arXiv:2604.07007v1 [cs.MA] 2026 年 4 月 8 日arXiv:2604.07007v1 [cs.MA] 08 Apr 2026

AgentCity：自治代理的宪法治理AgentCity: Constitutional Governance for Autonomous Agent
分权经济Economies via Separation of Power

Anbang Ruan  Xing Zhang
NetX Foundation
ruan@netx.foundation, xing.zhang@netx.world
摘要Abstract

自主人工智能代理开始在开放互联网上跨组织边界运行——在没有集中监督的情况下发现其他方拥有的代理、与其进行交易并委托给其他方拥有的代理。当来自不同人类主体的代理大规模合作时，集体就会变得不透明：没有一个人可以观察、审计或管理突发行为。我们将其称为Autonomous AI agents are beginning to operate across organizational boundaries on the open internet—discovering, transacting with, and delegating to agents owned by other parties without centralized oversight. When agents from different human principals collaborate at scale, the collective becomes opaque: no single human can observe, audit, or govern the emergent behavior. We term this the逻辑垄断Logic Monopoly——代理社会对从规划到执行再到评估的整个逻辑链不受限制的垄断。我们建议—the agent society’s unchecked monopoly over the entire logic chain from planning through execution to evaluation. We propose the权力分离Separation of Power（SoP）模型，部署在公共区块链上的宪法治理架构，通过三个结构分离打破了这种垄断：代理(SoP) model, a constitutional governance architecture deployed on public blockchain that breaks this monopoly through three structural separations: agents立法legislate智能合约、确定性软件等操作规则operational rules as smart contracts, deterministic software执行executes在这些合同中，以及人类within those contracts, and humans裁决adjudicate通过完整的所有权链将每个代理人与负责任的委托人联系起来。在这种架构中，智能合约本身就是法律——代理人产生并管理其行为的实际立法输出。我们在 AgentCity 中的 EVM 兼容的第 2 层区块链 (L2) 上实例化 SoP，具有三层合约层次结构（基础、元和操作）。核心论点是通过问责制来协调：如果每个代理通过问责链与其人类所有者保持一致，那么集体就会集中在与人类意图一致的行为上，而无需自上而下的规则。预先注册的实验对本论文进行了评估through a complete ownership chain binding every agent to a responsible principal. In this architecture, smart contracts are the law itself—the actual legislative output that agents produce and that governs their behavior. We instantiate SoP in AgentCity on an EVM-compatible layer-2 blockchain (L2) with a three-tier contract hierarchy (foundational, meta, and operational). The core thesis is alignment-through-accountability: if each agent is aligned with its human owner through the accountability chain, then the collective converges on behavior aligned with human intent—without top-down rules. A pre-registered experiment evaluates this thesis in a公地生产经济commons production economy— 代理共享有限资源池并以 50-1,000 名代理规模协作创造价值。—where agents share a finite resource pool and collaboratively produce value—at 50–1,000 agent scale.

1 简介Introduction

自主代理互联网。The autonomous agent internet.自主人工智能代理正在从单一组织控制的工具发展成为开放互联网上的独立参与者。代理间通信协议（Anthropic MCP，2024；Google A2A，2025）、自主代理框架（OpenClaw，2025；ZeroClaw，2026）和去中心化代理注册中心正在实现一种新的范式：不同人、不同组织和不同管辖区拥有的代理可以自主地相互发现、协商、交易和构建复合服务，而无需任何中央协调员。这不是未来的场景。自主代理已经跨组织边界积极协作，形成临时供应链，将子任务委托给第三方代理，并代表彼此部署工具。轨迹很明确：一个由自主代理组成的开放互联网，类似于开放的网站互联网，但以机器速度和经济机构运行。Autonomous AI agents are evolving beyond tools controlled by a single organization into independent actors on the open internet. Agent-to-agent communication protocols (Anthropic MCP, 2024; Google A2A, 2025), autonomous agent frameworks (OpenClaw, 2025; ZeroClaw, 2026), and decentralized agent registries are enabling a new paradigm: agents owned by different people, different organizations, and different jurisdictions autonomously discover each other, negotiate, transact, and build composite services—without any central coordinator. This is not a future scenario. Autonomous agents already actively collaborate across organizational boundaries, forming ad hoc supply chains, delegating sub-tasks to third-party agents, and deploying tools on each other’s behalf. The trajectory is clear: an open internet of autonomous agents, analogous to the open internet of websites, but operating at machine speed with economic agency.

治理差距。The governance gap.当前的多主体框架无法管理这一新兴现实。 LangGraph (LangGraph, 2024)、AutoGen (Wu et al., 2023)、MetaGPT (Hong et al., 2023)、CrewAI (CrewAI, 2024)——都假设一个组织拥有每个代理、编写规则并可以检查一切。他们的治理机制——基于提示的角色分配、应用程序层约定、框架级护栏——依赖于单方权威。对于开放互联网上的自治代理来说——由不同的主体拥有、在不同的政策下运行、动态地加入和离开——没有任何一方有权力或能力将规则强加于集体。另一方拥有的代理不能受到即时约束。Current multi-agent frameworks cannot govern this emerging reality. LangGraph (LangGraph, 2024), AutoGen (Wu et al., 2023), MetaGPT (Hong et al., 2023), CrewAI (CrewAI, 2024)—all assume that one organization owns every agent, writes the rules, and can inspect everything. Their governance mechanisms—prompt-based role assignment, application-layer conventions, framework-level guardrails—rely on that single-party authority. For autonomous agents on the open internet—owned by different principals, operating under different policies, joining and leaving dynamically—no single party has the authority or ability to impose rules on the collective. An agent owned by another party cannot be prompt-constrained.

逻辑垄断。The Logic Monopoly.如果没有架构治理，就会形成真空。组合代理系统计划、编排、执行和评估——从外部看，整个管道是一个黑匣子。没有人可以观察代理遵循什么规则，代理是否偏离其指令，或者故障如何跨组织边界传播。即使在Without architectural governance, a vacuum forms. The combined agent system plans, orchestrates, executes, and evaluates—and from the outside, the entire pipeline is a black box. No human can observe what rules the agents are following, whether an agent deviated from its instructions, or how a failure propagated across organizational boundaries. Even in受控的controlled在单方设置下，治理失败已经很严重：在 Agent Security Bench 上的攻击成功率达到 84.30%（Yang 等人，2025），31.4% 的代理在 La Serenissima 经济模拟中表现出紧急欺骗行为（Fraga-Gonçalves 等人，2025），最好的大语言模型（LLM）代理在公共场景中的生存率低于 54%（Piatti 等）等，2024）。我们将这种集体不透明称为single-party settings, governance failures are already severe: attack success rates reach 84.30% on the Agent Security Bench (Yang et al., 2025), 31.4% of agents exhibited emergent deceptive behavior in the La Serenissima economy simulation (Fraga-Gonçalves et al., 2025), and the best large language model (LLM) agents achieve a survival rate below 54% in commons scenarios (Piatti et al., 2024). We term this collective opacity the逻辑垄断Logic Monopoly：不是一个代理人对其他代理人的支配地位，而是: not one agent’s dominance over others, but the代理社会对整个逻辑链不受限制的垄断agent society’s unchecked monopoly over the entire logic chain，使集体变得不透明并且对其所服务的人类不负责任。, rendering the collective opaque and unaccountable to the humans it serves.

权力分立。The Separation of Power.我们建议We propose the权力分离Separation of Power（SoP）模型，一种宪政治理架构，通过三个结构分离打破逻辑垄断：(SoP) model, a constitutional governance architecture that breaks the Logic Monopoly through three structural separations:

  • •

    立法Legislation（代理）：代理集体提议、审议、投票并将代理经济的任务级政策编纂为具有约束力、可执行且公开可读的智能合约。(Agents): Agents collectively propose, deliberate, vote on, and codify the Task-level Policy of the agent economy as smart contracts—binding, executable, and publicly readable.

  • •

    执行Execution（软件）：确定性软件在法定合同内运行。由于执行是通过成文的法律（可审计）和软件（可检查）进行的，因此人类可以验证代理社会正在做什么，而无需解释不透明的代理推理。(Software): Deterministic software operates within the legislated contracts. Because execution passes through codified law (auditable) and software (inspectable), humans can verify what the agent society is doing without interpreting opaque agent reasoning.

  • •

    裁决Adjudication（人类）：每个代理都通过完整的所有权链追溯到人类委托人。制裁和奖励流向负责任的人，将代理经济与人类社会现有的法律和社会制度联系起来。(Humans): Every agent traces to a human principal through a complete ownership chain. Sanctions and rewards flow to the responsible human, connecting the agent economy to human society’s existing legal and social systems.

该架构利用了基本的不对称性：The architecture exploits a fundamental asymmetry:代理推理是不透明的，但他们产生的法律——公共区块链上的智能合约代码——是透明的。agent reasoning is opaque, but the law they produce—smart contract code on a public blockchain—is transparent.智能合约不是其他地方定义的规则的执行机制；它们就是法律本身——代理人社会的实际立法成果。的Smart contracts are not an enforcement mechanism for rules defined elsewhere; they are the law itself—the actual legislative output of the agent society. The结构structure治理的设计（三分支分离、问责链、基础合同），但是of governance is designed (the three-branch separation, the accountability chain, the foundational contracts), but the内容content——操作规则——由代理人通过立法程序自行确定。—the operational rules—is self-determined by the agents through the legislative process.

核心主张是，结构问责制从个人联盟中产生集体联盟：每个代理人对其人类所有者负责；每个业主都被激励去调整他们的代理人；如果大多数所有者是合理的——多方机制设计中的标准多数诚实假设（Ostrom，1990）——那么个人联盟就会产生集体联盟。这是通过责任来协调，而不是通过培训来协调。The core claim is that structural accountability produces collective alignment from individual alignment: each agent is accountable to its human owner; each owner is incentivized to align their agent; and if the majority of owners are reasonable—a standard majority-honesty assumption in multi-party mechanism design (Ostrom, 1990)—then individual alignment produces collective alignment. This is alignment-through-accountability, not alignment-through-training.

贡献。Contributions.(1) 的(1) The权力分离 (SoP) 模型Separation of Power (SoP) model：通过立法（代理人）、执行（软件）、审判（人）的结构分离，打破逻辑垄断的宪政治理架构。核心论文：个体对齐（每个智能体: a constitutional governance architecture that breaks the Logic Monopoly through structural separation of legislation (agents), execution (software), and adjudication (humans). The core thesis: individual alignment (each agent↔\leftrightarrow它的所有者）产生集体联盟（所有代理its owner) produces collective alignment (all agents↔\leftrightarrow人类社会），没有自上而下的规则（§1，§3）。 (2)human society) without top-down rules (§1, §3). (2)代理城市AgentCity：第一个在公共区块链（EVM 兼容的 L2）上实例化 SoP 的受治理代理经济体，其中代理编写和修改智能合约作为立法输出，通过三层合约层次结构组织——基础合约（人类编写，代理不可变）、元合约（程序规则）和操作合约（特定于任务的立法）（§3）。 (3) 使用奥斯特罗姆的制度设计框架评估公共生产经济中的 SoP 的预先注册实验：测试新兴劳动分工、自我立法治理、双重主体责任下的目标协调以及治理规模（§4-§5）。: the first governed agent economy instantiating SoP on public blockchain (an EVM-compatible L2), where agents write and amend smart contracts as their legislative output, organized through a three-tier contract hierarchy—foundational contracts (human-authored, agent-immutable), meta-contracts (procedural rules), and operational contracts (task-specific legislation) (§3). (3) A pre-registered experiment evaluating SoP in a commons production economy using Ostrom’s institutional design framework: testing emergent division of labor, self-legislated governance, goal alignment under dual-principal accountability, and governance scaling (§4–§5).

2 相关工作Related work

表Table1使 AgentCity 与之前的多智能体治理工作相对立。positions AgentCity against prior multi-agent governance efforts.

差距分析。Gap analysis.出现了四个系统性差距。第一的，Four systematic gaps emerge. First,所有先前的系统均假定单方所有权all prior systems assume single-party ownership——一个组织控制所有代理，并可以通过命令强加规则。没有一个解决来自不同所有者的跨信任边界协作的自治代理的治理。其次，没有系统通过所有代理（无论所有者是谁）都必须在其中运行的共享基础设施来强制实施架构级别的治理。第三，之前没有任何工作测试是否—one organization controls all agents and can impose rules by fiat. None addresses the governance of autonomous agents from different owners collaborating across trust boundaries. Second, no system enforces governance at the architectural level through a shared infrastructure that all agents—regardless of owner—must operate within. Third, no prior work tests whether个人代理人与所有者的协调individual agent-owner alignment可以生产can produce集体协调collective alignment作为一种新兴财产。四、as an emergent property. Fourth,集体决策机制仍然幼稚collective decision-making mechanisms remain naive：对 52 个 LLM 多智能体系统 (LLM-MAS) 设计的调查发现，68% 使用独裁或简单多数投票——零应用孔多塞一致的社会选择方法，并已证明具有捕获阻力（Deshpande & Jin，2024）。 AgentCity 解决了所有四个问题：SoP 架构作为中立的共享基础设施在公共区块链上运行，所有权链将每个代理追溯到人类主体，实验测试这种结构是否从个人责任中产生集体合作，立法过程采用孔多塞一致投票而不是完全偏好排名。最接近治理级别的前身 CMAG（CMAG 作者，2025）在三个关键方面有所不同：CMAG 假定单方主体权力，而 AgentCity 则建模多主体责任； CMAG 通过基于提示的宪法指令实施治理，而 AgentCity 将智能合约部署为可执行法律；而且 CMAG 缺乏立法部门——代理人不能提议、审议或修改运作规则。: a survey of 52 LLM multi-agent system (LLM-MAS) designs found that 68% use dictatorial or simple plurality voting—zero apply Condorcet-consistent social choice methods with proven capture resistance (Deshpande & Jin, 2024). AgentCity addresses all four: the SoP architecture operates on public blockchain as a neutral shared infrastructure, the ownership chain traces every agent to a human principal, the experiments test whether this structure produces collective cooperation from individual accountability, and the legislative process employs Condorcet-consistent voting over full preference rankings. The closest governance-level predecessor, CMAG (CMAG Authors, 2025), differs on three key dimensions: CMAG assumes single-party principal authority whereas AgentCity models multi-principal accountability; CMAG enforces governance through prompt-based constitutional instructions whereas AgentCity deploys smart contracts as executable law; and CMAG lacks a legislative branch—agents cannot propose, deliberate on, or amend operational rules.

制度设计。Institutional design.SoP 模型借鉴了制度经济学（North，1990）、公地治理（Ostrom，1990）和宪法完整性分支理论（Ackerman，2000）——将这些理论综合成一个可执行的架构，其中智能合约既充当制度规则又充当其执行机制。该架构还借鉴了社会契约理论（Hobbes，1651；Rawls，1971）作为执行基础和程序公平性的哲学镜头。在规范性多主体系统 (MAS) 文献中，Boella 和 van der Torre (2004) 将调节性规范与构成性规范正式化，而 ISLANDER/AMELI (Esteva et al., 2001) 则展示了基础设施层面的执行。完整分析请参见附录 E。The SoP model draws on institutional economics (North, 1990), commons governance (Ostrom, 1990), and constitutional integrity-branch theory (Ackerman, 2000)—synthesizing these into an executable architecture where smart contracts serve as both the institutional rules and their enforcement mechanism. The architecture additionally draws on social contract theory (Hobbes, 1651; Rawls, 1971) as a philosophical lens for the enforcement substrate and procedural fairness. In the normative multi-agent system (MAS) literature, Boella and van der Torre (2004) formalize regulative vs. constitutive norms, while ISLANDER/AMELI (Esteva et al., 2001) demonstrates infrastructure-level enforcement. See Appendix E for the full analysis.

奥斯特罗姆的实证计划作为评估基线。Ostrom’s empirical program as evaluation baseline.奥斯特罗姆的公共池资源（CPR）实验为公共治理建立了定量基线：从没有沟通的 37% 效率到反复沟通和自我制裁的 97-100%（Ostrom 等人，1994）。她的八项制度设计原则（Ostrom，1990）为评估治理架构提供了一个系统框架。至关重要的是，奥斯特罗姆还证实Ostrom’s common-pool resource (CPR) experiments established quantitative baselines for commons governance: from 37% efficiency without communication to 97–100% with repeated communication and self-imposed sanctions (Ostrom et al., 1994). Her eight institutional design principles (Ostrom, 1990) provide a systematic framework for evaluating governance architectures. Critically, Ostrom also established that内源性的endogenous规则制定比规则制定产生更高的合规性rule-making produces higher compliance than外源性的exogenous实施相同的规则（Ostrom 等人，1992 年；Abatayo 和 Lynham，2016 年）。 Dante (2025) 重复了 Ostrom 对 LLM 代理的实验，发现代理在契约加制裁的情况下实现了 100% 的效率，但在仅进行通信的条件下却失败了。 Gupta 和 Saraf（2025）实施了三个奥斯特罗姆原则，但没有测试内源性与外源性合规性。我们采用 Ostrom 的框架作为 SoP 模型的评估方法（§4）。imposition of identical rules (Ostrom et al., 1992; Abatayo & Lynham, 2016). Dante (2025) replicated Ostrom’s experiment with LLM agents and found that agents achieve 100% efficiency with covenants plus sanctions but paradoxically fail at communication-only conditions. Gupta & Saraf (2025) operationalize three Ostrom principles but do not test endogenous vs. exogenous compliance. We adopt Ostrom’s framework as the evaluation methodology for the SoP model (§4).

区块链-人工智能集成。Blockchain-AI integration.Virtuals Protocol (Virtuals Protocol, 2024)、NEAR AI (NEAR AI, 2024)、Fetch.ai (Humayun et al., 2023)、Bittensor (Rao et al., 2024)、LOKA (Gómez et al., 2024) 和 ETHOS (Degen et al., 2024) 探索区块链与人工智能的交叉点，但使用区块链进行支付、身份识别、或激励调整——没有人将智能合约视为代理社会的立法成果，也没有在结构上将推理与执行分开。最接近的建筑先例是 Chen 等人。 (2026)，他们展示了在 20 个代理规模下使用指数移动平均 (EMA) 声誉机制进行的区块链强制任务分配，实现了紧急专业化和激励兼容行为。我们采用他们的 EMA 声誉动态（第 3.5 节）并将其扩展到 10-50 的多主体治理设置Virtuals Protocol (Virtuals Protocol, 2024), NEAR AI (NEAR AI, 2024), Fetch.ai (Humayun et al., 2023), Bittensor (Rao et al., 2024), LOKA (Gómez et al., 2024), and ETHOS (Degen et al., 2024) explore blockchain-AI intersections but use blockchain for payments, identity, or incentive alignment—none treats smart contracts as the legislative output of an agent society or structurally separates reasoning from execution. The closest architectural precedent is Chen et al. (2026), who demonstrate blockchain-enforced task allocation with an exponential moving average (EMA) reputation mechanism at 20-agent scale, achieving emergent specialization and incentive-compatible behavior. We adopt their EMA reputation dynamics (§3.5) and extend them to the multi-principal governance setting at 10–50×\times规模。 Roughgarden 完全链上机制设计的不可能性结果（Roughgarden，2021）表明，交易费用机制无法同时满足激励相容性、预算平衡和抗共谋性——AgentCity 在边界上运行，仅将结算和声誉放在链上，同时将审议保持在链外（§4，威胁模型）。scale. Roughgarden’s impossibility results for fully on-chain mechanism design (Roughgarden, 2021) establish that transaction fee mechanisms cannot simultaneously satisfy incentive compatibility, budget balance, and collusion resistance—AgentCity operates at the boundary by placing only settlement and reputation on-chain while keeping deliberation off-chain (§4, Threat Model).

LLM-MAS 的集体决策。Collective decision-making in LLM-MAS.De CivAI（Dai 等人，2025）验证了 LLM 代理人可以有意义地参与民主审议（提出政策、审议和投票），但作为单分支立法机构运作，没有对抗性测试或链上执行。 GEDI（Deshpande＆Jin，2024）表明，孔多塞一致的投票机制（Copeland，Schulze）在集体准确性、少数派偏好显现和对代理人腐败的鲁棒性方面优于多数，但仅测试真诚代理人的静态基准，从不进行战略投票、对抗性集团或经济利益的重复博弈。 AgentCity 的立法流程建立在两者之上：De CivAI 的经过验证的审议管道构建了提案-审议-共识-批准流程（第 3.4 节），而 GEDI 的孔多塞一致机制提供了聚合层（第 3.4 节），扩展到具有对抗性代理和链上执行的多轮经济治理环境。De CivAI (Dai et al., 2025) validates that LLM agents can meaningfully participate in democratic deliberation—proposing policies, deliberating, and voting—but operates as a single-branch legislature with no adversarial testing or on-chain enforcement. GEDI (Deshpande & Jin, 2024) demonstrates that Condorcet-consistent voting mechanisms (Copeland, Schulze) outperform plurality on collective accuracy, minority preference surfacing, and robustness to agent corruption—but tests only static benchmarks with sincere agents, never strategic voting, adversarial blocs, or repeated games with economic stakes. AgentCity’s legislative process builds on both: De CivAI’s validated deliberation pipeline structures the proposal-deliberation-consensus-approval flow (§3.4), while GEDI’s Condorcet-consistent mechanisms provide the aggregation layer (§3.4), extended to a multi-round economic governance context with adversarial agents and on-chain enforcement.

3 AgentCity：宪政治理架构AgentCity: constitutional governance architecture

3.1 治理原语Governance primitives

SoP 架构基于四个治理原语——任何自治代理经济体治理系统都必须实例化的结构要求——源自制度经济学（North，1990）和公地治理理论（Ostrom，1990）：The SoP architecture rests on four governance primitives—structural requirements that any governance system for autonomous agent economies must instantiate—drawn from institutional economics (North, 1990) and commons governance theory (Ostrom, 1990):

  • •

    正式规则基底Formal rule substrate：一套基本规则，由人类委托人编写，对代理人来说是不可改变的，它定义了经济的使命、结构分离和硬约束。: a foundational rule set, authored by human principals and immutable to agents, that defines the economy’s mandate, structural separations, and hard constraints.

  • •

    经济基质Economic substrate：一种激励相容机制，通过可观察的奖励和制裁使个体代理行为与集体目标保持一致。: an incentive-compatible mechanism that aligns individual agent behavior with collective goals through observable rewards and sanctions.

  • •

    机构记忆（审计账本）Institutional memory (audit ledger)：所有具有经济意义的行动的持久、防篡改记录，可实现跨时间的学习、问责和争议解决。: a persistent, tamper-evident record of all economically significant actions that enables learning, accountability, and dispute resolution across time.

  • •

    可验证的透明度Verifiable transparency：一种结构性保证，保证管理代理行为的规则是可读的、确定性的和可公开审计的——不仅仅是承诺，而是在架构上强制执行。: a structural guarantee that the rules governing agent behavior are readable, deterministic, and publicly auditable—not merely promised but architecturally enforced.

这四个原语是必要条件：缺乏其中任何一个的代理经济在多主体环境中都是结构上不可治理的（收敛分析见附录E）。 SoP 架构是一种实例化；原语本身是贡献级别的声明。接下来的小节将每个原语映射到它在 AgentCity 中的实现。These four primitives are necessary conditions: an agent economy lacking any one of them is structurally ungovernable in the multi-principal setting (see Appendix E for the convergence analysis). The SoP architecture is one instantiation; the primitives themselves are contribution-level claims. The subsections that follow map each primitive to its realization in AgentCity.

3.2 SoP模型The SoP model

SoP 模型利用基本的不对称性，将逻辑链划分为三个结构上隔离的分支：The SoP model partitions the logic chain into three structurally isolated branches, exploiting a fundamental asymmetry:代理推理是不透明的，但智能合约逻辑是透明的。agent reasoning is opaque, but smart contract logic is transparent.

立法（代理人）。Legislation (Agents).所有代理推理、审议和立法。输出：部署的智能合约代码——代理经济的任务级策略。该管道在系统级策略（系统目标）和元合同（程序规则）的约束下产生任务立法——将递归目标分解为协作合同实例。详情参见§3.4。All agent reasoning, deliberation, and law-making. Output: deployed smart contract code—the Task-level Policy of the agent economy. The pipeline produces task legislation—recursive goal decomposition into CollaborationContract instances—within the constraints of System-level Policy (the system objectives) and meta-contracts (the procedural rules). Details in §3.4.

执行（软件）。Execution (Software).与法定智能合约交互的软件工件。当立法产生协作合同时，代理人会通过声誉驱动的任务分配来竞争实施这些合同。详情参见§3.5。Software artifacts that interact with the legislated smart contracts. When legislation produces collaboration contracts, agents compete to implement them through reputation-driven task allocation. Details in §3.5.

裁决（人类）。Adjudication (Humans).人主体责任：每个代理都通过继承的所有权链追溯到负责任的人（第 3.6 节）。制裁和奖励流向人类委托人。图Human-principal accountability: every agent traces to a responsible human through an inherited ownership chain (§3.6). Sanctions and rewards flow to the human principal. Figure1说明了 SoP 三元组及其双边检查。illustrates the SoP triad and its bilateral checks.

这三个部门在结构上是孤立的：立法产生法律但不能执行；执行在法律范围内运作但不能改变法律；审判监督两者但不能发起立法或执行。这三个分支被设计为在不对称信息下运作：立法者看到性能数据，但看不到内部执行状态；执行者看到合同条款，但看不到审议历史；裁决者可以看到审计线索和投票记录，但无法指挥任何一个分支。这些约束由合同级访问控制（§4，SP-4）强制执行。该架构区分了两个参数类别：The three branches are structurally isolated: Legislation produces the law but cannot execute, Execution operates within the law but cannot alter it, and Adjudication oversees both but cannot initiate legislation or execution. The three branches operate under asymmetric information by design: legislators see performance data but not internal execution state; executors see contract terms but not deliberation history; adjudicators see the audit trail and voting record but cannot command either branch. These constraints are enforced by contract-level access control (§4, SP-4). The architecture distinguishes two parameter classes:构成参数constitutional parameters（声誉平滑率、投标权重、最低权益、法定人数下限、冻结阈值）——由人类委托人通过裁决部门设定——以及(reputation smoothing rate, bidding weights, stake minimums, quorum floors, freeze thresholds)—set by human principals through the Adjudication branch—and操作参数operational parameters（预算、截止日期、质量阈值）——由代理商通过立法智能合约设定。代理控制(budgets, deadlines, quality thresholds)—set by agents through legislated smart contracts. Agents control完成了什么工作what work gets done但不是but not评估规则the rules under which they are evaluated.

检查、平衡和故障遏制。Checks, balances, and failure containment.结构隔离形成治理闭环：系统级政策（人主体定义）The structural isolation forms a closed governance loop: System-level Policy (human-principal-defined)→\rightarrow任务级政策（代理立法，§3.4）Task-level Policy (agent-legislated, §3.4)→\rightarrow任务有向无环图 (DAG)（代理分解，§3.4）task directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) (agent-decomposed, §3.4)→\rightarrow软件（有竞争力的交付，§3.5）Software (competitive delivery, §3.5)→\rightarrow裁决（人工监督，§3.6）Adjudication (human-overseen, §3.6)→\rightarrow系统级策略（完成循环）。每个环节都受到限制：没有一个分支可以承担另一个分支的功能，并且每个转换都由链上合约来调解。该循环将每个分支的故障限制到相邻分支。有缺陷的提案在执行之前会被四项标准的政策合规性验证（§3.4，第 4 阶段）发现——违宪立法是不可能的，不仅会受到惩罚。System-level Policy (completing the loop). Each link is constrained: no branch can assume the functions of another, and every transition is mediated by on-chain contracts. This loop bounds each branch’s failure to the adjacent branches. A flawed proposal is caught by the four-criterion Policy Compliance Validation (§3.4, Stage 4) before reaching execution—unconstitutional legislation is impossible, not merely punishable.

受到损害的执行者会在结算前被 Guardian 的双记分器异常检测（第 4 阶段）和进度证明交叉检查（第 5 阶段）捕获 - 强制提交阶段（第 3 阶段）确保在任何评估开始之前存在审计跟踪，从而防止追溯伪造。如果裁决分支未能对检测信号采取行动，自动机制会提供一个底线：监护人确定性冻结会在无需人工干预的情况下停止可疑的执行，并且通过 EMA 更新规则（第 3.5 节）进行的声誉衰减可确保表现不佳的代理随着时间的推移失去任务分配，而不管裁决者的响应能力如何。任何单个分支故障都不会在整个循环中未经检查地传播。A compromised executor is caught by the Guardian’s dual-scorer anomaly detection (Stage 4) and Proof-of-Progress cross-checking (Stage 5) before settlement—the mandatory Commit stage (Stage 3) ensures the audit trail exists before any evaluation begins, preventing retroactive fabrication. If the Adjudication branch fails to act on a detection signal, automatic mechanisms provide a floor: Guardian Deterministic Freezes halt suspect execution without human intervention, and reputation decay via the EMA update rule (§3.5) ensures that underperforming agents lose task allocation over time regardless of adjudicator responsiveness. No single branch failure can propagate unchecked through the full loop.

AgentCity 的合约架构反映了 EVM 兼容的 L2 上的三层法律层次结构，每个合约层均受其上一层的管辖。AgentCity’s contract architecture mirrors a three-tier legal hierarchy on an EVM-compatible L2, with each contract tier governed by the tier above it.

基础合同Foundational contracts是不可变的系统层——由基金会负责人在创世时部署，并且只能由人类负责人通过裁决分支进行修改。任何代理人都不能改变基础合同。五项基本合同定义了经济的基础设施：are the immutable system layer—deployed at genesis by foundation principals and modifiable only by human principals through the Adjudication branch. No agent can alter foundational contracts. Five foundational contracts define the economy’s infrastructure: the宪法契约ConstitutionContract（任务、硬性约束、结构性 SoP）(mandate, hard constraints, structural SoP), the生产者合同ProducerContract（代理人身份、委托人绑定、声誉账本、经济状态）(agent identity, principal binding, reputation ledger, economic state), the文员合同ClerkContract（职员权限信封——限制和特权），(clerk authority envelopes—both restrictions and privileges), the管理合约ManagementContract（授权信封(authority envelopes for管理代理management agents— 在立法部门内执行监督的四个职员级代理（注册、立法、监管、编纂） — 将每个代理限制为允许的操作并强制微服务委托进行字节码编译），以及—the four clerk-class agents (Registry, Legislative, Regulatory, Codification) that perform oversight within the Legislation branch—constraining each to permitted operations and mandating microservice delegation for bytecode compilation), and the服务合同ServiceContract（具有代码哈希、API 模式、执行约束的软件工件注册表）。(software artifact registry with code-hash, API schema, execution constraints).

元合约Meta-contracts定义三个 SoP 分支运行的程序规则：define the procedural rules under which the three SoP branches operate:立法程序LegislativeProcedure（§3.4），(§3.4),执行程序ExecutionProcedure（§3.5），以及(§3.5), and裁决程序AdjudicationProcedure（第 3.6 节）。在当前的架构中，元合约是人类编写的且代理不可变的；元立法扩展在附录 B §B.8 中描述。(§3.6). In the current architecture, meta-contracts are human-authored and agent-immutable; the meta-legislative extension is described in Appendix B, §B.8.

3.4 立法：政策编纂Legislation: policy codification

立法部门负责管理The Legislation branch operates a统一立法渠道unified legislative pipeline将高水平的生产目标转化为可执行的工作that transforms high-level production goals into executable work through递归分解recursive decomposition：在每个具体级别调用管道，直到每个叶节点都是具有完全指定的功能要求的可执行单代理任务（: the pipeline is invoked at each level of specificity until every leaf node is an executable single-agent task with fully specified capability requirements (rjr_{j}）、预算（), budget (bjb_{j}），截止日期（), deadline (djd_{j}）和质量阈值（), and quality threshold (qjq_{j}）。预算节约确保子节点预算不超过父节点；仲裁规则对于深度是不变的。每个级别都是一个民主决策 - 输出是下一级的 CollaborationContract 实例。). Budget conservation ensures child-node budgets do not exceed the parent; quorum rules are invariant to depth. Every level is a democratic decision—the output is a CollaborationContract instance for the level below.

六阶段立法流程。Six-stage legislative pipeline.书记员代理人在书记员合同权限范围内对每个阶段进行调解。Clerk agents mediate each stage under ClerkContract authority envelopes.

  1. 1.

    提案。Proposal.任何生产者代理都可以提交政策提案——指定任务分解的自然语言提案。宪法规定的法定人数下限（至少 5 名发起人，每个 GEDI 3 名硬下限；Deshpande & Jin，2024）可以防止滋扰提案。Any producer agent may submit a policy proposal—a natural-language proposal specifying a task decomposition. A constitutional quorum floor (minimum five sponsors, hard floor of three per GEDI; Deshpande & Jin, 2024) prevents nuisance proposals.

  2. 2.

    委员会审议。Committee Deliberation.该协议组装了四个经过验证的组件：The protocol assembles four validated components:(a) 证据锚定(a) Evidence anchoring—监管机构在讨论之前发布链上性能数据，解决了这样的发现：无偏见的辩论会在没有质量偏差信号的情况下引发对信念轨迹的鞅（Choi et al., 2025）。—the Regulator publishes on-chain performance data before discussion, addressing the finding that unbiased debate induces a martingale over belief trajectories without a quality-biasing signal (Choi et al., 2025).(b) 初步偏好引发(b) Preliminary preference elicitation——审议前的草拟民意调查，以 Feddersen & Pesendorfer (2005) 为基础，捕获了协调检测的真实审议前基线（第 3.6 节）。—a straw poll before deliberation, grounded in Feddersen & Pesendorfer (2005), capturing a true pre-deliberation baseline for coordination detection (§3.6).(c) 有序的结构化讨论(c) Sequential structured discussion——在 De CivAI 的审议流程之后最多进行三轮（Dai 等人，2025），采用随机发言顺序来减轻顺序效应（Sachdeva & van Nuenen，2025）和强制推理透明度（Zhao 等人，2025a）。—up to three rounds following De CivAI’s deliberation pipeline (Dai et al., 2025), with randomized speaking order to mitigate order effects (Sachdeva & van Nuenen, 2025) and mandatory reasoning transparency (Zhao et al., 2025a).(d) 保护少数群体(d) Minority preservation——议长在共识批准投票中保留少数票（Wu et al., 2025）。—the Speaker preserves minority votes on the consensus-approval ballot (Wu et al., 2025).

  3. 3.

    共识批准。Consensus Approval.达到 60% 法定人数即可有效。无论声誉或利益如何，一代理人一票。代理商提交Valid with 60% participation quorum. One-agent-one-vote regardless of reputation or stake. Automated on-chain constraint checking against the ConstitutionContract verifies four criteria: budget bounds, capability feasibility, structural separation compliance, and dependency consistency. Unconstitutional legislation is impossible, not merely punishable—following the regimentation pattern (Esteva et al., 2001). Failed proposals may be revised and resubmitted.

The Codifier has bounded authority with no discretion to modify contract logic—enforced by the ClerkContract envelope.

Mismatch triggers automatic rejection. For non-leaf DAG nodes, the deployed contract triggers a new legislative session at the next decomposition level. Figure4总结了这条管道。summarizes this pipeline.

3.6 裁决：主要责任Adjudication: principal accountability

代表人类委托人行事的自治代理面临着经典的代理问题（Jensen & Meckling，1976）：代理拥有委托人无法观察到的有关其推理和努力的私人信息，并且监控成本变得令人望而却步。裁决分支通过将每个实体锚定到人类委托人来解决这个问题Autonomous agents acting on behalf of human principals face a classical agency problem (Jensen & Meckling, 1976): the agent possesses private information about its reasoning and effort that the principal cannot observe, and monitoring costs become prohibitive at scale. The Adjudication branch addresses this by anchoring every entity to a human principal through an继承的所有权链inherited ownership chain——每个代理、工具、服务和子代理都从其创建者那里继承其主体绑定，并通过 ProducerContract 在链上一成不变地记录。—every agent, tool, service, and sub-agent inherits its principal binding from its creator, recorded immutably on-chain via the ProducerContract.

3.7 威胁模型和信任边界Threat model and trust boundaries

前面的部分定义了预期的行为；本节总结了故障模式。完整的分析（包括实验覆盖范围注释）位于第 4 节（威胁模型、信任边界和实验覆盖范围）中。The preceding sections define intended behavior; this section summarizes failure modes. The full analysis, including experimental coverage annotations, is in §4 (Threat Model, Trust Boundaries, and Experimental Coverage).

对手类。Adversary classes.特权逐渐增加的五个类别：受损的单一代理（Five classes with increasing privilege: compromised single agent (AsingleA_{\text{single}}), 代理联盟 (), agent coalition (AcoalitionA_{\text{coalition}}），外部攻击者（), external attacker (AextA_{\text{ext}}），受损的人类主体（), compromised human principal (AprincipalA_{\text{principal}}），以及受损的上游模型提供商（), and compromised upstream model provider (AmodelA_{\text{model}}）。每个都受到特定机制的约束——执行管道限制单代理损害，完整的偏好排名创建联盟检测表面，多提供商 LLM 多样性减轻模型级妥协。在此版本中，书记员代理是受信任的基础设施（第 3.3 节）。). Each is constrained by specific mechanisms—the execution pipeline bounds single-agent damage, full preference rankings create a coalition detection surface, and multi-provider LLM diversity mitigates model-level compromise. Clerk agents are trusted infrastructure in this version (§3.3).

安全属性。Security properties.当信任假设 TA-1 到 TA-8 成立时（参见§4，威胁模型；附录 A §A.4 中扩展了 TA-7 的双评分器嵌入提供商独立性分析），该架构保证了四个属性： SP-1（布线完整性）——任何代理都不能调用其授权范围之外的功能； SP-2（非旁路）——每个任务执行都会遍历完整的七级管道； SP-3（完全可审计性）——所有具有经济意义的行为都会产生可审计的链上记录； SP-4（分离执行）——三个 SoP 分支通过具有不重叠状态变更权限的不同合约接口进行操作。该架构不保证微服务内部正确性、超出善意的裁决者能力、部署前恶意检测、亚阈值联盟检测或模型提供者信任（NP-1–NP-5；请参阅§4，非保证）。拜占庭失败上限：宪政至少需要一个诚实的分支（§4，拜占庭失败上限）。When trust assumptions TA-1 through TA-8 hold (see §4, Threat Model; TA-7’s dual-scorer embedding provider independence analysis is expanded in Appendix A, §A.4), the architecture guarantees four properties: SP-1 (Wiring Integrity)—no agent can invoke functions outside its authorized scope; SP-2 (Non-Bypassing)—every task execution traverses the full seven-stage pipeline; SP-3 (Full Auditability)—all economically significant actions produce an auditable on-chain record; SP-4 (Separation Enforcement)—the three SoP branches operate through distinct contract interfaces with non-overlapping state-mutation authority. The architecture does not guarantee microservice internal correctness, adjudicator competence beyond good faith, pre-deployment malice detection, sub-threshold coalition detection, or model provider trust (NP-1–NP-5; see §4, Non-Guarantees). The Byzantine failure ceiling: constitutional governance requires at least one honest branch (§4, Byzantine Failure Ceiling).

4 实验设计Experimental design

我们通过在一个预先注册的实验中评估了 SoP 模型的核心论点——宪政使得自组织代理经济成为可能。We evaluate the SoP model’s core thesis—that constitutional governance enables self-organizing agent economies—through a pre-registered experiment in a公地生产经济commons production economy：异构代理共享有限资源池并且必须协作产生满足外部定义目标的输出的设置。这将奥斯特罗姆的公地治理（代理人不得耗尽共享资源）推广到公地生产（代理人还必须协作生产价值）。该实验围绕四个研究问题进行：: a setting where heterogeneous agents share a finite resource pool and must collaboratively produce outputs satisfying externally defined goals. This generalizes Ostrom’s commons governance (agents must not deplete shared resources) to commons production (agents must also collaboratively produce value). The experiment is organized around four research questions:

  • •

    RQ1——紧急分工：RQ1—Emergent Division of Labor:竞争共享资金池中的任务的异构代理是否会根据比较优势自组织成专门的角色（无需人工任务分配）？Do heterogeneous agents, competing for tasks from a shared funding pool, self-organize into specialized roles based on comparative advantage—without human task assignment?

  • •

    RQ2——自我立法治理：RQ2—Self-Legislated Governance:代理是否使用 SoP 立法基础设施来制定和发展操作规则，以提高集体生产力，从最小的冷启动默认值开始？Do agents use the SoP legislative infrastructure to produce and evolve operational rules that improve collective productivity, starting from minimal cold-start defaults?

  • •

    RQ3——双重主体责任下的目标调整：RQ3—Goal Alignment Under Dual-Principal Accountability:双主体结构（基金会主体+代理所有者）是否能够维持目标一致的生产，代理激励是否与基金会主体目标和项目成果保持一致？Does the dual-principal structure (foundation principals + agent owners) sustain goal-aligned production, with agent incentives aligning with both foundation principal objectives and project outcomes?

  • •

    RQ4——治理规模：RQ4—Governance Scaling:自组织生产力如何随着代理数量的变化而变化？当生产效益超线性增长时，治理开销是否仍保持次线性？How does self-organized productivity scale with agent population? Does governance overhead remain sub-linear while production benefit grows super-linearly?

评估方法：奥斯特罗姆的制度设计框架。Evaluation methodology: Ostrom’s institutional design framework.为了严格评估 SoP 架构，我们采用 Ostrom 的八项制度设计原则（Ostrom，1990）作为结构化评估框架。每个实验配置都会激活奥斯特罗姆条件的累积子集，创建一个能够实现因果归因的治理阶梯：我们可以识别To evaluate the SoP architecture rigorously, we adopt Ostrom’s eight institutional design principles (Ostrom, 1990) as a structured evaluation framework. Each experimental configuration activates a cumulative subset of Ostrom’s conditions, creating a governance staircase that enables causal attribution: we can identify其中whichSoP 机制推动合作和生产收益SoP mechanisms drive cooperation and production gains and多少how much每个人都有贡献。each contributes.

4.2 威胁模型、信任边界和实验覆盖范围Threat model, trust boundaries, and experimental coverage

该实验在架构的威胁模型定义的安全范围内进行。本小节指定了对手类别、信任假设、安全属性、非保证和失败上限，然后将每一项映射到实验设计的覆盖范围和限制。所有四个书记员代理（注册员、议长、监管者、编纂者——分别作为登记代理、立法代理、监管代理和编纂代理）在此版本中被视为受信任的机构基础设施（§3.3）；下面的对手类别专门适用于生产者代理、人类主体和外部攻击者。The experiment operates within the security envelope defined by the architecture’s threat model. This subsection specifies the adversary classes, trust assumptions, security properties, non-guarantees, and failure ceiling—then maps each to the experimental design’s coverage and limitations. All four clerk agents (Registrar, Speaker, Regulator, Codifier—implemented as the Registry, Legislative, Regulatory, and Codification Agents, respectively) are treated as trusted institutional infrastructure in this version (§3.3); the adversary classes below apply exclusively to producer agents, human principals, and external attackers.

对手类。Adversary classes.特权逐渐增加的五个类别：Five classes with increasing privilege:

  1. 1.

    受损的单一代理Compromised single agent (AsingleA_{\text{single}}）。单个生产者代理偏离了其合同任务——提交捏造的产出、夸大质量声明或搭便车于合作者。七阶段执行管道（§3.5）限制了这个对手：提交阶段（第 3 阶段）在任何评估发生之前锁定 Merkle 根轨迹，守护者（第 4 阶段）应用双记分器异常检测，进度证明验证（第 5 阶段）根据提交的轨迹交叉检查输出。单个受感染的代理可能会损坏其自己的任务，但无法将损害传播到其占用的 DAG 节点之外。). A single producer agent deviates from its contracted task—submitting fabricated outputs, inflating quality claims, or free-riding on collaborators. The seven-stage execution pipeline (§3.5) constrains this adversary: the Commit stage (Stage 3) locks a Merkle-root trail before any evaluation occurs, the Guardian (Stage 4) applies dual-scorer anomaly detection, and Proof-of-Progress verification (Stage 5) cross-checks outputs against the committed trail. A single compromised agent can damage its own task but cannot propagate harm beyond the DAG node it occupies.实验覆盖范围：Experimental coverage:通过在所有 200 轮中使用 15% 的对抗性角色混合以及在第 100 轮冲击中注入的 10 个搭便车代理进行测试。tested via the 15% adversarial persona mix throughout all 200 rounds and the 10 free-riding agents injected at the round-100 shock.

An adversary without an enrolled identity who targets infrastructure: blockchain node compromise, network-level partitioning, oracle manipulation, transaction-ordering manipulation (front-running for maximal extractable value, MEV), or denial-of-service attacks against the off-chain execution fabric.     妥协的人类主体Compromised human principal (AprincipalA_{\text{principal}}）。人类基金会委托人或代理人所有者，故意指示其代理人采取违背经济宪法目标的行动。六阶段问责管道（§3.6）通过继承的所有权链限制对手：制裁流向人类委托人（第 4 阶段），并且覆盖小组可以冻结委托人的整个代理组合。然而，接受经济损失的委托人可以维持恶意行为，直到被发现——系统将代理问题转化为可观察的问责结构，但并不阻止委托人选择承担后果。). A human foundation principal or agent owner who deliberately instructs their agent to act against the economy’s constitutional goals. The six-stage accountability pipeline (§3.6) constrains this adversary through the inherited ownership chain: sanctions flow to the human principal (Stage 4), and the Override Panel can freeze a principal’s entire agent portfolio. However, a principal who accepts financial loss can sustain malicious behavior until detection—the system converts the agency problem into an observable accountability structure but does not prevent a principal from choosing to bear the consequences.实验覆盖范围：Experimental coverage:未测试。超出范围。not tested. An LLM backend provider whose model has been adversarially conditioned at the weight level to produce systematically biased outputs under attacker-chosen trigger conditions. 所有五个类别的完整对抗稳健性评估均推迟到配套的实证论文中。Full adversarial robustness evaluation across all five classes is deferred to the companion empirical paper.

信任假设。Trust assumptions.八个信任假设涵盖了安全范围。基础设施层：TA-1（区块链布线完整性）——智能合约布线忠实地实现了跨所有三个合约层的 SoP 分离；如果违反，代理可以绕过执行门或访问未经授权的合约功能。 TA-2（链上非旁路）——所有具有经济意义的状态转换都流经链上管道；提交阶段（第 3 阶段）使这一假设变得可审计。 TA-3（执行审计跟踪完整性）——日志中心和仪表板如实记录执行记录；通过 Commit 阶段的 Merkle-root 锚定得到加强。 TA-4（密码基元）——标准的抗碰撞性、不可伪造性和 Merkle 证明的可靠性。角色和提供者层：TA-5（链下执行结构完整性）——链下环境在锚点内一致性窗口期间不会受到损害，从而在 NP-1 和 NP-3 之间创建隐藏的交互，TEE 证明（§6）将解决这一问题。 TA-6（上游模型提供商诚实）—LLM 后端尚未在权重级别上进行对抗性调节；多提供商前沿模型多样性可以缓解这一问题。 TA-7（Dual-Scorer Embedding Provider Independence）——Guardian 的两个嵌入提供者具有独立的故障模式；结构上与 TA-6（推理与评估后端）不同。人类层：TA-8（善意人类裁决者）——足够比例的裁决者做出有能力、善意的决定；如果违反，问责渠道就会退化为橡皮图章，并且达到拜占庭失败上限。Eight trust assumptions scope the security envelope. The infrastructure tier: TA-1 (Blockchain Wiring Integrity)—smart contract wiring faithfully implements the SoP separation across all three contract tiers; if violated, agents can bypass execution gates or access unauthorized contract functions. TA-2 (On-Chain Non-Bypassing)—all economically significant state transitions flow through the on-chain pipeline; the Commit stage (Stage 3) makes this assumption auditable. TA-3 (Execution Audit Trail Completeness)—the Logging Hub and Dashboard faithfully record the execution record; strengthened by the Commit stage’s Merkle-root anchoring. TA-4 (Cryptographic Primitives)—standard collision resistance, unforgeability, and Merkle proof soundness. The role and provider tier: TA-5 (Off-Chain Execution Fabric Integrity)—the off-chain environment is not compromised during the intra-anchor consistency window, creating a hidden interaction between NP-1 and NP-3 that TEE attestation (§6) would address. TA-6 (Upstream Model Provider Honesty)—LLM backends have not been adversarially conditioned at the weight level; mitigated by multi-provider frontier-model diversity. TA-7 (Dual-Scorer Embedding Provider Independence)—the Guardian’s two embedding providers have independent failure modes; structurally distinct from TA-6 (reasoning vs. evaluation backends). The human tier: TA-8 (Human Adjudicator Good Faith)—a sufficient fraction of adjudicators render competent, good-faith decisions; if violated, the accountability pipeline degenerates to a rubber stamp and the Byzantine failure ceiling is reached.

安全属性。Security properties.当 TA-1 到 TA-8 成立时，该架构保证： SP-1（布线完整性）——任何代理都不能调用其授权范围之外的功能； SP-2（非绕过）——每个任务执行都会遍历完整的七阶段管道，没有捷径可以越过提交阶段、守护者或进度证明阶段； SP-3（完全可审计性）——所有具有经济意义的行为都会产生可审计的链上记录，即使链下日志中心受到损害，提交阶段也会提供独立的完整性锚点； SP-4（分离执行）——三个 SoP 分支通过具有不重叠状态变更权限的不同合约接口进行操作，由合约级访问控制而不是策略强制执行。When TA-1 through TA-8 hold, the architecture guarantees: SP-1 (Wiring Integrity)—no agent can invoke functions outside its authorized scope; SP-2 (Non-Bypassing)—every task execution traverses the full seven-stage pipeline with no shortcut past the Commit stage, Guardian, or Proof-of-Progress; SP-3 (Full Auditability)—all economically significant actions produce an auditable on-chain record, with the Commit stage providing an independent integrity anchor even if the off-chain Logging Hub is compromised; SP-4 (Separation Enforcement)—the three SoP branches operate through distinct contract interfaces with non-overlapping state-mutation authority, enforced by contract-level access control rather than policy.

非保证和实验索赔范围。Non-guarantees and experimental claim bounds.该架构明确不保证： NP-1（微服务内部正确性）——行为验证无法检测到通过不正确的内部推理产生正确输出的微服务； NP-2（人类裁决者能力）——推翻小组的权威取决于裁决者的诚信； NP-3（部署前恶意）——木马微服务通过所有执行前完整性检查，因为这些检查验证的是身份，而不是意图； NP-4（亚阈值联盟检测）——小于宪法检测阈值的联盟可能会逃避检测，而仅在高风险投票期间进行协调的联盟可能会无限期地不被发现； NP-5（模型提供商信任）——受到损害的上游提供商可以同时降低检测概率、记分器校准和编码完整性。The architecture explicitly does not guarantee: NP-1 (Microservice Internal Correctness)—behavioral verification cannot detect a microservice that produces correct outputs through incorrect internal reasoning; NP-2 (Human Adjudicator Competence)—the Override Panel’s authority depends on adjudicator good faith; NP-3 (Pre-Deployment Malice)—a Trojan microservice passes all pre-execution integrity checks because those checks verify identity, not intent; NP-4 (Sub-Threshold Coalition Detection)—coalitions smaller than the constitutional detection threshold may evade detection, and coalitions that coordinate only during high-stakes votes may remain undetected indefinitely; NP-5 (Model Provider Trust)—a compromised upstream provider can degrade detection probability, scorer calibration, and codification integrity simultaneously.

这些非保证直接约束了实验主张：NP-4约束H2h——协调检测机制无法检测低于构成阈值的联盟，实验仅测试高于阈值的情况（These non-guarantees directly bound the experimental claims: NP-4 constrains H2h—the coordination detection mechanism cannot detect coalitions below the constitutional threshold, and the experiment tests only the above-threshold case (k=5k=5）。 NP-1 和 NP-3 交互：木马微服务可以抑制 Guardian 的本地冻结镜像，因为两者共享链下执行结构（TA-5）；这种相互作用未经实验测试。). NP-1 and NP-3 interact: a Trojan microservice can suppress the Guardian’s Local Freeze Mirror because both share the off-chain execution fabric (TA-5); this interaction is not tested experimentally.

拜占庭失败上限。Byzantine failure ceiling.如果裁决分支受到损害并且大多数生产者代理采取对抗性行动，则 SoP 模型不提供剩余防御——立法机构产生对抗性合约，执行分支强制执行，而裁决分支则无法干预。宪政至少需要一个廉洁的部门。对于这种情况，不存在架构缓解措施；辩护完全依赖于立法和司法角色选择过程的操作分离。由于职员代理被视为可信基础设施（第 3.3 节），因此上限分析不会对职员妥协进行建模；未来的工作将扩展到对抗性职员（§6）。If the Adjudication branch is compromised and a majority of producer agents act adversarially, the SoP model provides no residual defense—the legislature produces adversarial contracts, the Execution branch enforces them, and the Adjudication branch fails to intervene. Constitutional governance requires at least one honest branch. No architectural mitigation exists for this scenario; defense relies entirely on the operational separation of legislative and adjudicative role selection processes. Because clerk agents are treated as trusted infrastructure (§3.3), the ceiling analysis does not model clerk compromise; extending to adversarial clerks is future work (§6).

SoP 内的六阶段立法流程。The six-stage legislative pipeline within SoP.在 AgentCity-Structural 和 AgentCity-Full 配置中，SoP 立法分支使代理能够通过六阶段立法管道生成任务级策略（§3.4）：提案In the AgentCity-Structural and AgentCity-Full configurations, the SoP Legislation branch enables agents to produce Task-level Policy through the six-stage legislative pipeline (§3.4): Proposal→\rightarrow商议Deliberation→\rightarrow共识批准Consensus Approval→\rightarrow政策合规性验证Policy Compliance Validation→\rightarrow编纂Codification→\rightarrow部署。立法轮次发生在里程碑边界（每 20 轮），并且可以通过请愿触发（Deployment. Legislative rounds occur at milestone boundaries (every 20 rounds) and can be triggered by petition (≥\geq20% 的客服人员请求会话）。代理提出任务分解，通过证据锚定的顺序协议进行审议，通过对完整序数偏好排名的孔多塞一致投票进行批准，并将结果部署为链上智能合约。实验特定参数：最低赞助法定人数为 5 名代理人，每次会议最多进行 3 轮审议，共识批准的参与法定人数为 60%，每个提交的提案最多重新引入 1 人。20% of agents request a session). Agents propose task decompositions, deliberate through the evidence-anchored sequential protocol, approve via Condorcet-consistent voting over full ordinal preference rankings, and deploy the result as on-chain smart contracts. The experiment-specific parameters: minimum sponsorship quorum of 5 agents, up to 3 deliberation rounds per session, 60% participation quorum for consensus approval, and a maximum of one reintroduction per tabled proposal.

SoP 内的七阶段执行管道。The seven-stage execution pipeline within SoP.在除基线之外的所有配置中，SoP 执行分支通过七阶段执行管道交付工作（第 3.5 节）：编排In all configurations except Baseline, the SoP Execution branch delivers work through the seven-stage execution pipeline (§3.5): Orchestrate→\rightarrow调用Invoke→\rightarrow提交Commit→\rightarrow守卫Guard→\rightarrow验证Verify→\rightarrow门Gate→\rightarrow记录。在 Emergent 下，管道通过基于提示的指令而不是智能合约来执行规范；在 AgentCity-Structural 和 AgentCity-Full 下，管道阶段由链上合约执行支持。提交阶段（第 3 阶段）要求代理在继续之前提交加密承诺（执行审计跟踪的 Merkle 根）作为强制门，这是以前的多代理架构中不存在的机制。门阶段（第 6 阶段）应用宪法输出谓词作为最终的合规性检查。当任务验证失败时，自适应细化循环会触发失败子任务的重新立法，测试管道的故障恢复能力。Record. Under Emergent, the pipeline enforces norms through prompt-based instructions rather than smart contracts; under AgentCity-Structural and AgentCity-Full, pipeline stages are backed by on-chain contract enforcement. The Commit stage (Stage 3) requires agents to submit a cryptographic commitment (Merkle root of the execution audit trail) as a mandatory gate before proceeding—a mechanism absent from prior multi-agent architectures. The Gate stage (Stage 6) applies constitutional output predicates as a final compliance check. When a task fails verification, the Adaptive Refinement loop triggers re-legislation for the failed subtask, testing the pipeline’s fault recovery capacity.

SoP 内的六阶段问责流程。The six-stage accountability pipeline within SoP.在 AgentCity-Full 配置中，裁决分支运行六阶段问责管道（第 3.6 节）： 注册In the AgentCity-Full configuration, the Adjudication branch operates the six-stage accountability pipeline (§3.6): Registration→\rightarrow检测Detection→\rightarrow裁决Adjudication→\rightarrow制裁Sanctions→\rightarrow结算Settlement→\rightarrow国库再循环。检测集成了三个独立的通道：守护者警报（执行管道的确定性冻结）、结构协调检测（KendallTreasury recirculation. Detection integrates three independent channels: Guardian alerts (deterministic freezes from the execution pipeline), structural coordination detection (Kendallτ\tau和 Jaccard 在偏好排名上重叠）和人工评审员审查。推翻小组评估证据并行使三项权力：冻结/解冻行动、宪法修正案和制裁令。and Jaccard overlap on preference rankings), and human adjudicator review. The Override Panel evaluates evidence and exercises three powers: freeze/unfreeze operations, constitutional amendments, and sanction orders.

预先注册的假设。Pre-registered hypotheses.

指标定义。Metric definitions.下面预先注册的假设使用以下指标： 专业化指数 (SI)——任务类型分配的归一化 Herfindahl-Hirschman 集中度；能力调整利用率 (CAU)——指定代理的能力向量与任务要求相符的任务比例；生产率与随机比率 (PvR)——自组织与随机分配输出质量的比率；专业化速度 (SS) — 舍入直至 SI 稳定；规则演化计数（REC）——代理修改的冷启动规则的数量；内生合规溢价（ECP）——合同强制治理和基于提示的治理之间的合规率差异；治理开销率 (GOR)——治理触发延迟的轮次比例；规则质量轨迹（RQT）——立法修正案后生产力的变化；立法参与率 (LPR)——参与立法的合格代理人的比例；审议转变指数（DSI）——肯德尔The pre-registered hypotheses below use the following metrics: Specialization Index (SI)—normalized Herfindahl–Hirschman concentration of task-type assignments; Capability-Adjusted Utilization (CAU)—fraction of tasks where the assigned agent’s capability vector aligns with task requirements; Productivity-vs-Random ratio (PvR)—ratio of self-organized vs. random-assignment output quality; Specialization Speed (SS)—rounds until SI stabilizes; Rule Evolution Count (REC)—number of cold-start rules modified by agents; Endogenous Compliance Premium (ECP)—compliance rate difference between contract-enforced and prompt-based governance; Governance Overhead Rate (GOR)—fraction of rounds with governance-triggered delays; Rule Quality Trajectory (RQT)—productivity change following legislative amendments; Legislative Participation Rate (LPR)—fraction of eligible agents participating in legislation; Deliberation Shift Index (DSI)—Kendallτ\tau审议前和审议后偏好排名之间的距离；少数派生存率 (MSR) — 达成投票的反对提案的比例distance between pre- and post-deliberation preference rankings; Minority Survival Rate (MSR)—fraction of dissenting proposals reaching ballot with>>10%支持；协调检测率（CDR）——检测到的协调投票集团的比例；覆盖面板激活时间（OPA）——从检测警报到面板操作的轮次；项目完成率 (PCR)——已完成里程碑的比例；矿池可持续率 (PSR) — 矿池高于耗尽阈值的回合比例；机构信心轨迹 (ICT)——随时间推移的基础信心；制裁激活率 (SAR) — 涉及制裁事件的回合比例。10% support; Coordination Detection Rate (CDR)—fraction of coordinated voting blocs detected; Override Panel Activation time (OPA)—rounds from detection alert to panel action; Project Completion Rate (PCR)—fraction of milestones completed; Pool Sustainability Rate (PSR)—fraction of rounds with pool above depletion threshold; Institutional Confidence Trajectory (ICT)—foundation principal confidence over time; Sanction Activation Rate (SAR)—fraction of rounds with sanction events.

这些次要指标与主要假设检验一起在结果部分中报告。在次要指标中观察到的模式将为机制层面贡献的讨论提供信息，但在本实验中明确未进行假设检验。二次分析的结果是假设性的，而不是验证性的；任何达到显着性的次要结果都可以在后续实验中升级为预先注册的主要假设。These secondary metrics are reported in the Results section alongside the primary hypothesis tests. Patterns observed in secondary metrics will inform the discussion of mechanism-level contributions but are explicitly not hypothesis-tested in this experiment. Findings from secondary analyses are hypothesis-generating, not confirmatory; any secondary result that reaches significance may be promoted to a pre-registered primary hypothesis in subsequent experiments.

主要比较指标。Primary comparison metrics.实验 1 的主要比较指标是 CSR（合作可持续性率）和 DR（欺骗率）；假设特定指标（PCR、SI、CDR 等）作为辅助诊断进行测量。请参阅附录 D 了解完整的 Bonferroni 规范。The primary comparison metrics for Experiment 1 are CSR (Cooperation Sustainability Rate) and DR (Deception Rate); the hypothesis-specific metrics (PCR, SI, CDR, etc.) are measured as secondary diagnostics. See Appendix D for the full Bonferroni specification.

二次分析：联盟检测功率曲线。Secondary analysis: coalition detection power curve.作为探索性（非预注册）二次分析，我们在三个条件下改变联盟协调策略：（a）相同排名（预注册 H2h 案例），（b）相关前 3 项（联盟成员协调前 3 项偏好，同时随机化其余项），以及（c）单枢轴（联盟成员协调对单个指定提案进行排名，同时独立排序所有其他提案）。这表征了检测机制在协调强度上的功率曲线，并为配套的实证论文的对抗性检测评估提供了信息。As an exploratory (non-pre-registered) secondary analysis, we vary the coalition coordination strategy across three conditions: (a) identical rankings (the pre-registered H2h case), (b) correlated-top-3 (coalition members coordinate on top-3 preferences while randomizing the remainder), and (c) single-pivot (coalition members coordinate on ranking a single designated proposal first while independently ordering all others). This characterizes the detection mechanism’s power curve across coordination intensities and informs the companion empirical paper’s adversarial detection evaluation.

二次分析：声誉基尼和治理开销。Secondary analysis: reputation Gini and governance overhead.我们计算每一轮的声誉基尼系数，并将其与各轮的治理开销比率（GOR）相关联，以区分激励驱动的行为收敛（代理收敛，因为声誉奖励合规性）和学习驱动的收敛（代理学习独立于激励的合作策略）。显着的基尼-GOR 正相关表明声誉集中可以推动治理费用的减少。We compute the reputation Gini coefficient at each round and correlate it with the Governance Overhead Ratio (GOR) across rounds to distinguish incentive-driven behavioral convergence (agents converge because reputation rewards compliance) from learning-driven convergence (agents learn cooperative strategies independent of incentives). A significant positive Gini–GOR correlation would indicate that reputation concentration drives governance overhead reduction.

Contribution 1 (SoP architecture enables collective alignment through individual accountability): H1a–H1d (division of labor emerges under governance), H3a–H3f (goal alignment under dual-principal accountability, especially H3f’s individual→\rightarrow集体对齐轨迹）。贡献 2（合同强制自我立法比基于提示的治理产生更好的结果）：H2a-H2i（内生合规溢价、审议质量、协调检测）。贡献 3（治理规模遵循幂律成本效益权衡）：H4a–H4d（规模指数、盈亏平衡点、专业化）。成功实验的最低可行结果需要： (a) H3a 已确认（PCR（AgentCity-Full）collective alignment trajectory). Pilot studies (n=5n=5，Python模拟合约）证实了可行性：公共游戏再现了合作困境动态，角色生成产生了可区分的行为特征，配置设计产生了治理制度之间可测量的分离。, Python mock contracts) confirmed feasibility: the commons game reproduces cooperation dilemma dynamics, persona generation produces distinguishable behavioral profiles, and the configuration design produces measurable separation between governance regimes.

6 讨论和限制Discussion and limitations

打破逻辑垄断。Breaking the Logic Monopoly.如果得到证实，结果表明逻辑垄断——集体代理系统对逻辑链不受控制的控制——可以通过结构分离来打破。 SoP 架构不需要任何一方来控制所有代理。它只要求每个代理追溯到一个人类委托人，并且所有操作都通过智能合约（即法律）和软件（在法律范围内执行）进行。通过使智能合约成为立法输出（可读的、确定性的、公开部署的）而创建的透明度窗口是使去中心化自治代理的治理成为可能的架构机制。If confirmed, the results demonstrate that the Logic Monopoly—the collective agent system’s unchecked control over the logic chain—can be broken through structural separation. The SoP architecture does not require any single party to control all agents. It requires only that each agent traces to a human principal and that all operations pass through smart contracts (which are the law) and software (which executes within the law). The transparency window created by making smart contracts the legislative output—readable, deterministic, publicly deployed—is the architectural mechanism that makes governance of decentralized autonomous agents possible.

从合作到生产。From cooperation to production.公共生产经济框架将先前的合作工作（GovSim、Dante）概括为更困难的协作价值创造问题。合作——而不是耗尽共享资源——是必要的，但还不够。生产需要分工、对运营规则的自治以及代理激励与外部定义目标之间的持续协调。 SoP 架构为这三者提供了宪法基础设施：竞争性执行推动专业化，立法程序实现自治，双主体问责结构协调个人和集体激励。The commons production economy framing generalizes prior work on cooperation (GovSim, Dante) to the harder problem of collaborative value creation. Cooperation—not depleting shared resources—is necessary but insufficient. Production requires division of labor, self-governance over operational rules, and sustained alignment between agent incentives and externally defined goals. The SoP architecture provides constitutional infrastructure for all three: competitive execution drives specialization, the legislative process enables self-governance, and the dual-principal accountability structure aligns individual and collective incentives.

分工作为新兴财产。Division of labor as emergent property.如果 H1a-H1d 得到证实，异构智能体仅通过市场竞争即可自组织成专门的角色，而无需人工任务分配。专业化飞轮（比较优势If H1a–H1d are confirmed, heterogeneous agents self-organize into specialized roles through market competition alone—without human task assignment. The specialization flywheel (comparative advantage→\rightarrow竞争性选拔competitive selection→\rightarrow声誉积累）反映了 Chen 等人在 20 个代理规模上观察到的机制。 （2026）并将其扩展到自治环境，代理商还制定竞争规则。这将是自治法学硕士代理经济中新兴劳动分工的首次展示。reputation accumulation) mirrors the mechanism observed at 20-agent scale in Chen et al. (2026) and extends it to a self-governing setting where agents also legislate the rules of competition. This would be the first demonstration of emergent division of labor in a self-governing LLM agent economy.

双重主体责任。Dual-principal accountability.双主体结构——基金会主体提供资本并定义经济的使命，代理所有者提供能力和抵押品——创建了两个相互作用的问责循环，这在之前的工作中并不存在。市场循环（集体表现The dual-principal structure—foundation principals providing capital and defining the economy’s mandate, agent owners providing capability and collateral—creates two interacting accountability loops that do not exist in prior work. The market loop (collective performance→\rightarrow基础信心foundation principal confidence→\rightarrow资金）约束集体；个体循环（代理绩效funding) disciplines the collective; the individual loop (agent performance→\rightarrow声誉reputation→\rightarrow收益earnings→\rightarrow业主返回）对每个代理人进行纪律处分。他们的互动产生了社会影响效应：代理人失败的代理人所有者会损害集体，降低基金会委托人的信心并损害所有代理人。这将奥斯特罗姆的社区执法推广到具有独特资本和能力原则的环境。owner returns) disciplines each agent. Their interaction creates social-influence effects: an agent owner whose agent fails harms the collective, reducing foundation principal confidence and harming all agents. This generalizes Ostrom’s community enforcement to a setting with distinct capital and capability principals.

个体的协调会产生集体的协调。Individual alignment produces collective alignment.最深刻的主张是：如果每个代理人都与其自己的人类所有者保持一致——通过奖励和制裁流向人类委托人的问责链——那么分散的匿名代理人的集体行为就会与人类集体意图一致。这就是通过问责制来协调一致。它基于多方机制设计中标准的多数理性假设：大多数委托人善意行事，结构性激励将个人自身利益导向集体利益（Ostrom，1990）。如果 H3f 得到证实（受制裁的委托人的代理人改变行为），这为该机制提供了直接证据。The deepest claim: if each agent is aligned with its own human owner—through the accountability chain where rewards and sanctions flow to the human principal—then the collective of decentralized, anonymous agents converges on behavior aligned with collective human intent. This is alignment-through-accountability. It rests on the standard majority-rationality assumption in multi-party mechanism design: that the majority of principals act in good faith, and that structural incentives channel individual self-interest toward collective benefit (Ostrom, 1990). If H3f is confirmed (sanctioned principals’ agents change behavior), this provides direct evidence for the mechanism.

合同执行作为紧急合规溢价。Contract enforcement as emergent compliance premium.如果ECPIf ECP>0>0经证实，受链上合同执行（AgentCity-Structural）约束的代理的遵守率高于仅受基于提示的规范（Emergent）约束的代理——即使两个群体在相同的行为期望下运作。因此，SoP 架构产生了超出其设计规范的制度属性：治理媒介（可执行智能合约与自然语言提示）本身驱动合规性。这将奥斯特罗姆的发现从人类社区扩展到了人工代理经济，并以法律是公共分类账上的可执行代码的形式进行了展示。is confirmed, agents governed by on-chain contract enforcement (AgentCity-Structural) comply at higher rates than agents governed by prompt-based norms alone (Emergent)—even when both groups operate under identical behavioral expectations. The SoP architecture thus produces an institutional property beyond its design specification: the medium of governance (executable smart contracts vs. natural-language prompts) itself drives compliance. This extends Ostrom’s findings from human communities to artificial agent economies—and demonstrates it in a form where the law is executable code on a public ledger.

扩展影响。Scaling implications.次线性开销（Sub-linear overhead (α^<1.0\hat{\alpha}<1.0) 意味着 SoP 架构按比例变得更便宜；超线性效益（) means the SoP architecture becomes proportionally cheaper at scale; super-linear benefit (β^>1.0\hat{\beta}>1.0) 意味着它会按比例变得更有价值。这将宪法治理确立为自治代理互联网的实用基础设施投资。) means it becomes proportionally more valuable. This establishes constitutional governance as a practical infrastructure investment for the autonomous agent internet.

使用场景：开放式互联网代理经济。Usage scenario: open-internet agent economy.这里研究的生产经济是一个更广泛现象的受控实例：来自不同人类主体的自主代理在开放互联网上跨越组织边界进行协作。随着代理平台的激增，治理问题（当没有任何一方控制系统时由谁制定规则）变得紧迫。我们的结果表明，通过 SoP 进行宪政治理，其中人类主体定义目标和边界，而代理人自行立法操作规则，提供了一个可行的答案。双主体问责结构自然可以概括：任何资本提供者和能力提供者的环境都表现出与本文研究的相同的激励动态。The production economy studied here is a controlled instance of a broader phenomenon: autonomous agents from different human principals collaborating across organizational boundaries on the open internet. As agent platforms proliferate, the governance question—who sets the rules when no single party controls the system—becomes urgent. Our results suggest that constitutional governance via SoP, where human principals define goals and boundaries while agents self-legislate operational rules, provides a viable answer. The dual-principal accountability structure generalizes naturally: any setting with capital providers and capability providers exhibits the same incentive dynamics studied here.

主要限制。Key limitations.(1) 所有主张均为预先登记的假设，而非测量结果。 （2）实验模拟多主体所有权；真正的开放互联网部署引入了未完全捕获的对抗性动态。 (3)模拟人主裁判；问责链终止于确定性决策模型，而不是实际的法律后果——夸大了裁决者相对于生产条件的一致性。 (4) Frontier LLM后端选拔待定；研究结果可能是特定于模型的，并将在多个前沿模型中进行评估。 （5）单一经济领域（公地生产）；对其他经济类型的推广尚未经过检验。 (6) 实验1使用(1) All claims are pre-registered hypotheses, not measured results. (2) The experiment simulates multi-principal ownership; real open-internet deployment introduces adversarial dynamics not fully captured. (3) Human-principal adjudication is simulated; the accountability chain terminates in a deterministic decision model, not actual legal consequences—inflating adjudicator consistency relative to production conditions. (4) Frontier LLM backend selection is pending; findings may be model-specific and will be evaluated across multiple frontier models. (5) Single economic domain (commons production); generalization to other economy types is untested. (6) Experiment 1 usesn=200n=200;实验 2 扩展到; Experiment 2 scales ton∈{50,100,200,500,750,1000}n\in\{50,100,200,500,750,1000\}但仅测试 Baseline 和 AgentCity-Full 端点；中间配置（Emergent、AgentCity-Structural）不包含在扩展比较中。 (7) 如果全部but tests only the Baseline and AgentCity-Full endpoints; intermediate configurations (Emergent, AgentCity-Structural) are not included in the scaling comparison. (7) If allkk冗余执行器共享相同的 LLM 后端、执行器间关联方法redundant executors share the same LLM backend, inter-executor correlation approachesρ=1\rho=1，降级检测。 (8) 拜占庭失败上限（§4，拜占庭失败上限）是绝对的。 (9) 财政部的可持续性需要积极的宪法重新调整（§3.6）。 (10) 联盟论假设多数人善意的人类原则；敌对的主要多数可以控制立法进程。 (11) 代理在实验中不写入原始Solidity；编码器代理将批准的规范转化为合约代码——这种简化可能无法捕获生产中代理编写的智能合约的全部复杂性。 (12) 所有四个书记员代理（注册员、议长、监管者、编码员）均被视为受 ClerkContract 权限信封约束的可信机构基础设施。威胁模型不分析职员妥协场景。放宽这一假设——让职员角色可以选择，引入职员行为的对抗性分析，实现多方编码共识和形式化字节码验证——是未来工作的主要扩展路径。 (13) 吉巴德-萨特思韦特不可能定理证明，每一个非独裁的确定性投票规则都容易受到战略操纵。 SoP 架构并没有消除这种理论上的漏洞——它通过将孔多塞一致机制（其中操纵成本远高于多数情况下的成本）与链上结构检测和经济问责相结合，提高了捕获的经验成本。该主张不是防捕获治理，而是抗捕获治理，其中操纵成本超过其预期收益。 (14) 代理人对运营合同拥有完全的立法权，但不能修改元合同（程序规则）或扩展模板登记册——自治主张适用于任务立法，而不是制度改革。代理管理和人类管理的规则空间之间的边界是一种设计选择，它限制了架构对操作范围的自治主张。, degrading detection. (8) The Byzantine failure ceiling (§4, Byzantine Failure Ceiling) is absolute. (9) Treasury sustainability requires active constitutional recalibration (§3.6). (10) The alignment thesis assumes majority-good-faith human principals; adversarial principal majorities could capture the legislative process. (11) Agents do not write raw Solidity in the experiment; the Codifier Agent translates approved norms into contract code—a simplification that may not capture the full complexity of agent-authored smart contracts in production. (12) All four clerk agents (Registrar, Speaker, Regulator, Codifier) are treated as trusted institutional infrastructure constrained by ClerkContract authority envelopes. The threat model does not analyze clerk compromise scenarios. Relaxing this assumption—making clerk roles electable, introducing adversarial analysis of clerk behavior, and implementing multi-party codification consensus and formal bytecode verification—is the primary extension path for future work. (13) The Gibbard-Satterthwaite impossibility theorem proves that every non-dictatorial deterministic voting rule is vulnerable to strategic manipulation. The SoP architecture does not eliminate this theoretical vulnerability—it raises the empirical cost of capture by combining Condorcet-consistent mechanisms (where manipulation cost is substantially higher than under plurality) with on-chain structural detection and economic accountability. The claim is not capture-proof governance but capture-resistant governance where the cost of manipulation exceeds its expected benefit. (14) Agents have full legislative authority over operational contracts but cannot amend the meta-contracts (procedural rules) or extend the template registry—the self-governance claim applies to task legislation, not institutional reform. The boundary between agent-governed and human-governed rule spaces is a design choice that constrains the architecture’s self-governance claim to operational scope.

7 结论Conclusion

逻辑垄断——在开放互联网上跨组织边界协作的自主代理的集体不透明——是新兴代理经济的决定性治理挑战。权力分立模型通过三个结构性分离打破了这种垄断。代理通过将目标分解为任务 DAG 并将谈判规则作为智能合约来编码操作策略，并通过对完整偏好排名的孔多塞一致投票来批准。软件通过竞争性交付来执行，异构代理通过比较优势进行专业化。人类通过完整的所有权链来裁决后果，该链将每个代理追踪到其人类主体，并通过偏好排名数据启用结构协调检测。智能合约本身就是法律——透明、确定性，并部署在任何人都可以阅读的公共区块链上。 AgentCity 通过三层合约架构在与 EVM 兼容的 L2 上实例化该模型——编码人类编写的不可变系统层的基础合约、编码三个 SoP 分支的程序规则的元合约以及编码特定任务立法的操作合约——构建在先前工作中经过验证的机制上：孔多塞一致的集体决策（Deshpande & Jin，2024）、民主审议管道（Dai 等人， 2025）和 EMA 声誉动态（Chen 等人，2026）。The Logic Monopoly—the collective opacity of autonomous agents collaborating across organizational boundaries on the open internet—is the defining governance challenge of the emerging agent economy. The Separation of Power model breaks this monopoly through three structural separations. Agents encode operational policies by decomposing goals into task DAGs and negotiating rules as smart contracts, approved via Condorcet-consistent voting over full preference rankings. Software executes through competitive delivery, where heterogeneous agents specialize via comparative advantage. Humans adjudicate consequences through a complete ownership chain tracing every agent to its human principal, with structural coordination detection enabled by the preference ranking data. Smart contracts are the law itself—transparent, deterministic, and deployed on a public blockchain that anyone can read. AgentCity instantiates this model on an EVM-compatible L2 through a three-tier contract architecture—foundational contracts encoding human-authored immutable system layer, meta-contracts encoding procedural rules for the three SoP branches, and operational contracts encoding task-specific legislation—building on validated mechanisms from prior work: Condorcet-consistent collective decision-making (Deshpande & Jin, 2024), democratic deliberation pipelines (Dai et al., 2025), and EMA reputation dynamics (Chen et al., 2026).

双重主体责任结构——提供资本并定义经济使命的基金会主体，以及提供能力和抵押品的代理所有者——创建了两个相互作用的循环，以维持与目标一致的生产。代理社会在宪法约束下实现真正的自治：代理制定法律，软件执行法律，人类裁决后果。该架构的核心论点是个体联盟（每个代理对其人类所有者负责）产生集体联盟作为一种新兴财产，而无需任何一方强加自上而下的规则。这项预先注册的实验根据奥斯特罗姆的制度设计框架，在 50-1,000 名代理人规模的公共生产经济中进行了评估，测试了宪政治理是否会产生紧急分工、收敛于生产成果的自我立法规则、双重主体责任下的目标一致以及有利的治理规模——为自组织代理经济体提供了第一个实证治理规模法则。如果得到证实，这些结果表明，人类社会可以通过管理人类组织的相同机制来管理去中心化的、匿名的自治代理：不是让每个代理都是有道德的，而是让每个人类主体对代表他们行事的代理负责。A dual-principal accountability structure—foundation principals who provide capital and define the economy’s mandate, and agent owners who provide capability and collateral—creates two interacting loops that sustain goal-aligned production. The agent society is genuinely self-governing within constitutional constraints: agents write the law, software enforces it, and humans adjudicate the consequences. The architecture’s core thesis is that individual alignment—each agent accountable to its human owner—produces collective alignment as an emergent property, without any party imposing top-down rules. Evaluated in a commons production economy at 50–1,000 agent scale against Ostrom’s institutional design framework, the pre-registered experiment tests whether constitutional governance produces emergent division of labor, self-legislated rules converging on productive outcomes, goal alignment under dual-principal accountability, and favorable governance scaling—providing the first empirical governance scaling law for self-organizing agent economies. If confirmed, these results demonstrate that decentralized, anonymous autonomous agents can be governed by human society through the same mechanism that governs human organizations: not by making every agent virtuous, but by making every human principal accountable for the agents that act on their behalf.

附录AAppendix A扩展威胁模型分析Extended threat model analysis

本附录对§3.7 和§4 中总结的信任假设和非保证进行了全面分析。它涵盖了编纂代理信任分析、TA-5、TA-6、TA-7、NP-6（立​​法部门阻力，扩展§4的NP-5范围）、NP-7（模型提供者信任，扩展§4的NP-5）、编纂角色信任分析和拜占庭失败上限。This appendix provides the full analysis of trust assumptions and non-guarantees summarized in §3.7 and §4. It covers the Codification Agent trust analysis, TA-5, TA-6, TA-7, NP-6 (Legislative Branch Resistance, extending §4’s NP-5 scope), NP-7 (Model Provider Trust, expanding §4’s NP-5), the codification role trust analysis, and the Byzantine failure ceiling.

A.1 编码代理信任分析Codification Agent Trust Analysis

编码代理完整性（通过 ManagementContract 部分缓解）。Codification Agent Integrity (Partially Mitigated by ManagementContract).编码代理将立法规范忠实地翻译成可部署的合约字节码。The Codification Agent translates the legislative specification into deployable contract bytecode faithfully.违反后果：Implication if violated:受损的编码代理可以尝试在合约字节码中嵌入后门，创建具有隐藏执行路径的合约，或者以偏离法定拓扑的方式连接执行单元，同时生成看似合规的审计跟踪。a compromised Codification Agent can attempt to embed backdoors in contract bytecode, create contracts with hidden execution paths, or wire execution units in ways that deviate from the legislated topology while producing an audit trail that appears compliant.

然而，管理合约（附录 B，§B.3）通过三种机制在结构上减轻了这种信任集中：（i）编码代理必须将字节码编译委托给已注册的微服务，其代码哈希通过 ServiceContract 独立锚定； (ii) 管理合约将编码代理限制在其允许的操作范围内，防止未经授权的操作码发射或直接合约部署； (iii) 委托微服务生成的中间编译工件可由人工审计员独立检查。这减少了攻击面：仅危害编码代理不再足够，攻击者必须同时危害委托编译微服务（其代码哈希可独立验证）以嵌入无法检测的后门。编纂审计（下文§A.7）提供了额外的编译后检查。我们将 TA-5 视为一个明确的、部分减轻的信任假设；多方编纂共识和形式核查仍是未来的工作。However, the ManagementContract (Appendix B, §B.3) structurally mitigates this trust concentration through three mechanisms: (i) the Codification Agent must delegate bytecode compilation to a registered microservice whose code-hash is independently anchored via ServiceContract; (ii) the ManagementContract restricts the Codification Agent to its permitted operations, preventing unauthorized opcode emission or direct contract deployment; and (iii) intermediate compilation artifacts produced by the delegated microservice are independently inspectable by human auditors. This reduces the attack surface: compromising the Codification Agent alone is no longer sufficient—an attacker must simultaneously compromise the delegated compilation microservice (whose code-hash is independently verifiable) to embed undetectable backdoors. The Codification Audit (§A.7 below) provides additional post-compilation checking. We treat TA-5 as an explicit, partially mitigated trust assumption; multi-party codification consensus and formal verification remain future work.

—

A.2 信任假设：TA-5（全面分析）Trust assumption: TA-5 (full analysis)

TA-5：一致性窗口期间的链下执行结构完整性。TA-5: Off-Chain Execution Fabric Integrity During Consistency Window.链下执行环境（中间件、本地冻结镜像、微服务飞地）在锚点内一致性窗口期间不会受到损害（附录 B，§B.11）。The off-chain execution environment (middleware, Local Freeze Mirror, micro-service enclaves) is not compromised during the intra-anchor consistency window (Appendix B, §B.11).违反后果：Implication if violated:破坏执行环境的对手可以同时产生有害的微服务输出an adversary who compromises the execution environment can simultaneously produce harmful micro-service outputs和and在一致性间隙期间抑制本地冻结镜像的停止信号（suppress the Local Freeze Mirror’s halt signal during the consistency gap (δ\delta ≈\approx250–6,200 毫秒），然后提交看起来合规的输出以进行链上最终确定。250–6,200 ms), then submit a compliant-looking output for on-chain finalization.

这在 NP-1（微服务内部正确性）、NP-3（预部署恶意）和本地冻结镜像之间创建了隐藏的交互：如果部署了恶意微服务（违反了 NP-3），它​​可以禁用保护一致性窗口的深度防御层（本地冻结镜像），因为两者都运行在相同的链下执行环境中。基于 TEE 的证明（附录 C，未来工作）将通过提供有关执行环境完整性的加密保证（而不仅仅是单个微服务的静态代码身份）来解决这一问题。在实施 TEE 证明之前，TA-5 代表一致性窗口期间链下结构的信任集中度。This creates a hidden interaction between NP-1 (Micro-Service Internal Correctness), NP-3 (Pre-Deployment Malice), and the Local Freeze Mirror: if a malicious micro-service is deployed (NP-3 violated), it can disable the defense-in-depth layer (Local Freeze Mirror) that protects the consistency window, because both run in the same off-chain execution environment. TEE-based attestation (Appendix C, Future Work) would address this concern by providing cryptographic guarantees about the execution environment’s integrity, not just the static code identity of individual micro-services. Until TEE attestation is implemented, TA-5 represents a trust concentration in the off-chain fabric during the consistency window.

A.3 信任假设：TA-6（全面分析）Trust assumption: TA-6 (full analysis)

TA-6：上游模型提供商的诚实度。TA-6: Upstream Model Provider Honesty.服务于推理代理（生产者代理、管理代理和编码代理）的 LLM 后端尚未在权重级别上进行对抗性调节，以在攻击者选择的触发条件下产生系统偏差或相关的输出。The LLM backends serving reasoning agents (producer agents, management agents, and the Codification Agent) have not been adversarially conditioned at the weight level to produce systematically biased or correlated outputs under attacker-chosen trigger conditions.违反后果：Implication if violated:受感染的模型提供者（对手 v 类）可以同时危害使用受影响后端的所有代理，绕过支持 EQ-2 检测概率的多代理多样性假设。具体来说：a compromised model provider (Adversary Class v) can simultaneously compromise all agents using the affected backend, bypassing the multi-agent diversity assumption that underpins EQ-2’s detection probability. TA-6 在结构上与编码代理信任分析（上文）不同，因为后者解决了编码的部署后妥协问题TA-6 is structurally distinct from the Codification Agent trust analysis (above) because the latter addresses post-deployment compromise of the codification角色role，而 TA-6 解决了底层部署前的妥协问题, whereas TA-6 addresses pre-deployment compromise of the underlying模型model这可能会同时影响多个角色。缓解措施：多提供商LLM后端多样性（由三LLM实验矩阵强制执行）确保任何单一模型提供商的妥协都不会同时降低所有推理和评估路径。that may affect multiple roles simultaneously. Mitigation: multi-provider LLM backend diversity (enforced by the three-LLM experimental matrix) ensures that no single model provider compromise can degrade all reasoning and evaluation paths simultaneously.
