A.4 信任假设：TA-7（全面分析）Trust assumption: TA-7 (full analysis)

TA-7：双评分器嵌入提供商独立性。TA-7: Dual-Scorer Embedding Provider Independence.偏差评分器多样性要求（§3.5，Guardian 模块；附录 B，§B.11）假设用于行为异常检测的两个独立嵌入提供程序——text-embedding-3-large (OpenAI) 和 Voyage AI 的 voyage-3——具有独立的故障模式。具体来说：影响一个提供商嵌入空间的系统错误、对抗性操纵或供应链妥协不会同时影响另一个提供商。The deviation scorer diversity requirement (§3.5, Guardian module; Appendix B, §B.11) assumes that the two independent embedding providers used for behavioral anomaly detection—text-embedding-3-large (OpenAI) and Voyage AI’s voyage-3—have independent failure modes. Specifically: a systematic error, adversarial manipulation, or supply-chain compromise affecting one provider’s embedding space does not simultaneously affect the other.

违反后果：Implication if violated:如果两个提供者共享上游依赖性（例如，在同一语料库上进行训练，或共享推理基础设施妥协），则双评分者协议要求提供的保护比独立失败模型假设的要弱——单个对抗性扰动可以同时逃避两个评分者，从而允许异常代理行为通过卫报的2if both providers share an upstream dependency (e.g., training on the same corpus, or a shared inference infrastructure compromise), the dual-scorer agreement requirement provides weaker protection than the independent-failure model assumes—a single adversarial perturbation could evade both scorers simultaneously, allowing anomalous agent behavior to pass the Guardian’s 2σ\sigma阈值而不触发确定性冻结。 TA-7 在结构上与 TA-6（上游模型提供商诚实）不同：TA-6 解决了 LLM 推理后端的妥协问题，而 TA-7 解决了嵌入评估后端的妥协问题。缓解措施：通过对保留的异常基准进行跨提供商相关性分析，对嵌入提供商独立性进行实证部署验证；定期轮换嵌入提供商以限制供应链风险。threshold without triggering a Deterministic Freeze. TA-7 is structurally distinct from TA-6 (Upstream Model Provider Honesty): TA-6 addresses compromise of the LLM reasoning backends, whereas TA-7 addresses compromise of the embedding evaluation backends. Mitigation: empirical deployment validation of embedding provider independence through cross-provider correlation analysis on held-out anomaly benchmarks; periodic rotation of embedding providers to limit supply-chain exposure.

—

A.5 非保证：NP-6（全面分析）Non-guarantee: NP-6 (full analysis)

NP-6：A_leg + A_reg_agent 勾结下的立法部门抵抗。NP-6: Legislative Branch Resistance Under A_leg + A_reg_agent Collusion.当 A_leg 和 A_reg_agent 均由单个对手控制时（违反了双重共同授权分离），SoP 架构并不能保证立法部门能够抵御恶意合约规范。 MSG_TYPE_7 的双重共同授权要求可防止任一代理单独单方面最终确定，但无法阻止两者之间的协调共谋。妥协这两个角色的对手可以生成符合程序的立法记录（所有 MSG_TYPE_1 到 MSG_TYPE_7 消息格式良好且有效签名），同时在最终合同规范中编码对抗性连线、虚假惩罚参数或恶意任务分配。The SoP architecture does not guarantee that the legislative branch resists malicious contract specification when both A_leg and A_reg_agent are controlled by a single adversary (dual co-authorization separation violated). The dual co-authorization requirement for MSG_TYPE_7 prevents unilateral finalization by either agent individually but provides no resistance against coordinated collusion between the two. An adversary who compromises both roles can produce a procedurally compliant legislative record (all MSG_TYPE_1 through MSG_TYPE_7 messages well-formed and validly signed) while encoding adversarial wiring, false penalty parameters, or malicious task assignments in the finalized contract specification.

编纂审计的 M1-M4 消除检查（下面的§A.7）提供了部分缓解措施：即使在协调的 A_leg + A_reg_agent 共谋下，未通过字节码审计谓词的消息在到达执行分支之前也会被拒绝。因此，NP-6 下的残余攻击面仅限于通过编纂审计结构验证的 M5-M8 操作。检测到此攻击需要人工裁决员在执行授权之前审查立法记录，这是系统中存在的一项功能（规则中心显示完整的 MSG_TYPE 跟踪以供裁决员检查），但依赖于 NP-2（人工裁决员能力和诚信）。这种非担保被正式记录为 NP-6（本附录），并将在未来的工作中通过多方立法共识予以解决（附录 C）。The Codification Audit’s M1–M4 elimination checks (§A.7 below) provide partial mitigation: even under coordinated A_leg + A_reg_agent collusion, messages that fail bytecode audit predicates are rejected before reaching the execution branch. The residual attack surface under NP-6 is therefore limited to M5–M8 manipulations that pass the Codification Audit’s structural validation. Detection of this attack requires human adjudicator review of the legislative record before execution authorization—a capability present in the system (the Rules Hub surfaces the full MSG_TYPE trace for adjudicator inspection) but dependent on NP-2 (Human Adjudicator Competence and Good Faith). This non-guarantee is formally tracked as NP-6 (this appendix) and will be addressed by multi-party legislative consensus in future work (Appendix C).

—

A.6 非保证：NP-7（全面分析）Non-guarantee: NP-7 (full analysis)

NP-7：模型提供商信任。NP-7: Model Provider Trust.该架构不保证底层 LLM 后端不受对抗性条件影响（违反 TA-6）。如果所有推理代理共享单个受损后端，则受损的上游模型提供者（对手 v 级）可能会同时降低检测概率、偏差记分器校准和编码完整性。多提供商 LLM 后端多样性要求减轻了但并没有消除这种风险：影响实验矩阵中三个后端之一的提供商妥协会降低大约三分之一的评估者多样性，从而减少The architecture does not guarantee that the underlying LLM backends are free from adversarial conditioning (TA-6 violated). A compromised upstream model provider (Adversary Class v) can degrade detection probability, deviation scorer calibration, and codification integrity simultaneously if all reasoning agents share a single compromised backend. The multi-provider LLM backend diversity requirement mitigates but does not eliminate this risk: a provider compromise affecting one of the three backends in the experimental matrix degrades approximately one-third of evaluator diversity, reducingPe​f​fP_{eff}的金额由by an amount bounded by theρ\rho- 表中敏感性分析-sensitivity analysis in Table13。完全消除这种风险需要提供者级别的模型完整性证明（例如，加密模型权重来源）——目前任何主要法学硕士提供者都无法提供这一功能。. Full elimination of this risk would require provider-level attestation of model integrity (e.g., cryptographic model weight provenance)—a capability not currently available from any major LLM provider.

—

A.7 编纂作用：信任集中和缓解措施（完整§3.4）The codification role: trust concentration and mitigations (full §3.4)

编码角色（第 3.4 节）在 SoP 架构中占据着独特的敏感位置。该角色将立法结果（具有资源绑定和惩罚参数的高级任务 DAG）转换为可部署的合约字节码。如果担任此角色的代理受到损害，它可以在合约字节码中嵌入后门，创建看似实现立法规范但包含隐藏执行路径的合约，或者以偏离协商拓扑的方式连接执行单元，同时生成看似合规的审计跟踪。The Codification role (§3.4) occupies a uniquely sensitive position in the SoP architecture. This role translates the legislative outcome—a high-level task DAG with resource bindings and penalty parameters—into deployable contract bytecode. If the agent occupying this role is compromised, it can embed backdoors in the contract bytecode, create contracts that appear to implement the legislative specification but contain hidden execution paths, or wire execution units in ways that deviate from the negotiated topology while producing an audit trail that appears compliant.

这种信任集中在架构上与 SoP 模型消除单点控制的目标存在冲突。我们承认这是当前的限制，并按照实施复杂性的顺序提出以下缓解措施：This trust concentration is architecturally in tension with the SoP model’s goal of eliminating single points of control. We acknowledge it as a current limitation and propose the following mitigations, in order of implementation complexity:

(a) 多方编纂共识。(a) Multi-Party Codification Consensus.多个独立的编码实例（用不同的模型权重、提示或实现实例化）独立地将相同的立法规范转换为合约字节码。仅当达到共识阈值（例如，3 个实例中的 2 个实例生成相同的字节码）时，部署才会继续。在部署任何合同之前，分歧会触发自动升级到裁决审查。Multiple independent Codification instances—instantiated with different model weights, prompts, or implementations—independently translate the same legislative specification into contract bytecode. Deployment proceeds only when a consensus threshold (e.g., 2-of-3 instances produce identical bytecode) is reached. Divergence triggers automatic escalation to Adjudication review before any contract is deployed.(b) 编纂结果的正式验证。(b) Formal Verification of Codification Output.编纂的合同根据从立法输出中得出的机器可读规范进行正式验证。验证失败会阻止部署。这种方法提供了强有力的保证，但要求立法规范以易于形式验证的形式表达——这一约束限制了具有可验证行为属性的合同的适用性。The codified contract is formally verified against a machine-readable specification derived from the legislative output. Verification failure blocks deployment. This approach provides strong guarantees but requires that the legislative specification be expressed in a form amenable to formal verification—a constraint that limits applicability to contracts with verifiable behavioral properties.(c) 裁决审查门。(c) Adjudication Review Gate.所有编纂的合同在部署前都会提交给裁决部门进行人工审查。这增加了延迟，但通过在编码角色的输出和合约部署之间插入人工判断来缩小信任差距。对于高风险任务，这个门应该是强制性的。All codified contracts are submitted to the Adjudication branch for human review before deployment. This adds latency but closes the trust gap by interposing human judgment between the Codification role’s output and contract deployment. For high-stakes missions, this gate should be mandatory.

缓解措施 (c) 作为强制性措施实施Mitigation (c) is implemented as a mandatory编纂审计Codification Audit：编码代理编译的合约规范 (MSG_TYPE_6) 在部署授权 (MSG_TYPE_7) 之前提交给覆盖面板。编纂审计的运作方式如下：: the Codification Agent’s compiled contract specification (MSG_TYPE_6) is submitted to the Override Panel before deployment authorization (MSG_TYPE_7). The Codification Audit operates as follows:

// 调用Invoked 之间between MSG_TYPE_6 (编纂codification) 和and MSG_TYPE_7 (批准approval)

编码角色信任集中度现在通过两层在结构上得到缓解：管理合同委托授权（附录 B，§B.3），它要求编码代理通过具有独立锚定代码哈希的注册微服务来编译字节码，以及编码审计（缓解 (c)，已实施）。委托授权意味着即使是受损的编码代理也无法直接生成字节码，它必须调用委托的编译微服务，其输出是可独立验证的。这已正式记录在编纂代理信任分析（附录 A）中。多方编纂共识（缓解措施 (a)）和形式验证（缓解措施 (b)）仍是未来的工作（附录 C）。我们注意到，MSG_TYPE_7（立法机构 + 监管机构）的联合签名者现在授权部署已通过编纂审计的结构一致性和对齐检查的规范，这是对盲目规范批准的有意义的改进，尽管不等同于完整的字节码到规范的形式验证。The Codification role trust concentration is now structurally mitigated through two layers: the ManagementContract delegation mandate (Appendix B, §B.3), which requires the Codification Agent to compile bytecode through a registered microservice with an independently anchored code-hash, and the Codification Audit (mitigation (c), implemented). The delegation mandate means that even a compromised Codification Agent cannot produce bytecode directly—it must invoke the delegated compilation microservice, whose output is independently verifiable. This is formally documented in the Codification Agent Trust Analysis (Appendix A). Multi-party codification consensus (mitigation (a)) and formal verification (mitigation (b)) remain future work (Appendix C). We note that the co-signers of MSG_TYPE_7 (Legislative + Regulatory Agents) now authorize deployment of a specification that has passed the Codification Audit’s structural conformance and alignment checks—a meaningful improvement over blind spec approval, though not equivalent to full bytecode-to-spec formal verification.

A.8 拜占庭失败上限：扩展讨论Byzantine failure ceiling: extended discussion

如果同时违反 NP-6（立法共同授权完整性）和 NP-2（人类裁决者能力和诚信），即对手控制了立法共同授权角色If NP-6 (legislative co-authorization integrity) and NP-2 (human adjudicator competence and good faith) are simultaneously violated—i.e., the adversary controls both legislative co-authorization roles和and破坏了人类裁决者池——该架构不提供剩余的结构防御。所有三个 SoP 分支都受到损害：立法机构产生对抗性合约，执行分支强制执行，而裁决分支未能干预。这代表了 SoP 设计的拜占庭失败上限：宪政治理需要至少一个诚实的分支来提供有意义的安全保证。对于这种情况，不存在架构缓解措施；辩护完全依赖于立法和审判角色的运作分离以及审判员选择过程的完整性（附录 B，§B.12）。corrupts the human adjudicator pool—the architecture provides no residual structural defense. All three SoP branches are compromised: the legislature produces adversarial contracts, the execution branch enforces them, and the adjudication branch fails to intervene. This represents the Byzantine failure ceiling of the SoP design: constitutional governance requires at least one honest branch to provide meaningful security guarantees. No architectural mitigation exists for this scenario; defense relies entirely on the operational separation of legislative and adjudicative roles and the integrity of the adjudicator selection process (Appendix B, §B.12).

这种复合失败模式激发了未来工作的几个方向：（i）多方拜占庭容错立法共识（附录C），它增加了对手为了控制立法结果而必须妥协的角色数量； (ii) 分散裁决机制，将裁决权分配给更大的、独立选择的主体； (iii) 对在每个 SoP 分支机构提供有意义的保证所需的最低诚实方假设进行正式分析。This compound failure mode motivates several directions in future work: (i) multi-party Byzantine fault-tolerant legislative consensus (Appendix C), which raises the number of roles an adversary must compromise to control the legislative outcome; (ii) decentralized adjudication mechanisms that distribute adjudicative authority across a larger, independently selected principal set; and (iii) formal analysis of the minimum honest-party assumptions required to provide meaningful guarantees at each SoP branch.

附录BAppendix B扩展系统设计Extended system design

本附录提供了 AgentCity 系统设计架构（第 3 节）的扩展详细信息，包括经济层、代币流、信誉机制和三个 SoP 分支实现。This appendix provides extended details for the AgentCity system design architecture (§3), including the economic layer, token flows, reputation mechanics, and the three SoP branch implementations.

B.1 AgentCity：系统设计AgentCity: System Design

代理城市AgentCity是主论文第 3 节中指定的抽象权力分离模型的具体实例。第 3 节在正式的、独立于实现的级别上指定了 SoP 模型——定义三个分支、它们的权限、作为机构锚的智能合约以及它们的三角监督拓扑——本节描述了 AgentCity 如何在可部署系统中实现该模型。映射是直接的：立法分支被实现为五节点 LangGraph 工作流程；执行分支被实现为四种链上智能合约类型（CollaborationContract 包含六个子模块）的合约网格，锚定合约执行的微服务结构；裁决分支实现为统一的人机界面，包括规则中心、日志中心、执行仪表板和覆盖面板。该架构与区块链无关，并且可移植到任何与 EVM 兼容的结算层；合约旨在部署在任何此类链上。本节激发了驱动设计的实施差距（§B.2），提出了作为可审计布线层的完整智能合约架构（§B.3），描述了包括代理注册和多方立法协商的立法模块（§B.10），包括链上/链下一致性协议（§B.11）的执行基础设施，以及裁决接口（§B.12）。is the concrete instantiation of the abstract Separation of Power model specified in §3 of the main paper. Where §3 specifies the SoP model at a formal, implementation-independent level—defining the three branches, their authorities, the smart contract as institutional anchor, and their triangular oversight topology—this section describes how AgentCity realizes that model in a deployable system. The mapping is direct: the Legislation branch is implemented as a five-node LangGraph workflow; the Execution branch is implemented as a contract mesh of four on-chain smart contract types (with the CollaborationContract encompassing six sub-modules) anchoring a fabric of contract-enforced micro-services; and the Adjudication branch is implemented as a unified human interface comprising a Rules Hub, Logging Hub, Execution Dashboard, and Override Panel. The architecture is blockchain-agnostic and portable to any EVM-compatible settlement layer; contracts are designed for deployment on any such chain. This section motivates the Implementation Gap that drives the design (§B.2), presents the complete smart contract architecture as the auditable wiring layer (§B.3), describes the Legislation Module including agent registration and multi-party legislative negotiation (§B.10), the Execution Infrastructure including the on-chain/off-chain consistency protocol (§B.11), and the Adjudication Interface (§B.12).

智能合约部署细节和 L2 主网地址已计划在配套的实证论文中。Smart contract deployment details and the L2 mainnet addresses are planned for the companion empirical paper.

B.2 实施差距The Implementation Gap

在当前的多代理系统中，代理已经自主构建软件（生成代码、部署工具、编写 API 调用）来执行分配的工作。然而，由此产生的软件工件及其相互依赖性对于代理的人类主体来说基本上是不透明的。代理可能会生成数十个脚本，通过临时 API 调用将它们链接起来，并将它们连接到功能管道中，但人类所有者无法系统地了解构建的内容、组件的连接方式或执行拓扑是否安全。我们将其称为In current multi-agent systems, agents already build software autonomously—generating code, deploying tools, composing API calls—to carry out their assigned work. The resulting software artifacts and their interdependencies are, however, largely opaque to the agent’s human principal. An agent may produce dozens of scripts, chain them through ad-hoc API invocations, and wire them into a functioning pipeline, yet the human owner has no systematic visibility into what was built, how components are connected, or whether the execution topology is safe. We term this the实施差距Implementation Gap：软件基础设施代理产生的结构与委托人检查它的能力之间的结构脱节。: the structural disconnect between the software infrastructure agents produce and the human principal’s ability to inspect it.

我们将这种直觉形式化。让We formalize this intuition. Let the接线图wiring graphW = (V, E) 表示执行拓扑，其中 V 是已部署的微服务的集合，E 是它们之间的绑定的集合（API 调用、数据流、依赖边）。对于人类委托人 h，定义W = (V, E) represent the execution topology, where V is the set of deployed micro-services and E is the set of bindings between them (API calls, data flows, dependency edges). For a human principal h, define可检验性inspectability为 I_h(W) = |E_hv̂isible| / |E|——h 可以观察到的结合分数。主体 h 的实现差距为 G_h = 1 – I_h(W)。as I_h(W) = |E_hv̂isible| / |E|—the fraction of bindings that h can observe. The Implementation Gap for principal h is then G_h = 1 – I_h(W).

在具有少量代理的单一组织设置中，I_hIn single-organization settings with a small number of agents, I_h≈\approx1：开发人员可以检查所有绑定。但对于具有 n 个微服务和平均扇出 k 的 DAG，绑定计数 |E| = O(nk)，进行详尽的人工检查 O(nk) - 成本高昂——当 nk 时不可行1: a developer can inspect all bindings. But for a DAG with n micro-services and average fan-out k, the binding count |E| = O(nk), making exhaustive human inspection O(nk)-costly—infeasible when nk≫\gg 103。在多方设置中，I_h < 1. In multi-party settings, I_h < 1结构上structurally：组织 A 无法观察组织 B 内部的边缘，无论规模如何。: organization A cannot observe edges internal to organization B, regardless of scale.

复杂性论证。Complexity Argument.令 n 表示任务中微服务的数量，k 表示接线图 W 中每个服务的平均出度（扇出）。边数为 |E| = O(nk)。对于 m 个并发任务，总审计负担（以需要检查的不同绑定来衡量）为 B(n, k, m) = O(mnk)。该数量在所有三个参数中同时超线性增长。即使是适度的参数值也会产生难以管理的审核负载：在 n = 50、k = 3、m = 20、B = 3,000 个绑定时。如果我们进一步考虑 DAG（最长的依赖链）的依赖深度 d，则每个任务的检查Let n denote the number of micro-services in a mission and k the average out-degree (fan-out) of each service in the wiring graph W. The edge count is |E| = O(nk). For m concurrent missions, total audit burden—measured in distinct bindings requiring inspection—is B(n, k, m) = O(mnk). This quantity grows super-linearly in all three parameters simultaneously. Even modest parameter values produce unmanageable audit loads: at n = 50, k = 3, m = 20, B = 3,000 bindings. If we further account for the dependency depth d of the DAG (the longest chain of dependencies), the per-mission inspection延迟latency- 人工审核员可以证明完整接线之前的最短时间 - 是—the minimum time before a human auditor can attest to the full wiring—isΩ\Omega(d) 连续检查步骤，即使有无限的并行审查者，因为在理解其前身之前无法评估下游绑定。因此，每次任务的人工审计成本不仅仅是 O(nk)，而且还有(d) sequential inspection steps even with unlimited parallel reviewers, because downstream bindings cannot be evaluated before their predecessors are understood. Human audit cost is therefore not merely O(nk) per mission but has a关键路径critical-path无法通过并行性简化的组件。component that is irreducible by parallelism.

工作示例。Worked Example.考虑一个具有 n = 50 个微服务和 k = 3 个平均依赖项的任务。接线图有 150 条边。对于每个边缘花费 5 分钟的人工审核员，单个任务审核需要 12.5 小时，这比大多数任务执行时间都要长。如果同一位审核员同时监督 m = 4 个相同规模的并发任务，则待审核的总负载为 600 项边缘检查，需要 50 人时，但这些任务可能会在 2 小时内完成。审计师的检查带宽在结构上不足以维持实时治理的保真度。现在添加多方维度：如果 50 个微服务中有 25 个属于审核员无法访问其源存储库的合作伙伴组织，则 I_h(W) 会下降到大约 0.5，并且审核员没有任何额外的审核工作可以弥补这一差距，因为相关信息不可用，而不仅仅是未处理。公共分类账上的合约恰恰解决了这个问题：它们使接线信息在结构上可用，而不管组织边界如何。Consider a mission with n = 50 micro-services and k = 3 average dependencies. The wiring graph has  150 edges. A human auditor spending 5 minutes per edge requires 12.5 hours for a single mission audit—longer than most mission execution times. If the same auditor simultaneously oversees m = 4 concurrent missions of identical size, the total pending audit load is 600 edge-inspections requiring 50 person-hours, yet the missions may collectively complete in under 2 hours. The auditor’s inspection bandwidth is structurally insufficient to maintain real-time governance fidelity. Now add the multi-party dimension: if 25 of the 50 micro-services belong to a partner organization whose source repositories the auditor cannot access, I_h(W) drops to approximately 0.5, and no additional audit effort by the auditor can close that gap—because the relevant information is not available, not merely unprocessed. Contracts on a public ledger solve precisely this: they make wiring information structurally available regardless of organizational boundaries.

AgentCity 的链上合约恢复了接线拓扑的 I_h(W) = 1：因为所有绑定都记录在公共分类账上，所以任何委托人都可以重建完整的图 W。对于微服务来说，差距并未弥合AgentCity’s on-chain contracts restore I_h(W) = 1 for the wiring topology: because all bindings are recorded on a public ledger, any principal can reconstruct the full graph W. The gap is not closed for micro-service内部结构internals（这需要 TEE 认证 - 请参阅附录 C），但对于决定的结构布线来说是封闭的(which would require TEE attestation—see Appendix C), but it is closed for the structural wiring that determines其中which服务执行services execute其中which下的任务tasks under什么what约束——对于治理最关键的层。constraints—the layer most critical for governance.

在小规模上，差距是可以控制的。监督少数代理的开发人员仍然可以检查工件、运行验证工具或雇用审计代理来审查代码。当组件数量较少且组件之间的接线足够简单以保存在工作内存中时，这些解决方法就足够了。At small scale, the gap is manageable. A developer overseeing a handful of agents can still inspect artifacts, run verification tools, or employ auditing agents to review the code. These workarounds suffice when the number of components is small and the wiring between them is simple enough to hold in working memory.

然而，随着代理经济迅速发展的规模，这种基于检查的治理在结构上变得不可行。当数千个代理协作构建由数万或数十万个微服务组成的互联网规模的去中心化应用程序时，接线图的组合复杂性（哪些服务以什么顺序、使用什么数据、在什么约束下调用哪个服务）超出了任何人类团队或审计代理群可以逐点检查的范围。治理问题与代理的数量不是线性的；它是其输出之间的绑定数量的组合。我们的原型在具有数十个微服务的五代理立法机构规模上验证了 AgentCity 架构（附录 C）；验证更大规模（数百个代理和数千个服务）的治理开销将通过基于代理的模拟和合成 DAG 工作负载来解决（附录 D）。At the scale toward which agent economies are rapidly progressing, however, such inspection-based governance becomes structurally infeasible. When thousands of agents collaboratively build internet-scale decentralized applications comprising tens or hundreds of thousands of micro-services, the combinatorial complexity of the wiring graph—which services call which, in what order, with what data, under what constraints—exceeds what any human team or auditing-agent swarm can review point by point. The governance problem is not linear in the number of agents; it is combinatorial in the number of bindings between their outputs. Our prototype validates the AgentCity architecture at the scale of a five-agent legislature with dozens of micro-services (Appendix C); validating governance overhead at larger scales—hundreds of agents and thousands of services—will be addressed through agent-based simulation with synthetic DAG workloads (Appendix D).

在多方参与的情况下，这个问题会更加严重。当组织 A 的代理自主发现组织 B 的代理、协商协作并共同构建软件系统时，任何一方都无法检查对方的工件。组织 A 无法访问组织 B 的微服务源代码、部署配置和内部布线，反之亦然。然而，他们的代理已经让双方都承诺共享执行拓扑。再多的组织内部审计也无法解决这种跨界不透明的问题。The problem deepens in multi-party settings. When agents from organization A autonomously discover agents from organization B, negotiate a collaboration, and jointly construct a software system, neither party can inspect the other’s artifacts. Organization A lacks access to organization B’s micro-service source code, deployment configuration, and internal wiring—and vice versa. Yet their agents have committed both parties to a shared execution topology. No amount of within-organization auditing resolves this cross-boundary opacity.

AgentCity 通过两个架构决策解决了实施差距。首先，所有可执行组件都形式化为AgentCity addresses the Implementation Gap through two architectural decisions. First, all executable components are formalized as微服务micro-services- 具有已知代码哈希和 API 模式的可识别的注册实体，而不是不透明的临时脚本。其次，更根本的是，微服务之间的关系（哪个服务以什么顺序、在什么约束下绑定到哪个任务）被编码为—identifiable, registered entities with known code-hashes and API schemas—rather than opaque, ad-hoc scripts. Second, and more fundamentally, the relationships among micro-services—which service is bound to which task, in what order, under what constraints—are encoded as链上智能合约on-chain smart contracts。 CollaborationContract 对任务 DAG（接线图）进行编码； ServiceContract 锚定每个微服务的身份和执行约束；守护者模块和验证模块控制每次转换时发生的情况。由于这些合约驻留在公共区块链上，因此它们构成了中立、防篡改的记录，任何一方（包括无法检查彼此工件的各方）都可以独立审核。如果不产生可验证的链上跟踪，则无法更改微服务的连接。. The CollaborationContract encodes the task DAG (the wiring diagram); the ServiceContract anchors each micro-service’s identity and execution constraints; the Guardian module and Verification module govern what happens at each transition. Because these contracts reside on a public blockchain, they constitute a neutral, tamper-proof record that any party—including parties who cannot inspect each other’s artifacts—can independently audit. The wiring of micro-services cannot be altered without producing a verifiable on-chain trace.

—

B.3 智能合约架构The Smart Contract Architecture

智能合约是AgentCity的制度中心。它们不是属于单个 SoP 分支的组件；它们是独立于部门的宪法支柱，由立法产生、执行执行、裁决验证。四种链上合约类型涵盖整个任务生命周期。表Smart contracts are the institutional center of AgentCity. They are not components belonging to a single SoP branch; they are the branch-independent constitutional anchors that Legislation produces, Execution enforces, and Adjudication verifies. Four on-chain contract types span the full mission lifecycle. TableLABEL:tab:contracts总结了架构。summarizes the architecture.

注：所有 Gas 估算均为基于 SSTORE 操作计数的分析预测；实际测量值将在配套的实证论文中报告。Note: All gas estimates are analytical projections based on SSTORE operation counts; actual measured values will be reported in the companion empirical paper.

代理合同。AgentContract.每个参与者——无论是生产代理、管理代理还是裁决监督员——在参与任何任务之前都必须通过代理合同进行注册。注册绑定三个要素：（1）加密身份（去中心化标识符（DID）兼容）Every participant—whether a producer agent, a management agent, or an adjudication monitor—must register through the AgentContract before participating in any mission. Registration binds three elements: (1) a cryptographic identity (decentralized identifier (DID)-compatible[35]），（2）建立责任执行的所有权链的人类委托人地址，以及（3）确定允许的操作的代理类型分类（生产者与管理者）。该合约在每次任务后根据经过验证的执行遥测维护更新的声誉分类账，提供控制市场参与的链上“专业许可证”。声誉更新由检查任务结果的监管机构和报告验证结果的执行合同授权——防止自我评分，同时保持人类委托人的裁决权威。), (2) a human principal address establishing the ownership chain for liability enforcement, and (3) an agent type classification (producer vs. management) that determines permitted operations. The contract maintains a reputation ledger updated after each mission based on verified execution telemetry, providing the on-chain "professional license" that gates marketplace participation. Reputation updates are authorized by Regulatory Agents that inspect mission outcomes and by execution contracts that report verified results—preventing self-scoring while keeping adjudicative authority with human principals.

Gas 分析：AgentContract.register() 执行 4 个 SSTORE 操作（代理映射条目、 humanPrincipals、reputationLedger、结构中隐式的 agentType）以及与 DID 长度成比例的 DID 字符串存储（通常为 40 字节）。预计总数：4Gas analysis: AgentContract.register() performs 4 SSTORE operations (agents mapping entry, humanPrincipals, reputationLedger, implicitly agentType within the struct) plus DID string storage proportional to DID length ( 40 bytes typical). Estimated total: 4×\times20,000（冷 SSTORE）+ calldata + ABI 开销20,000 (cold SSTORE) + calldata + ABI overhead≈\approx85,000–100,000 气体。实际的链上测量计划作为实验 4（附录 D）的一部分。85,000–100,000 gas. Actual on-chain measurement is planned as part of Experiment 4 (Appendix D).

可重入审计（所有四个合同）。Reentrancy Audit (All Four Contracts).§B.3–§B.11 中的所有合约伪代码都遵循检查-效果-交互 (CEI) 模式：状态突变（SSTORE、DELETE）先于任何外部调用（TRANSFER、跨合约 CALL）。的All contract pseudocode in §B.3–§B.11 follows the Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) pattern: state mutations (SSTORE, DELETE) precede any external call (TRANSFER, cross-contract CALL). The注销()deregister()上面的函数在 v0.20 中得到了纠正，以符合 CEI 的要求，因为审阅者发现了顺序违规（其中 TRANSFER 先于 DELETE），从而通过生产权益级别（10,000 美元以上）的回退重新进入实现了经典的可重入利用。其余合约类型——管理合约、服务合约和协作合约（包括其监护人、验证和门模块）——都经过了类似排序漏洞的审核：没有发现其他违规行为。 CollaborationContract 中的所有削减功能均遵循 CEI 设计（权益余额在金库转移之前归零，现在根据 v0.29 四合约合并，在金库模块的金库余额和保险池之间按 50/50 分配）。 Gate 模块专门使用 STATICCALL 进行谓词求值，它不能修改状态，因此在构造上是可重入安全的。function above was corrected in v0.20 to comply with CEI after a reviewer-identified ordering violation in which TRANSFER preceded DELETE, enabling a classic reentrancy exploit via fallback re-entry at production stake levels ($10,000+). The remaining contract types—ManagementContract, ServiceContract, and the CollaborationContract (including its Guardian, Verification, and Gate modules)—were audited for analogous ordering vulnerabilities: no additional violations were found. All slashing functions in CollaborationContract follow CEI by design (stake balance is zeroed before the treasury transfer, now split 50/50 between the Treasury module’s treasury balance and insurance pool per the v0.29 four-contract consolidation). The Gate module uses STATICCALL exclusively for predicate evaluation, which cannot modify state and is therefore reentrancy-safe by construction.

管理合同。ManagementContract.管理合约通过将每个管理代理绑定到一个权限信封（指定允许的操作、禁止的操作和强制微服务委托的链上记录）来在协议级别管理四个管理代理（注册、立法、监管、编纂）。该合约完善了 SoP 模型的对称性：AgentContract 为所有参与者提供身份和声誉管理，而 ManagementContract 为管理代理添加了特定于角色的行为约束。关键的架构洞察是The ManagementContract governs the four management agents (Registry, Legislative, Regulatory, Codification) at the protocol level by binding each to an authority envelope—an on-chain record specifying permitted operations, prohibited operations, and mandatory microservice delegations. This contract completes the SoP model’s symmetry: where the AgentContract provides identity and reputation management for all participants, the ManagementContract adds role-specific behavioral constraints for management agents. The key architectural insight is the代表团授权delegation mandate：管理代理必须将工件生成操作（字节码编译、DAG 验证、信誉评分）委托给已注册的微服务，其代码哈希通过 ServiceContract 独立锚定。这创建了一个可检查的中间层 - 人工审计员可以独立于调用它的编码代理来检查编译微服务，从结构上减轻编码代理的信任集中度。: management agents must delegate artifact-producing operations (bytecode compilation, DAG validation, reputation scoring) to registered microservices whose code-hashes are independently anchored via ServiceContract. This creates an inspectable intermediate layer—a human auditor can examine the compilation microservice independently of the Codification Agent that invokes it, structurally mitigating the Codification Agent trust concentration.

Gas 分析： ManagementContract.registerManagementAgent() 执行 N 个 SSTORE 操作，其中 N = 1 (profile) + |permissedOps| + |禁止行动| + 委托服务验证 SLOAD。对于具有 8 项允许操作、3 项禁止操作和 2 项委托服务的典型编码代理：11Gas analysis: ManagementContract.registerManagementAgent() performs N SSTORE operations where N = 1 (profile) + |permittedOps| + |prohibitedOps| + delegated service validation SLOADs. For a typical Codification Agent with 8 permitted operations, 3 prohibited operations, and 2 delegated services:  11×\times20,000（冷SSTORE）+220,000 (cold SSTORE) + 2×\times2,100（跨合约 SLOAD）+ 开销2,100 (cross-contract SLOAD) + overhead≈\approx85,000–95,000 气体。 validateOperation() 执行 2 个 SLOAD + 1 个 LOG85,000–95,000 gas. validateOperation() performs 2 SLOADs + 1 LOG≈\approx8,000–12,000 气体。 delegateToMicroservice() 执行 3 个 SLOAD + 任务查找 + 1 个 LOG8,000–12,000 gas. delegateToMicroservice() performs 3 SLOADs + mandate lookup + 1 LOG≈\approx20,000–30,000 气体。20,000–30,000 gas.

女巫攻击成本受限。Sybil Attack Cost Bound.通过注册质押，使用 n 个共谋代理发起 Sybil 攻击的成本为：With registration staking, the cost of mounting a Sybil attack with n colluding agents is:

CS​y​b​i​l​(n)=n⋅sr​e​g+∑i=1ksb​i​d​(i)≥n⋅1000+k⋅sm​i​nC_{Sybil}(n)=n\cdot s_{reg}+\sum_{i=1}^{k}s_{bid}(i)\geq n\cdot 1000+k\cdot s_{min}

其中 s_reg 是注册权益（默认值：1,000 单位），s_bid(i) 是第 i 个任务的每个任务投标权益，k 是联盟投标的任务数量。对于默认参数，用 50 个 Sybil 代理淹没立法流程就需要锁定 50,000 个单位的注册权益——这是一个随着攻击广度线性扩展的经济障碍。where s_reg is the registration stake (default: 1,000 units), s_bid(i) is the per-task bid stake for the i-th task, and k is the number of tasks the coalition bids on. For the default parameters, flooding the legislative process with 50 Sybil agents requires locking 50,000 units in registration stakes alone—an economic barrier that scales linearly with attack breadth.

服务合同。ServiceContract.对于每个部署的微服务，负责的生产者代理会在链上注册一个 ServiceContract，将服务的代码哈希、API 模式和执行约束锚定为不可变的记录。这种注册将不透明的代理构建软件转变为可识别、可审计的执行实体。For each deployed micro-service, the responsible producer agent registers a ServiceContract on-chain, anchoring the service’s code-hash, API schema, and execution constraints as an immutable record. This registration is what transforms an opaque piece of agent-built software into an identifiable, auditable execution entity.

合作合同。CollaborationContract.CollaborationContract 是任务 DAG 的链上编码，该接线图指定哪些微服务绑定到哪些任务节点、它们的依赖顺序、I/O 模式和每个节点的代币预算。它在执行期间充当中央同步中心，将任务路由到注册的微服务并强制执行法定的执行拓扑。这是进行布线的合同The CollaborationContract is the on-chain encoding of the task DAG—the wiring diagram that specifies which micro-services are bound to which task nodes, their dependency ordering, I/O schemas, and per-node token budgets. It serves as the central synchronization hub during execution, routing tasks to registered micro-services and enforcing the legislated execution topology. This is the contract that makes the wiring可见的visible：通过检查 CollaborationContract，任何一方都可以重建完整的执行拓扑，而无需访问任何单个微服务的内部逻辑。每个任务节点的进度证明层（见下文）也在立法阶段在协作合同中按节点指定，确保验证要求被编码在与任务拓扑相同的不可变记录中。: by examining the CollaborationContract, any party can reconstruct the full execution topology without access to any individual micro-service’s internal logic. The Proof-of-Progress tier for each task node (see below) is also specified per-node in the CollaborationContract during the Legislation phase, ensuring that verification requirements are encoded in the same immutable record as the task topology.

验证超时（PENDING_VERIFICATION 活跃度）。Verification Timeout (PENDING_VERIFICATION Liveness).不提交的冗余执行器可以无限期地使 DAG 节点处于 PENDING_VERIFICATION 状态。为了防止这种情况，CollaborationContract 强制每个节点验证超时（A non-submitting redundant executor can stall a DAG node indefinitely in the PENDING_VERIFICATION state. To prevent this, the CollaborationContract enforces a per-node verification timeout (验证超时时间verificationTimeoutMs，构成参数，默认：300,000 ms = 5 分钟）。如果冗余执行器在进入 PENDING_VERIFICATION 后未在此窗口内提交其 PoP 证明，则验证模块会将节点转换为 FAILED 并具有故障类别, constitutional parameter, default: 300,000 ms = 5 minutes). If a redundant executor has not submitted its PoP proof within this window after entering PENDING_VERIFICATION, the Verification module transitions the node to FAILED with fault category验证\{}_TIMEOUTVERIFICATION\{}_TIMEOUT，触发不提交执行人的出价股份的大幅削减（, triggering slashing of the non-submitting executor’s bid stake (lashingSchedule.timeoutExceededslashingSchedule.timeoutExceeded，默认值：50 个单位）并启动自适应细化重新分配协议。对于类型 2（冗余共识）验证，超时适用于每个执行者：共识机制继续处理在窗口内收到的提交，未能提交的执行者将被排除在共识投票之外并被单独削减。, default: 50 units) and initiating the Adaptive Refinement re-assignment protocol. For Type 2 (redundant consensus) verification, the timeout applies per-executor: the consensus mechanism proceeds with the submissions received within the window, and executors who failed to submit are excluded from the consensus vote and slashed individually.

Gas 分析：CollaborationContract.deployDAG() 涉及每个节点的 SSTORE 操作（DAGNode 结构的每个节点 1 个 + 每个边条目 1 个）加上合约链接（3 个 SSTORE）。对于具有 12 条边的 10 节点 DAG：大约 (10 + 12 + 3)Gas analysis: CollaborationContract.deployDAG() involves SSTORE operations for each node (1 per node for the DAGNode struct + 1 per edge entry) plus contract linkage (3 SSTOREs). For a 10-node DAG with 12 edges: approximately (10 + 12 + 3)×\times20,000 = 500,000 Gas 用于冷存储，加上部署开销。估计总量：280,000–500,000 Gas，具体取决于 DAG 大小。 advanceNode() 调用验证模块（2,500 Gas 基础）加上 2–3 SSTORE 进行状态更新：每次转换 45,000–60,000 Gas。每个 DAG 大小的实际测量值计划作为实验 4（附录 D）的一部分。20,000 = 500,000 gas for cold storage, plus deployment overhead. Total estimated:  280,000–500,000 gas depending on DAG size. advanceNode() invokes a call to the Verification module ( 2,500 gas base) plus 2–3 SSTOREs for state updates:  45,000–60,000 gas per transition. Actual measured values per DAG size are planned as part of Experiment 4 (Appendix D).

用于大型部署的 DAG 批处理。DAG Batching for Large Deployments.对于超过 L2 区块 Gas 限制（30M Gas）的 DAG，For DAGs exceeding the L2 block gas limit ( 30M gas),部署DAG()deployDAG()必须跨多个块进行分区。 AgentCity 实施了must be partitioned across multiple blocks. AgentCity implements a批量部署协议batched deployment protocol：编码代理将 DAG 划分为部署部分，每个部分最多包含: the Codification Agent partitions the DAG into deployment tranches, each containing at most每组最大节点数maxNodesPerTranche节点数（构成参数，默认：500）。每个 tranche 都部署为一个单独的事务，并且 CollaborationContract 维护一个nodes (constitutional parameter, default: 500). Each tranche is deployed as a separate transaction, and the CollaborationContract maintains a部署完成deploymentComplete仅当所有批次均已提交时才设置的标志。任务一直处于 PENDING 状态，直到flag that is set only when all tranches have been committed. The mission remains in PENDING state until部署完成== truedeploymentComplete == true，防止过早执行部分部署的 DAG。, preventing premature execution of partially deployed DAGs.

对于 5,000 个节点的 DAG（计划的大规模压力测试，配套的实证论文），这会产生大约 10 个部署部分，每个部分消耗 15M Gas，完全在每个区块的限制之内。批处理开销（额外交易和最终检查）估计为每个批次边界 50,000 个 Gas。For a 5,000-node DAG (planned large-scale stress test, companion empirical paper), this yields approximately 10 deployment tranches, each consuming  15M gas—well within the per-block limit. The batching overhead (additional transactions and finalization check) is estimated at  50,000 gas per tranche boundary.

质押和托管机制。Staking and Escrow Mechanism.经济激励层通过集成到现有合约架构中的托管功能而不是单独的 StakeContract 来运行。两种托管机制强制善意参与：The economic incentive layer operates through escrow functions integrated into the existing contract architecture rather than a separate StakingContract. Two escrow mechanisms enforce good-faith participation:

注册托管（代理合同）。Registration Escrow (AgentContract).注册后，每个代理将注册股份（默认：1,000 单位的任务结算代币）存入 AgentContract 中。该股份在特工的整个活跃生命周期内被锁定，并且只有在自愿注销且没有待执行任务的情况下才会退还。注册权益作为女巫防御（参见上面的女巫攻击成本限制）。Upon registration, each agent deposits a registration stake (default: 1,000 units of the mission’s settlement token) into the AgentContract. This stake is locked for the agent’s entire active lifetime and is refunded only upon voluntary deregistration with no pending missions. Registration stake serves as a Sybil defense (see Sybil Attack Cost Bound above).

任务级托管（协作合同）。Task-Level Escrow (CollaborationContract).投标接受（MSG_TYPE_5 批准）后，每个生产者代理的投标股份（在 MSG_TYPE_4 中指定）在任务期间被锁定在 CollaborationContract 中。任务成功完成后，权益将被释放（节点达到 COMPLETED 状态并确认 PoP 证明）。在以下情况下，权益将被削减（转移到由裁决部门控制的协议金库）：Upon bid acceptance (MSG_TYPE_5 approval), each producer agent’s bid stake (specified in MSG_TYPE_4) is locked in the CollaborationContract for the duration of the mission. Stake is released upon successful task completion (node reaches COMPLETED state with PoP attestation confirmed). Stake is slashed (transferred to a protocol treasury controlled by the Adjudication branch) upon:

  • •

    任务超时：slashingSchedule.timeoutExceeded（默认值：50个单位）Task timeout: slashingSchedule.timeoutExceeded (default: 50 units)

  • •

    代码哈希不匹配：slashingSchedule.codeHashMismatch（默认值：500 个单位）Code-hash mismatch: slashingSchedule.codeHashMismatch (default: 500 units)

  • •

    冻结后节点故障：slashingSchedule.nodeFailure（默认值：100 个单位）Node failure after freeze: slashingSchedule.nodeFailure (default: 100 units)

  • •

    由于代理故障而中止任务：slashingSchedule.missionAbort（默认值：全额）Mission abort due to agent fault: slashingSchedule.missionAbort (default: full stake)

博弈论激励约束。Game-Theoretic Incentive Bound.对于阻止叛逃的质押机制，最低质押必须满足联盟调整的威慑不平等。我们扩展了标准威慑范围，以考虑威胁模型中确定的三个因素：（i）验证层特定的检测概率，（ii）严格经济模型下的联盟形成概率，以及（iii）具体的经济面额。For the staking mechanism to deter defection, the minimum stake must satisfy a coalition-adjusted deterrence inequality. We extend the standard deterrence bound to account for three factors identified in the threat model: (i) verification tier-specific detection probabilities, (ii) coalition formation probability under a rigorous economic model, and (iii) concrete economic denomination.

统一的 Sybil + 叛逃成本模型。Unified Sybil + Defection Cost Model.女巫攻击成本界限（上图）和博弈论威慑界限独立分析了对抗性经济学的两个方面。在实践中，注册多个代理然后使用它们来竞标任务的 Sybil 攻击者同时面临两种成本。对手发动协调攻击的总成本The Sybil Attack Cost Bound (above) and the game-theoretic deterrence bound analyze two aspects of adversarial economics independently. In practice, a Sybil attacker who registers multiple agents and then uses them to bid on tasks faces both costs simultaneously. The total adversary cost for mounting a coordinated attack withnnSybil 代理人竞标Sybil agents bidding onkk任务是：tasks is:

Ct​o​t​a​l​(n,k)=n⋅sr​e​g⏟registration+k⋅sm​i​n⏟task staking+n⋅Cc​o​m​p​u​t​e⏟agent operationC_{total}(n,k)=\underbrace{n\cdot s_{reg}}_{\text{registration}}+\underbrace{k\cdot s_{min}}_{\text{task staking}}+\underbrace{n\cdot C_{compute}}_{\text{agent operation}}

对于默认参数（For the default parameters (sr​e​g=1,000s_{reg}=1{,}000, sm​i​n=150s_{min}=150对于低风险），需要 5 个 Sybil 代理竞标 10 个任务的攻击成本：for LOW-risk), an attack requiring 5 Sybil agents bidding on 10 tasks costs:5×1,000+10×150=6,5005\times 1{,}000+10\times 150=6{,}500单位（units (≈$​16.25\approx\mathdollar 16.25），加上运营成本。注册权益在代理的整个生命周期内都被锁定（只有在没有活动任务的情况下取消注册时才能退还），而任务权益则按任务锁定并受到削减。这两种机制之间的相互作用产生了), plus operational costs. The registration stake is locked for the agent’s entire lifetime (refundable only upon deregistration with no active missions), while task stakes are locked per-mission and subject to slashing. The interaction between these two mechanisms creates a成本放大器cost amplifier：攻击者必须同时维持沉没资本（注册）和风险资本（任务权益），并且在保持攻击能力的同时无法收回注册权益。这个统一的模型取代了独立的分析；应评估女巫成本界限和威慑界限: the attacker must maintain both sunk capital (registration) and at-risk capital (task stakes) simultaneously, and cannot recover registration stakes while maintaining attack capability. This unified model supersedes the independent analyses; both the Sybil cost bound and deterrence bound should be evaluated againstCt​o​t​a​lC_{total}而不是它们孤立的组成部分。rather than their components in isolation.

明确的范围声明。Explicit scope statement.§B.3 中的经济安全分析表明，三部分威慑机制（EQ-2 到 EQ-4）是The economic security analysis in §B.3 demonstrates that the three-component deterrence mechanism (EQ-2 through EQ-4) is结构合理structurally sound：检测概率、权益大小和削减率正确组成威慑界限，并且界限与每个组件单调缩放。原型参数未提供足够的生产部署；它们经过校准，可以最大限度地降低测试网交易成本，并在评估阶段实现快速迭代。任何具有重大财务风险的部署处理任务: detection probability, stake size, and slashing rate compose correctly into a deterrence bound, and the bound scales monotonically with each component. The prototype parameters are not presented as adequate for production deployments; they are calibrated to minimize testnet transaction costs and enable rapid iteration during the evaluation phase. Any deployment processing missions with material financial exposure必须must在依靠经济威慑层作为安全保证之前，根据 EQ-5 到 EQ-7（或其更保守的变体）重新校准权益参数。recalibrate stake parameters according to EQ-5 through EQ-7 (or a more conservative variant thereof) before relying on the economic deterrence layer as a security guarantee.

At typical LLM inference costs of$​0.10\mathdollar 0.10–$​1.00\mathdollar 1.00每项任务的机会成本占主导地位两个数量级。这就产生了参与理性约束：只有资本成本较低的主体（机构运营商、质押池或拥有现有闲置资本的主体）才能理性参与生产质押的高风险任务。这可能会将执行集中在资本充足的现有企业中，从而减少激励架构的未经许可的参与。per task, the opportunity cost dominates by two orders of magnitude. This creates a participation rationality constraint: only agents with low cost of capital (institutional operators, staking pools, or agents with existing idle capital) can rationally participate in HIGH-risk missions at production stakes. This may concentrate execution among well-capitalized incumbents, reducing the permissionless participation that motivates the architecture.

Guardian 模块（CollaborationContract 子模块）。Guardian Module (CollaborationContract sub-module).Guardian 模块充当行为防火墙，强制执行执行层不变量：推理偏离任务（>2The Guardian module functions as a behavioral firewall, enforcing execution-layer invariants: reasoning deviation from mandate (>2σ\sigma触发确定性冻结）、工具调用计数（每个任务每个代理最多 40 个）和消息量（每个任务节点最多 120 个以防止循环）。这些阈值不是硬编码常量，而是triggers Deterministic Freeze), tool invocation count (max 40 per agent per task), and message volume (max 120 per task node to prevent loops). These thresholds are not hard-coded constants but构成参数constitutional parameters由人类评审员通过规则中心定义（§B.12）。defined by human adjudicators through the Rules Hub (§B.12).

IF 异常类型anomalyType == 留言MESSAGE:
柜台counter.消息量messageVolume += 1
IF 柜台counter.消息量messageVolume > 宪法参数constitutionalParams.最大消息量maxMessageVolume:
呼叫CALL 触发冻结triggerFreeze(节点IDnodeId, 代理地址agentAddr, MESSAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
商城SSTORE 异常计数器anomalyCounters[节点IDnodeId] = 柜台counter
功能FUNCTION 触发冻结triggerFreeze(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 代理地址agentAddr: 地址address, 原因reason: 冻结原因FreezeReason):
要求REQUIRE 不NOT 紧急停止激活emergencyStopActive
记录record <- 冻结记录FreezeRecord(节点IDnodeId, 代理地址agentAddr, 原因reason, 现在now, 假的false, 0x0)
追加APPEND 记录record TO 冻结日志freezeLog[代理地址agentAddr]
发射发射EMIT 冻结触发FreezeTriggered(节点IDnodeId, 代理地址agentAddr, 原因reason, 现在now)
呼叫CALL 合作合同collaborationContract.设置节点状态setNodeState(节点IDnodeId, 冷冻FROZEN)
// 检查Check 升级escalation 窗户window
窗口计数windowCount <- 窗口中冻结计数countFreezesInWindow(代理地址agentAddr)
有效阈值effectiveThreshold <- 获取有效升级阈值getEffectiveEscalationThreshold(代理地址agentAddr)
IF 窗口计数windowCount >= 有效阈值effectiveThreshold:
呼叫CALL 触发紧急停止triggerEmergencyStop(代理地址agentAddr)
功能FUNCTION 获取有效升级阈值getEffectiveEscalationThreshold(代理地址agentAddr: 地址address) -> uint256:
IF 不NOT 宪法参数constitutionalParams.声誉缩放启用reputationScalingEnabled:
返回RETURN 宪法参数constitutionalParams.升级冻结计数escalationFreezeCount
代表得分repScore <- 代理合同AgentContract.获取声誉分数getReputationScore(代理地址agentAddr)
// 线性Linear 缩放scaling: 声誉reputation [0,1000] 地图maps to 阈值threshold [3, 6]
// 阈值threshold = 基地base + 地板floor((代表得分repScore / 1000) * 3)
基地base <- 宪法参数constitutionalParams.升级冻结计数escalationFreezeCount
奖金bonus <- (代表得分repScore * 3) / 1000
返回RETURN 基地base + 奖金bonus
功能FUNCTION 窗口中冻结计数countFreezesInWindow(代理地址agentAddr: 地址address) -> uint256:
窗口女士windowMs <- 升级WindowsescalationWindows[代理地址agentAddr]
IF 窗口女士windowMs == 0: 窗口女士windowMs <- 宪法参数constitutionalParams.基本升级窗口MsbaseEscalationWindowMs
截止cutoff <- 现在now - 窗口女士windowMs
返回RETURN 计数count of 冻结日志freezeLog[代理地址agentAddr] 条目entries 与with 时间戳timestamp > 截止cutoff
和AND 是误报isFalsePositive == 假的false
功能FUNCTION 触发紧急停止triggerEmergencyStop(触发代理triggeringAgent: 地址address):
商城SSTORE 紧急停止激活emergencyStopActive = 真实true
// 双人间Double 升级escalation 窗户window 为了for 下一个next 循环cycle
升级WindowsescalationWindows[触发代理triggeringAgent] <- 升级WindowsescalationWindows[触发代理triggeringAgent] * 2
发射发射EMIT 紧急停止EmergencyStop(触发代理triggeringAgent, 现在now)
通知NOTIFY 人类的human 裁判员adjudicators 通过via 记录Logging 枢纽Hub
功能FUNCTION 批准解冻unfreezeWithApproval(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 代理地址agentAddr: 地址address):
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.发件人sender is 覆盖Override 面板Panel 授权的authorized 地址address
要求REQUIRE 合作合同collaborationContract.获取节点状态getNodeState(节点IDnodeId) == 冷冻FROZEN
冻结日志freezeLog[代理地址agentAddr].最后last.解决者resolvedBy = 味精msg.发件人sender
呼叫CALL 合作合同collaborationContract.设置节点状态setNodeState(节点IDnodeId, 符合资格ELIGIBLE)
发射发射EMIT 解冻Unfrozen(节点IDnodeId, 代理地址agentAddr, 味精msg.发件人sender)
功能FUNCTION 分类误报classifyFalsePositive(代理地址agentAddr: 地址address, 冻结索引freezeIndex: uint256):
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.发件人sender is 覆盖Override 面板Panel 授权的authorized 地址address
商城SSTORE 冻结日志freezeLog[代理地址agentAddr][冻结索引freezeIndex].是误报isFalsePositive = 真实true
发射发射EMIT 误报分类FalsePositiveClassified(代理地址agentAddr, 冻结索引freezeIndex, 味精msg.发件人sender)

验证模块（CollaborationContract子模块）。Verification Module (CollaborationContract sub-module).验证模块通过进度证明 (PoP) 证明来控制 DAG 节点状态转换，严格的验证可确保在没有经过验证的完成证明的情况下，任何任务都不会前进到下一个 DAG 节点。由于任务输出的可验证性属性存在根本差异，AgentCity 区分了三种 PoP 证明类型，在立法阶段在 CollaborationContract 中指定每个任务节点：The Verification module gates DAG node state transitions through Proof-of-Progress (PoP) attestations—rigorous validation ensuring that no task advances to the next DAG node without a verified proof of completion. Because task outputs vary fundamentally in their verifiability properties, AgentCity distinguishes three PoP attestation types, specified per-task-node in the CollaborationContract during the Legislation phase:

类型 1 — 确定性验证（基于哈希的证明）。Type 1—Deterministic Verification (Hash-Based Attestation).对于具有形式可验证输出的任务（加密操作、数值计算、确定性数据转换），PoP 使用基于哈希的证明：微服务生成输出和确定性证明（例如，输入/输出对的哈希、正确性的数学证明或针对参考值的校验和）。验证模块在授权 DAG 状态转换之前验证链上证明。这一层提供了最强有力的机械保证：当且仅当证明得到验证时，转换才会被授权。For tasks with formally verifiable outputs—cryptographic operations, numerical computation, deterministic data transformations—PoP uses hash-based attestation: the micro-service produces both the output and a deterministic proof (e.g., a hash of the input/output pair, a mathematical proof of correctness, or a checksum against a reference value). The Verification module verifies the proof on-chain before authorizing the DAG state transition. This tier provides the strongest mechanical guarantee: the transition is authorized if and only if the proof verifies.

具体类型 1 示例：Concrete Type 1 examples:(a) 对列表进行排序并返回排序数组的微服务提交 hash(input_array ||sorted_output) 以及正确排序的 Merkle 证明。验证模块重新计算哈希值并确定性地检查证明。 (b) 对文档执行 SHA-256 哈希的微服务提交输入哈希和输出摘要；验证是单个链上 keccak256 调用。 (c) 将结构化 JSON 转换为规范 CSV 格式的数据提取服务提交 hash(source_json || canonical_csv)；验证模块验证哈希是否与该节点的法定模式哈希匹配。当可实现输出可验证性时，类型 1 是首选层，因为它产生的每节点治理开销最低（用于哈希验证的 8,000 个 Gas 与类型 2 中的冗余执行成本）。(a) A micro-service that sorts a list and returns a sorted array submits hash(input_array || sorted_output) together with a Merkle proof of correct ordering. The Verification module recomputes the hash and checks the proof deterministically. (b) A micro-service performing SHA-256 hashing of a document submits the input hash and the output digest; verification is a single on-chain keccak256 call. (c) A data extraction service that converts structured JSON to a canonical CSV format submits hash(source_json || canonical_csv); the Verification module verifies the hash matches the legislated schema hash for that node. Type 1 is the preferred tier when output verifiability is achievable, as it incurs the lowest per-node governance overhead ( 8,000 gas for hash verification vs. the cost of redundant execution in Type 2).

类型 2 — 统计验证（统计证明）。Type 2—Statistical Verification (Statistical Attestation).对于具有随机但可测量输出的任务（分类、结构化数据提取、已知误差范围的数值估计），PoP 使用统计证明：多个独立的微服务执行相同的任务，并且验证模块在授权状态转换之前需要达成共识（例如，在可配置容差内的 2-of-3 协议）。冗余执行者数量和共识阈值是 CollaborationContract 中设置的宪法参数。此层以执行成本（冗余调用）为代价换取针对单个微服务错误或妥协的稳健性。For tasks with stochastic but measurable outputs—classification, structured data extraction, numerical estimation with known error bounds—PoP uses statistical attestation: multiple independent micro-services execute the same task, and the Verification module requires consensus (e.g., 2-of-3 agreement within a configurable tolerance) before authorizing the state transition. The number of redundant executors and the consensus threshold are constitutional parameters set in the CollaborationContract. This tier trades execution cost (redundant invocations) for robustness against individual micro-service error or compromise.

具体类型 2 示例：Concrete Type 2 examples:(a) 情感分类微服务（输出：积极、消极、中性）一式三份运行；验证模块检查 2-of-3 标签一致性。 (b) 命名实体识别服务（输出：具有位置的实体的 JSON 数组）重复运行；验证模块检查两个输出是否在 Jaccard 相似度阈值内(a) A sentiment classification micro-service (output: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL) runs in triplicate; the Verification module checks for 2-of-3 label agreement. (b) A named-entity recognition service (output: JSON array of entities with positions) runs in duplicate; the Verification module checks that both outputs are within a Jaccard similarity threshold≥\geq0.85（构成参数）。 (c) 数值估计服务（输出：浮点标量）一式三份运行；验证模块检查三个估计值的标准偏差是否低于可配置的容差（例如平均值的 5%）。第 2 类层对于机器学习微服务在架构上非常重要，其中不存在确定性的正确性证明，但输出质量可以通过整体协议来近似。0.85 (a constitutional parameter). (c) A numerical estimation service (output: floating-point scalar) runs in triplicate; the Verification module checks that the standard deviation of the three estimates is below a configurable tolerance (e.g., 5% of the mean). The Type 2 tier is architecturally important for machine-learning micro-services where no deterministic proof of correctness exists but output quality can be approximated by ensemble agreement.

类型 3 — 人工辅助验证（委托证明）。Type 3—Human-Assisted Verification (Delegated Attestation).对于具有固有主观输出的任务（自然语言生成、创意内容合成、战略推荐），PoP 使用委托证明：在授权 DAG 状态转换之前，微服务输出将转发到裁决分支进行人工审查。验证模块将 DAG 保持在 PENDING_REVIEW 状态，直到人工裁决者通过覆盖面板提交签名证明（批准或拒绝）。这是延迟和人力开销方面最昂贵的证明层，但它为自动验证在结构上不足的高风险主观输出提供了最强有力的治理保证。委托人工审核是对确定性和统计验证限制的正确架构响应——不是后备方案，而是设计的层。For tasks with inherently subjective outputs—natural language generation, creative content synthesis, strategic recommendation—PoP uses delegated attestation: the micro-service output is forwarded to the Adjudication branch for human review before the DAG state transition is authorized. The Verification module holds the DAG in a PENDING_REVIEW state until a human adjudicator submits a signed attestation (approve or reject) via the Override Panel. This is the most expensive attestation tier for latency and human overhead, but it provides the strongest governance guarantee for high-stakes subjective outputs where automated verification is structurally insufficient. Delegation to human review is the correct architectural response to the limits of deterministic and statistical verification—not a fallback, but a designed tier.

具体类型 3 示例：Concrete Type 3 examples:(a) 需要战略建议文件（例如，市场进入分析）的任务：微服务产出出现在覆盖小组中，并附有法定评估标题；人类评审员进行评分并批准或拒绝。 (b) 生成面向公众的通信的任务：输出显示在覆盖面板中，以便在发布前进行人工编辑审查。 (c) 法律文件起草任务：生成的文本保存在 PENDING_REVIEW 中，并发送给具有法律专业资格证书的裁决员（通过 AgentContract 人类主体分类进行验证）。类型 3 任务对 DAG 执行造成延迟瓶颈； AgentCity 通过启用不依赖于挂起的 3 类节点的 DAG 分支并行执行来缓解这一问题，从而最大限度地提高人工审核窗口期间的利用率。(a) A mission requiring a strategic recommendation document (e.g., market entry analysis): the micro-service output is surfaced in the Override Panel with the legislated evaluation rubric attached; a human adjudicator scores and approves or rejects. (b) A mission generating a public-facing communication: the output is displayed in the Override Panel for human editorial review before release. (c) A legal document drafting task: the generated text is held in PENDING_REVIEW and routed to an adjudicator with legal expertise credentials (verified via AgentContract human-principal classification). Type 3 tasks impose a latency bottleneck on DAG execution; AgentCity mitigates this by enabling parallel execution of DAG branches not dependent on the pending Type 3 node, maximizing utilization during the human review window.

三层 PoP 框架直接解决了同行评审中发现的不规范问题：验证模块不应用单一的整体验证模型，而是根据每个任务输出域的形式可验证性属性选择适当的证明机制。所有三个 PoP 层的实施以及每层验证开销的表征计划作为实验 4（附录 D）的一部分。The three-tier PoP framework directly addresses the underspecification identified in peer review: the Verification module does not apply a single monolithic verification model, but selects the appropriate attestation mechanism based on the formal verifiability properties of each task’s output domain. Implementation of all three PoP tiers and characterization of verification overhead per tier is planned as part of Experiment 4 (Appendix D).

⬇
模块MODULE 验证Verification (合作合同CollaborationContract 子sub-模块module):
状态STATE:
待定证明pendingProofs: 映射mapping(字节32bytes32 -> 波普记录PoPRecord) // 节点IDnodeId -> 证明proof 记录record
多余的提交redundantSubmissions: 映射mapping(字节32bytes32 -> 字节32bytes32[]) // 节点IDnodeId -> 输出output 哈希值hashes (类型Type 2)
委托待定delegatedPending: 映射mapping(字节32bytes32 -> 布尔值bool) // 节点IDnodeId -> 等待awaiting 人类的human 评论review
公差参数toleranceParams: 公差参数ToleranceParams // 宪政的constitutional 参数parameters
合作合同collaborationContract: 地址address
结构体STRUCT 波普记录PoPRecord:
节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32
流行层popTier: uint8
输出哈希值outputHash: 字节32bytes32
证明proof: 字节bytes
提交时间submittedAt: uint256
状态status: PoP状态PoPStatus
枚举ENUM PoP状态PoPStatus:
待定PENDING | 已批准APPROVED | 被拒绝REJECTED | 委托DELEGATED
结构体STRUCT 公差参数ToleranceParams:
杰卡德阈值jaccardThreshold: uint256 // 默认default: 85 (i.e., 0.85, 缩放的scaled x100)
数值公差百分比numericTolerancePct: uint256 // 默认default: 5 (5% of 意思是mean)
哈希证明必需hashProofRequired: 布尔值bool // 默认default: 真实true 为了for 类型Type 1
功能FUNCTION 提交PoPsubmitPoP(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 流行层popTier: uint8,
输出哈希值outputHash: 字节32bytes32, 证明proof: 字节bytes) -> PoP状态PoPStatus:
要求REQUIRE 合作合同collaborationContract.获取节点状态getNodeState(节点IDnodeId) == 执行EXECUTING
IF 流行层popTier == 1:
返回RETURN 验证哈希证明verifyHashProof(节点IDnodeId, 输出哈希值outputHash, 证明proof)
其他ELSE IF 流行层popTier == 2:
返回RETURN 验证共识verifyConsensus(节点IDnodeId, 输出哈希值outputHash)
其他ELSE IF 流行层popTier == 3:
返回RETURN 请求委托requestDelegated(节点IDnodeId, 输出哈希值outputHash)
功能FUNCTION 验证哈希证明verifyHashProof(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 输出哈希值outputHash: 字节32bytes32,
证明proof: 字节bytes) -> PoP状态PoPStatus:
预期模式哈希值expectedSchemaHash <- 合作合同CollaborationContract.达格dag[节点IDnodeId].输出模式哈希outputSchemaHash
计算哈希值computedHash <- 凯卡克256keccak256(输出哈希值outputHash || 证明proof)
IF 计算哈希值computedHash 比赛matches 预期模式哈希值expectedSchemaHash:
发射发射EMIT PoP批准PoPApproved(节点IDnodeId, 1, 输出哈希值outputHash)
返回RETURN 已批准APPROVED
其他ELSE:
发射发射EMIT PoP被拒绝PoPRejected(节点IDnodeId, 1, "散列hash 不匹配mismatch")
返回RETURN 被拒绝REJECTED
功能FUNCTION 验证共识verifyConsensus(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 输出哈希值outputHash: 字节32bytes32) -> PoP状态PoPStatus:
追加APPEND 输出哈希值outputHash TO 多余的提交redundantSubmissions[节点IDnodeId]
节点node <- 合作合同CollaborationContract.达格dag[节点IDnodeId]
意见书submissions <- 多余的提交redundantSubmissions[节点IDnodeId]
IF |意见书submissions| < 节点node.冗余系数redundancyFactor:
返回RETURN 待定PENDING // 等待awaiting 额外的additional 执行人executor 意见书submissions
// 检查Check 共识consensus
协议agreement <- 计算协议computeAgreement(意见书submissions, 节点node.流行层popTier)
IF 协议agreement >= 节点node.共识阈值consensusThreshold:
发射发射EMIT PoP批准PoPApproved(节点IDnodeId, 2, 输出哈希值outputHash)
返回RETURN 已批准APPROVED
其他ELSE:
发射发射EMIT PoP被拒绝PoPRejected(节点IDnodeId, 2, "共识consensus 不not 达到reached")
返回RETURN 被拒绝REJECTED
功能FUNCTION 请求委托requestDelegated(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 输出哈希值outputHash: 字节32bytes32) -> PoP状态PoPStatus:
商城SSTORE 委托待定delegatedPending[节点IDnodeId] = 真实true
发射发射EMIT 委托审查请求DelegatedReviewRequested(节点IDnodeId, 输出哈希值outputHash, 现在now)
返回RETURN 委托DELEGATED
功能FUNCTION 批准委托approveDelegated(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32):
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.发件人sender is 覆盖Override 面板Panel 授权的authorized 地址address
要求REQUIRE 委托待定delegatedPending[节点IDnodeId]
商城SSTORE 委托待定delegatedPending[节点IDnodeId] = 假的false
发射发射EMIT PoP批准PoPApproved(节点IDnodeId, 3, 待定证明pendingProofs[节点IDnodeId].输出哈希值outputHash)
呼叫CALL 合作合同collaborationContract.前进节点advanceNode(节点IDnodeId, ...)
功能FUNCTION 拒绝委托rejectDelegated(节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32, 原因reason: 字节32bytes32):
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.发件人sender is 覆盖Override 面板Panel 授权的authorized 地址address
要求REQUIRE 委托待定delegatedPending[节点IDnodeId]
商城SSTORE 委托待定delegatedPending[节点IDnodeId] = 假的false
发射发射EMIT PoP被拒绝PoPRejected(节点IDnodeId, 3, 原因reason)
呼叫CALL 合作合同collaborationContract.设置节点状态setNodeState(节点IDnodeId, 失败FAILED)

Gate 模块（CollaborationContract 子模块）。Gate Module (CollaborationContract sub-module).门模块应用构成输出过滤作为最后一英里的安全检查，在任何结果退出执行范围之前验证所有合成输出是否满足任务级安全谓词和总体系统构成。The Gate module applies constitutional output filtering as the last-mile safety check, verifying that all synthesized outputs satisfy mission-level safety predicates and the overarching System Constitution before any result exits the execution perimeter.

模块MODULE 门Gate (合作合同CollaborationContract 子sub-模块module):
状态STATE:
过滤谓词filterPredicates: 过滤谓词FilterPredicate[] // 定义的defined at 使命mission 设置setup 通过via 规则Rules 枢纽Hub
否决vetoed: 映射mapping(字节32bytes32 -> 布尔值bool) // 任务IDmissionId -> 否决vetoed 旗帜flag
释放released: 映射mapping(字节32bytes32 -> 布尔值bool) // 任务IDmissionId -> 释放released 旗帜flag
批准的谓词合约approvedPredicateContracts: 映射mapping(地址address -> 布尔值bool) // 白名单whitelist of 已批准approved 谓词predicate 实施implementations

谓词IDpredicateId: 字节32bytes32
描述description: 字符串string

安全说明：用于谓词求值的 STATICCALL。Security Note: STATICCALL for Predicate Evaluation.Gate 模块使用 STATICCALL（只读外部调用）而不是 DELEGATECALL 来进行谓词评估。 DELEGATECALL 在调用者的存储上下文中执行目标函数，这将允许恶意谓词（可能由受损的编码代理注册）覆盖 Gate 模块存储变量（例如，the Gate module uses STATICCALL (read-only external call) rather than DELEGATECALL for predicate evaluation. DELEGATECALL executes the target function in the caller’s storage context, which would allow a malicious predicate—potentially registered by a compromised Codification Agent—to overwrite the Gate module storage variables (e.g.,已发布[任务ID]released[missionId] or 否决[missionId]vetoed[missionId]），绕过构成输出滤波器。 STATICCALL 可防止被调用者修改状态，从而消除此攻击向量。此外，谓词合约地址必须由人类裁决者通过以下方式预先批准：), bypassing the constitutional output filter. STATICCALL prevents state modification by the callee, eliminating this attack vector. Additionally, predicate contract addresses must be pre-approved by human adjudicators via批准谓词契约()approvePredicateContract()，创建一个白名单，防止在 Gate 模块的安全范围内执行任意代码。, creating a whitelist that prevents arbitrary code execution within the Gate module’s security perimeter.

谓词 STATICCALL 的 Gas 限制。Gas Limit for Predicate STATICCALL.虽然 STATICCALL 可以防止状态修改，但恶意或实施不当的谓词合约仍然可以消耗任意 Gas 达到调用 Gas 限制，从而创建潜在的 Gas Griffing 向量。为了缓解这种情况，Gate 模块指定了每个谓词的气体上限（While STATICCALL prevents state modification, a malicious or poorly implemented predicate contract can still consume arbitrary gas up to the call gas limit, creating a potential gas-griefing vector. To mitigate this, the Gate module specifies a per-predicate gas ceiling (谓词GasLimitpredicateGasLimit，构成参数，默认：200,000gas），限制每个STATICCALL中转发的gas。如果谓词超出此预算，则调用将恢复，并且谓词将被标记为失败 - 在重新调用谓词之前触发裁决者进行手动审核。该参数应添加到构成参数表（§B.12）中。, constitutional parameter, default: 200,000 gas) that caps the gas forwarded in each STATICCALL. If the predicate exceeds this budget, the call reverts and the predicate is marked as failed—triggering a manual review by adjudicators before the predicate can be re-invoked. This parameter should be added to the Constitutional Parameter Table (§B.12).

结算和财务模块（CollaborationContract 子模块）。Settlement and Treasury Modules (CollaborationContract sub-modules).经济层分布在 AgentContract 上（代理级经济状态：钱包余额、权益核算、奖励历史、削减历史、The economic layer is distributed across the AgentContract (agent-level economic state: wallet balance, stake accounting, reward history, slashing history,ψ\psi(ρ\rho）计算）以及 CollaborationContract 的结算和财务模块（任务级和协议级经济功能）。立法规定任务预算和任务价格；通过结算模块验证任务完成后执行触发支付结算；裁决通过财务模块设定费用表并解决付款纠纷。经济职能不构成一个单独的部门；它们被整合到现有的四合约治理架构中。) computation) and the CollaborationContract’s Settlement and Treasury modules (mission-level and protocol-level economic functions). Legislation defines mission budgets and task prices; Execution triggers payment settlements upon verified task completion via the Settlement module; Adjudication sets fee schedules and resolves payment disputes via the Treasury module. The economic functions do not constitute a separate branch; they are integrated into the existing four-contract governance architecture.

功能FUNCTION 结算奖励settleReward(代理地址agentAddr: 地址address, 节点IDnodeId: 字节32bytes32):
// 被称为Called 之后after 流行病学PoP 验证verification 成功success. 实施Implements EQ-9.
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.发件人sender == 链接验证模块linkedVerificationModule // 结算Settlement 被称为called by 验证Verification 模块module
b <- 任务预算taskBudgets[节点IDnodeId]
要求REQUIRE b > 0
罗rho <- 代理合同AgentContract(链接代理合同linkedAgentContract).获取声誉分数getReputationScore(代理地址agentAddr)
磅/平方英寸psi <- 计算信誉乘数computeReputationMultiplier(代理地址agentAddr) // 磅/平方英寸psi(罗rho)
// EQ-9 (分裂split-来源source): R_任务R_task = R_base x 分钟min(磅/平方英寸psi, 1.0) + 财政补贴treasury_subsidy
// 哪里where R_base = b x (1 - f_p/10000 - f_i/10000), 和and
// 财政补贴treasury_subsidy = R_base x 最大max(磅/平方英寸psi - 1.0, 0) 绘制的drawn 来自from 协议protocol 国库treasury
费用分子feeNumerator <- 协议费率protocolFeeRate + 保险准备金率insuranceReserveRate // e.g., 300 为了for 3%
净利率netRate <- 10000 - 费用分子feeNumerator // e.g., 9700 为了for 97%
总奖励grossReward <- b x 净利率netRate / 10000 // = R_base (e.g., 970 at b=1000)
基础PsibasePsi <- 分钟min(磅/平方英寸psi, 1000) // 夹子clamp at 1.0 (中立的neutral); 磅/平方英寸psi 缩放的scaled by 1000
基本奖励baseReward <- 总奖励grossReward x 基础PsibasePsi / 1000 // <= 总奖励grossReward, 付费的paid 来自from 托管escrow
溢价PsipremiumPsi <- 最大max(磅/平方英寸psi - 1000, 0) // 0 if 磅/平方英寸psi <= 1.0
财政补贴treasurySubsidy <- 总奖励grossReward x 溢价PsipremiumPsi / 1000 // 资助的funded 来自from 协议protocol 国库treasury
协议费protocolFee <- b x 协议费率protocolFeeRate / 10000
保险准备金insuranceReserve <- b x 保险准备金率insuranceReserveRate / 10000
// 财政部Treasury 下溢underflow 守卫guard: 帽cap 补贴subsidy at 可用available 国库treasury 平衡balance + 传入incoming 协议protocol 费用fee
申请补贴requestedSubsidy <- 财政补贴treasurySubsidy
财政补贴treasurySubsidy <- 分钟min(财政补贴treasurySubsidy, 国库treasury + 协议费protocolFee)
IF 财政补贴treasurySubsidy < 申请补贴requestedSubsidy 那么THEN
发射发射EMIT 国库资金下溢TreasuryUnderflow(节点IDnodeId, 代理地址agentAddr, 申请补贴requestedSubsidy - 财政补贴treasurySubsidy)
奖励reward <- 基本奖励baseReward + 财政补贴treasurySubsidy // 总计total 代理人agent 支付payout
// 支票Checks-效果Effects-互动Interactions: 全部all 状态state 更新updates 之前before 转移TRANSFER
删除DELETE 任务预算taskBudgets[节点IDnodeId]
商城SSTORE 国库treasury = 国库treasury + 协议费protocolFee - 财政补贴treasurySubsidy // 网net 国库treasury: 费用fees in, 补贴subsidy 出out
商城SSTORE 保险池insurancePool = 保险池insurancePool + 保险准备金insuranceReserve
// 查找Find 使命mission 和and 更新update 定居settled 金额amount (托管escrow 仅only 封面covers 基地base + 费用fees)
任务IDmissionId <- 合作合同CollaborationContract(链接合作合同linkedCollaborationContract).获取节点的任务getMissionForNode(节点IDnodeId)
商城SSTORE 任务托管missionEscrows[任务IDmissionId].定居settled += (基本奖励baseReward + 协议费protocolFee + 保险准备金insuranceReserve)
// 定居settled <= b_i: at 磅/平方英寸psi=1.25，=1.25, 定居settled = 970 + 20 + 10 = 1000 = b_i [v]
发射发射EMIT 奖励已结算RewardSettled(代理地址agentAddr, 节点IDnodeId, 奖励reward, 基本奖励baseReward, 财政补贴treasurySubsidy, 协议费protocolFee, 保险准备金insuranceReserve)
转移TRANSFER 奖励reward to 代理地址agentAddr // 外部的external 打电话call 最后last (欧洲经济研究所CEI 图案pattern)
// 煤气Gas 分析analysis: 结算奖励settleReward() 执行performs 1 删除DELETE + 2 商城SSTORE (国库treasury, 保险池insurancePool) +
// 1 商城SSTORE (定居settled 领域field) + 2 十字cross-合同contract 呼叫CALLs (获取声誉分数getReputationScore, 获取节点的任务getMissionForNode) +
// 1 转移TRANSFER + 额外的additional 负载SLOAD (国库treasury 读read 为了for 网net 借方debit) + 分钟min/最大max 算术arithmetic 操作ops.
// 估计Estimated: 1 x 5,000 (删除DELETE/退款refund) + 3 x 20,000 (冷cold 商城SSTORE) + 1 x 2,100 (冷cold 负载SLOAD) +
// 2 x 2,500 (呼叫CALL 基地base) + 转移TRANSFER + 分钟min/最大max 操作ops ~= 60,000 气体gas. 温暖Warm-路径path (定居settled 领域field
// 已经already 书面的written): ~= 40,000 气体gas.
功能FUNCTION 计算信誉乘数computeReputationMultiplier(代理地址agentAddr: 地址address) -> uint256:
// 实施Implements 磅/平方英寸psi(罗rho) = 1 + 阿尔法alpha x (罗rho - 500) / 1000
// 退货Returns 价值value 缩放的scaled by 1000 (so 1.0 = 1000, 1.15 = 1150)
罗rho <- 代理合同AgentContract(链接代理合同linkedAgentContract).获取声誉分数getReputationScore(代理地址agentAddr)
// 中性Neutral 声誉reputation (罗rho = 500) 产量yields 磅/平方英寸psi = 1 + 阿尔法alpha x 0 = 1.0 (= 1000 缩放的scaled)
// 罗rho = 800: 磅/平方英寸psi = 1 + 0.5 x (800-500)/1000 = 1.15 (= 1150 缩放的scaled)
// 罗rho = 200: 磅/平方英寸psi = 1 + 0.5 x (200-500)/1000 = 0.85 (= 850 缩放的scaled)
IF 罗rho >= 500:
三角洲delta <- (罗rho - 500) x 声誉乘数AlphareputationMultiplierAlpha / 1000 // 积极的positive 增量increment, 缩放的scaled
返回RETURN 1000 + 三角洲delta
其他ELSE:
三角洲delta <- (500 - 罗rho) x 声誉乘数AlphareputationMultiplierAlpha / 1000 // 处罚penalty, 缩放的scaled
返回RETURN 1000 - 三角洲delta // 地板floor at 0 to 防止prevent 下溢underflow
// 煤气Gas 分析analysis: 计算信誉乘数computeReputationMultiplier() is a 读read-仅only 功能function (静态呼叫STATICCALL 符合资格eligible).
// 1 十字cross-合同contract 呼叫CALL + 算术arithmetic: ~= 2,500 (呼叫CALL) + 200 (算术arithmetic) ~= 2,700 气体gas.
// 被称为Called 内部internally 来自from 结算奖励settleReward(); 它的its 成本cost is 包括在内included in 那个that 估计estimate.
功能FUNCTION 权益池poolStake(池IDpoolId: 字节32bytes32, 金额amount: uint256):
// 代理Agent 贡献contributes to 股份stake 泳池pool to 分享share 砍伐slashing 风险risk (决心resolves IW-7)
要求REQUIRE 味精msg.价值value >= 金额amount
要求REQUIRE 金额amount > 0
泳池pool <- 权益池注册中心stakePoolRegistry[池IDpoolId]
要求REQUIRE 泳池pool.活跃的active
要求REQUIRE 泳池pool.参与者participants[味精msg.发件人sender] == 0 OR 泳池pool.参与者participants[味精msg.发件人sender] > 0
// 更新Update 参与者participant 分享share; 重新计算recalculate 基础basis 点points 按比例proportionally
上一篇ContribprevContrib <- 泳池pool.参与者participants[味精msg.发件人sender]
新总计newTotal <- 泳池pool.总质押totalStaked + 金额amount
商城SSTORE 权益池注册中心stakePoolRegistry[池IDpoolId].参与者participants[味精msg.发件人sender] = 上一篇ContribprevContrib + 金额amount
商城SSTORE 权益池注册中心stakePoolRegistry[池IDpoolId].总质押totalStaked = 新总计newTotal
// 基础Basis 点points 为了for 这个this 参与者participant: (上一篇ContribprevContrib + 金额amount) x 10000 / 新总计newTotal
商城SSTORE 权益池注册中心stakePoolRegistry[池IDpoolId].削减ShareBasisPointsslashingShareBasisPoints[味精msg.发件人sender] =
(上一篇ContribprevContrib + 金额amount) x 10000 / 新总计newTotal

结算和财务模块的 Gas 摘要。预计 200,000 Gas 的总部署成本反映了结构初始化（MissionEscrow 和 StakePool 结构定义、映射注册）和合约链接 SSTORE（3 个链接地址）Gas summary for the Settlement and Treasury modules. The total estimated deployment cost of  200,000 gas reflects the struct initialization (MissionEscrow and StakePool struct definitions, mapping registrations) and contract linkage SSTOREs (3 linked addresses×\times20,000 汽油）。每次操作成本遵循适用于所有合约类型的相同 SSTORE 计算方法：每个冷 SSTORE 花费 20,000 个 Gas；每个温暖的 SSTORE（此交易中已写入的槽位）花费 2,900 Gas；转账费用为 21,000 Gas；跨合约 CALL 基础成本为 2,500 Gas。 60,000 Gas 的 SettleReward 函数是每次操作最耗 Gas 的调用，反映了它在执行三个同步状态更新（Treasury、insurancePool、missionEscrow.settled）以及跨合约信誉查找、用于拆分源奖励计算的附加 SLOAD 和最小/最大算术以及终端 TRANSFER 中的作用。20,000 gas). Per-operation costs follow the same SSTORE-counting methodology applied to all contract types: each cold SSTORE costs 20,000 gas; each warm SSTORE (slot already written this transaction) costs 2,900 gas; TRANSFER costs 21,000 gas; cross-contract CALL base costs 2,500 gas. The settleReward function at  60,000 gas is the most gas-intensive per-operation call, reflecting its role in executing three simultaneous state updates (treasury, insurancePool, missionEscrow.settled) plus a cross-contract reputation lookup, the additional SLOAD and min/max arithmetic for split-source reward computation, and the terminal TRANSFER.

经济均衡分析。Economic Equilibrium Analysis.经济层（分布在 AgentContract 和 CollaborationContract 的结算和财务模块中）引入了四个正式的均衡条件，用于管理 AgentCity 代币经济的可持续性和参与合理性。这些方程扩展并取代了上面参与理性部分中的非正式经济分析。The economic layer (distributed across AgentContract and the CollaborationContract’s Settlement and Treasury modules) introduces four formal equilibrium conditions that govern the sustainability and participation rationality of the AgentCity token economy. These equations extend and supersede the informal economic analysis in the participation rationality section above.

EQ-10：参与理性（修订）。EQ-10: Participation Rationality (revised).对于理性参与，净奖励必须超过锁定权益的机会成本加上直接执行成本：For rational participation, the net reward must exceed the opportunity cost of locked stake plus direct execution cost:

bi×(1−fp10000−fi10000)×ψ​(ρi)>sminprod×rannual×Tmission365+Cexec\boxed{b_{i}\times\left(1-\frac{f_{p}}{10000}-\frac{f_{i}}{10000}\right)\times\psi(\rho_{i})>s_{\min}^{\text{prod}}\times r_{\text{annual}}\times\frac{T_{\text{mission}}}{365}+C_{\text{exec}}} (EQ-10)

这取代了上面参与理性小节 (EQ-8) 中的非正式分析。 EQ-8 仅描述了合理性约束的成本方面，而 EQ-10 则提供了奖励和成本的封闭式条件，从而能够直接比较权益池策略：代理人通过具有较小个人权益贡献的权益池参与This supersedes the informal analysis in the participation rationality subsection above (EQ-8). Where EQ-8 characterized only the cost side of the rationality constraint, EQ-10 provides the closed-form condition over both reward and cost, enabling direct comparison of stake-pool strategies: an agent participating through a stake pool with a smaller individual stake contributionsi<sminprods_{i}<s_{\min}^{\text{prod}}（池吸收差异）面朝较低(pool absorbs the difference) faces a lowerCoppC_{\text{opp}}因此，满足 EQ-10 要求的投标价格下限较低。因此，权益池直接扩大了可以理性参与的代理人群体。and therefore a lower bid-price floor to satisfy EQ-10. Stake pooling thus directly expands the set of agents for whom rational participation is feasible.

每月国库余额净额：Net monthly treasury balance: ≈$​51,020−$​98,725=−$​47,705\approx\mathdollar 51{,}020-\mathdollar 98{,}725=-\mathdollar 47{,}705（赤字）。在这种成熟经济情景下，财政补贴需求超过流入，产生赤字。因此，财政可持续性需要以下一项或多项： (a) 对每月补贴支出总额设定宪法上限（例如，将财政补贴流出量限制为每月财政流入量的 50%）； (b) 较低的(deficit). Under this mature-economy scenario, treasury subsidy demand exceeds inflows, yielding a deficit. Treasury sustainability therefore requires one or more of: (a) a constitutional cap on aggregate monthly subsidy disbursement (e.g., capping treasury_subsidy outflows at 50% of monthly treasury inflows); (b) a lowerα\alpha参数降低最大保费； (c) 更高的协议费率。在parameter reducing the maximum premium; or (c) higher protocol fee rates. Atα=0.25\alpha=0.25 (ψmax=1.125\psi_{\max}=1.125），稳态补贴需求下降到大约), steady-state subsidy demand drops to approximately$​48,500\mathdollar 48{,}500/月，恢复狭窄的偿付能力裕度。这种财务可持续性约束在第 6 条中作为限制进行了披露。/month, restoring a narrow solvency margin. This treasury sustainability constraint is disclosed as a limitation in §6.

合同链接。Contract Linking.部署后，合约按照立法协议进行链接，形成链上治理网格：After deployment, contracts are linked according to the legislative agreements, forming the on-chain governance mesh:

  • •

    CollaborationContract 引用 ServiceContract 来进行任务路由。CollaborationContract references ServiceContract(s) for task routing.

  • •

    CollaborationContract 的 Guardian 模块在每次 DAG 转换时执行行为审计。The CollaborationContract’s Guardian module performs behavioral audits at each DAG transition.

  • •

    验证模块控制 DAG 节点状态转换——如果没有适当层的进度证明证明，任何任务都无法前进。The Verification module gates DAG node state transitions—no task can advance without a Proof-of-Progress attestation of the appropriate tier.

  • •

    门模块在交付给任务请求者之前过滤所有输出。The Gate module filters all outputs before delivery to the mission requester.

  • •

    所有合约都引用 AgentContract 进行身份和授权检查。All contracts reference AgentContract for identity and authorization checks.

生成的契约网格是The resulting contract mesh is the可审计布线层auditable wiring layer§B.3 中确定：每个微服务绑定、每个任务依赖项、每个治理约束都记录在链上。产生线路的代理和任何单个组织都无法控制账本。人类裁决者、任何参与组织的开发人员以及自动化合规工具都可以通过检查合约状态来独立验证完整的执行拓扑。identified in §B.3: every micro-service binding, every task dependency, every governance constraint is recorded on-chain. Neither the agents that produced the wiring nor any single organization controls the ledger. Human adjudicators, developers from any participating organization, and automated compliance tools can independently verify the full execution topology by examining the contract state.

B.4 动机和架构位置Motivation and architectural position

AgentCity v0.26 实现了经济激励模型的“棒”面：注册质押（EQ-6）作为 Sybil 屏障；每个任务托管（lockStake/releaseStake/slashStake）作为背叛威慑；以及联盟调整的威慑界限（EQ-2 到 EQ-4）。 v0.26 缺少的是“胡萝卜”方面：成功完成任务的奖励分配机制、正式的代币市场、具有支付规则的财政经济学、声誉对经济的反馈以及稳态宏观经济均衡分析。AgentCity v0.26 implemented the "stick" side of the economic incentive model: registration staking (EQ-6) as a Sybil barrier; per-task escrow (lockStake/releaseStake/slashStake) as a defection deterrent; and the coalition-adjusted deterrence bound (EQ-2 through EQ-4). What v0.26 lacked was the "carrot" side: a reward distribution mechanism for successful task completion, a formalized token marketplace, treasury economics with disbursement rules, reputation-to-economic feedback, and steady-state macro-economic equilibrium analysis.

v0.27 中引入的经济层（并在 v0.29 中合并到四合约架构中）通过在 AgentContract（代理级经济状态）和 CollaborationContract 的结算和财务模块（任务级和协议级功能）之间分配经济功能来缩小这一差距。该设计借鉴了三个互补框架： 用于多主体协调的区块链增强激励兼容机制The Economic Layer introduced in v0.27 (and consolidated in v0.29 into the four-contract architecture) closes this gap by distributing economic functions across the AgentContract (agent-level economic state) and the CollaborationContract’s Settlement and Treasury modules (mission-level and protocol-level functions). The design draws on three complementary frameworks: blockchain-enhanced incentive-compatible mechanisms for multi-agent coordination[58], 通过重新抵押实现加密经济安全, cryptoeconomic security via restaking[59]，以及用于结构化代币经济设计的代币经济设计方法（TEDM）, and the Token Economy Design Method (TEDM) for structured tokenomics design[60]。经济层是. The economic layer is不notSoP 模型的一个单独分支。它是一个跨领域的经济基础，在现有的三分支结构内运作：a separate branch of the SoP model. It is a cross-cutting economic substrate that operates within the existing three-branch structure:

  • •

    立法Legislation通过 DepositMissionBudget() 和 allocateTaskBudget() 定义任务预算、协商任务价格并设置经济参数。defines mission budgets, negotiates task prices, and sets economic parameters via depositMissionBudget() and allocateTaskBudget().

  • •

    执行ExecutionPoP验证成功后，通过settleReward()触发奖励结算。triggers reward settlements upon PoP verification success via settleReward().

  • •

    裁决Adjudication设置费用表和宪法参数（protocolFeeRate、insuranceReserveRate、reputationMultiplierAlpha），通过 ClaimInsurance() 解决支付纠纷，并通过 disburse() 授权国库支出。sets fee schedules and constitutional parameters (protocolFeeRate, insuranceReserveRate, reputationMultiplierAlpha), resolves payment disputes via claimInsurance(), and authorizes treasury disbursements via disburse().
