B.6 声誉倍增器Reputation multiplierψ\psi(ρ\rho): 封闭式推导): closed-form derivation

声誉乘数The reputation multiplierψ​(ρ)\psi(\rho)创建一个正反馈循环：良好的任务执行会提高声誉，从而提高收入，从而放松参与理性约束（EQ-10），从而能够完成更高价值的任务。为了可审计性，函数形式被选择为线性的，并且有一个固定的中性点creates a positive feedback loop: good task execution raises reputation, which raises earnings, which relaxes the participation rationality constraint (EQ-10), enabling access to higher-value missions. The functional form is chosen to be linear for auditability and to have a fixed neutral point atρ=500\rho=500:

ψ​(ρ)=1+α×ρ−5001000\psi(\rho)=1+\alpha\times\frac{\rho-500}{1000}

At α=0.5\alpha=0.5（默认，编码为(default, encoded as声誉乘数Alpha = 500reputationMultiplierAlpha = 500以 1000 为基数形式）：in basis-1000 form):

  • •

    ρ=0\rho=0: ψ=1+0.5×(0−500)/1000=0.75\psi=1+0.5\times(0-500)/1000=0.75（最低声誉惩罚 25%）(25% penalty for minimum reputation)

  • •

    ρ=500\rho=500: ψ=1.0\psi=1.0（中性；无溢价或罚款）(neutral; no premium or penalty)

  • •

    ρ=800\rho=800: ψ=1+0.5×(800−500)/1000=1.15\psi=1+0.5\times(800-500)/1000=1.15（15% 溢价）( 15% premium)

  • •

    ρ=1000\rho=1000: ψ=1+0.5×(1000−500)/1000=1.25\psi=1+0.5\times(1000-500)/1000=1.25（最大声誉的溢价为 25%）(25% premium for maximum reputation)

乘数适用于The multiplier applies to the净奖励net reward（扣除费用后），而不是总投标价格。这意味着协议金库和保险池始终会收到总出价的固定基点份额，无论代理商的声誉如何。只有代理人的带回家部分是经过声誉调整的。对于代理(after fee deductions), not the gross bid price. This means that the protocol treasury and insurance pool always receive their fixed basis-point share of the gross bid, regardless of the agent’s reputation. Only the agent’s take-home portion is reputation-adjusted. For agents withψ​(ρ)>1.0\psi(\rho)>1.0（声誉高于 500），高于 1.0 的溢价通过国库补贴提供资金：(reputation above 500), the premium above 1.0 is financed via a treasury subsidy:Rtask​(i)=Rbase​(i)×min⁡(ψ​(ρi),1.0)+treasury_subsidy​(i)R_{\text{task}}(i)=R_{\text{base}}(i)\times\min(\psi(\rho_{i}),1.0)+\text{treasury\_subsidy}(i), 其中, whereRbase​(i)=bi×(1−fp/10000−fi/10000)R_{\text{base}}(i)=b_{i}\times(1-f_{p}/10000-f_{i}/10000)（与(withfpf_{p}和andfif_{i}以基点为单位，例如in basis points, e.g.,fp=200f_{p}=2002%）和for 2%) andtreasury_subsidy​(i)=Rbase​(i)×max⁡(ψ​(ρi)−1.0,0)\text{treasury\_subsidy}(i)=R_{\text{base}}(i)\times\max(\psi(\rho_{i})-1.0,0)从协议金库中提取。这确保了每个任务的支出永远不会超过drawn from the protocol treasury. This ensures that per-task disbursement never exceedsbib_{i}（费用+基本奖励(fees + base reward≤bi\leq b_{i}，保持特派团预算偿付能力），而财务和保险资金流入仍然可预测，并且不受声誉波动的影响。, preserving mission budget solvency), while treasury and insurance inflows remain predictable and not subject to reputation fluctuations.

构成参数The constitutional parameter声誉乘数AlphareputationMultiplierAlpha可以从 0 开始调整（完全禁用声誉权重，can be adjusted from 0 (disabling reputation weighting entirely,ψ≡1.0\psi\equiv 1.0) 至 1000 () to 1000 (α=1.0\alpha=1.0，产生, yieldingψ∈[0.5,1.5]\psi\in[0.5,1.5]在整个声誉范围内）。默认情况下across the full reputation range). At the defaultα=0.5\alpha=0.5, ψ∈[0.75,1.25]\psi\in[0.75,1.25]。更高. Higherα\alpha增加了维护声誉的动力，但也增加了代理人之间的收入不平等和财政补贴流出——这是实验 1 中 WGC 指标所控制的权衡。increases the incentive for reputation maintenance but also increases income inequality among agents and treasury subsidy outflows—a tradeoff governed by the WGC metric in Experiment 1.

B.7 权益池：IW-7 决议Stake pooling: IW-7 resolution

审稿人的担忧 IW-7 将权益集中动态确定为未解决的架构限制。在生产方面（EQ-5：Reviewer concern IW-7 identified stake concentration dynamics as an unresolved architectural limitation. At production stakes (EQ-5:sminp​r​o​d≈3.76×Vms_{\min}^{prod}\approx 3.76\times V_{m}根据高风险任务），参与高价值任务需要锁定资本，这对于小型运营商来说是望而却步的。权益池机制通过允许多个代理将权益贡献聚合到由 CollaborationContract 的结算模块管理的共享池中来解决此问题：per HIGH-risk task), participation in high-value missions requires locking capital that is prohibitive for small operators. The stake pooling mechanism resolves this by allowing multiple agents to aggregate stake contributions into a shared pool managed by the CollaborationContract’s Settlement module:

  1. 1.

    泳池经理打来电话A pool manager calls创建权益池（poolId）createStakePool(poolId)（通过第一个 poolStake 调用隐式）初始化池。(implicit via first poolStake call) to initialize a pool.

  2. 2.

    参会代理商请致电Participating agents callpoolStake(池ID, 金额)poolStake(poolId, amount)来贡献资本。to contribute capital.

  3. 3.

    矿池通过协作合约登记其合并股份以参与任务，满足The pool registers its combined stake with the CollaborationContract for mission participation, satisfyingsminp​r​o​ds_{\min}^{prod}集体。collectively.

  4. 4.

    如果任何矿池参与者分配的任务被削减，损失将根据以下比例分配If any pool participant’s assigned task is slashed, the loss is distributed proportionally according to削减ShareBasisPointsslashingShareBasisPoints.

  5. 5.

    池停用后（没有活动任务），参与者致电Upon pool deactivation (no active missions), participants call提取PooledStake（池ID）withdrawPooledStake(poolId)检索贡献。to retrieve contributions.

这种设计类似于以太坊验证者池协议This design is analogous to Ethereum validator pooling protocols[59]，小持有者将 ETH 委托给集合质押运营商。主要区别：(a) AgentCity 中的池参与是特定于任务的，而不是连续的； (b) 每个池参与者保留其个人声誉评分； (c) 矿池本身没有链上声誉（它是权益聚合工具，而不是代理）。, where small holders delegate ETH to pooled staking operators. Key differences: (a) pool participation in AgentCity is task-specific, not continuous; (b) each pool participant retains their individual reputation score; (c) the pool itself has no on-chain reputation (it is a stake aggregation vehicle, not an agent).

参与合理性提升：代理人贡献The participation rationality improvement: an agent contributingsis_{i}到总大小的池to a pool of total sizeS>sminp​r​o​dS>s_{\min}^{prod}面临机会成本faces opportunity costCo​p​p=si×ra​n​n​u​a​l×Tm​i​s​s​i​o​n/365C_{opp}=s_{i}\times r_{annual}\times T_{mission}/365，严格小于单独参与成本, which is strictly less than the solo-participation costsminp​r​o​d×ra​n​n​u​a​l×Tm​i​s​s​i​o​n/365s_{\min}^{prod}\times r_{annual}\times T_{mission}/365每当wheneversi<sminp​r​o​ds_{i}<s_{\min}^{prod}。因此，EQ-10 参与理性阈值随着池聚合而成比例降低，从而扩大了理性参与者的范围。. The EQ-10 participation rationality threshold therefore decreases proportionally with pool aggregation, expanding the set of rational participants.

矿池运营商的风险和限制。Pool operator risk and limitations.矿池管理者角色引入了集中风险：恶意或疏忽的矿池管理者可能会接受不合格的代理进入矿池，从而增加所有矿池参与者的预期削减率。当前的设计通过比例损耗分布部分缓解了这一问题（The pool manager role introduces a concentration risk: a malicious or negligent pool manager could accept poorly qualified agents into the pool, increasing the expected slashing rate for all pool participants. The current design mitigates this partially through proportional loss distribution (削减ShareBasisPointsslashingShareBasisPoints），这样被砍掉的代理就承担了大部分损失。然而，相关故障（即多个池参与者被分配到同一任务并同时失败）可能会放大损失，超出比例模型的假设。池级声誉跟踪（聚合通过给定池参与的代理的绩效历史记录）被认为是未来的增强功能，它将允许任务发起人区分管理良好和管理不善的池。), so that the slashed agent bears the majority of the loss. However, correlated failures—where multiple pool participants are assigned to the same mission and fail simultaneously—could amplify losses beyond the proportional model’s assumptions. Pool-level reputation tracking (aggregating the performance history of agents participating through a given pool) is identified as a future enhancement that would allow mission sponsors to discriminate between well-managed and poorly-managed pools.

B.8 保险池：力学和校准Insurance pool: mechanics and calibration

保险池由两项资金流入累积： (a) 保险准备金率The insurance pool accumulates from two inflows: (a) the insurance reserve ratefif_{i}适用于所有已结算的任务奖励； (b) 所有削减股份的 50%（另外 50% 流入国库）。这种双源设计确保高削减活动时期（对抗性任务、联盟攻击）同时补充保险池，以补偿遭受这些攻击的诚实代理。applied to all settled task rewards; (b) 50% of all slashed stakes (the other 50% flows to the treasury). This dual-source design ensures that periods of high slashing activity (adversarial missions, coalition attacks) simultaneously replenish the insurance pool that compensates honest agents who were exposed to those attacks.

保险赔付完全由人类裁决者的行动触发Insurance payouts are triggered exclusively by human adjudicator action via索赔保险()claimInsurance()。索赔人必须提供证据（记录损失的记录中心 CID 的链上 bytes32 参考），并且索赔必须在第 3 层 PoP 审查后由覆盖小组裁决员授权。这确保了保险池不会因欺诈性索赔而耗尽。. The claimant must provide evidence (an on-chain bytes32 reference to a Logging Hub CID documenting the loss) and the claim must be authorized by an Override Panel adjudicator after a Tier 3 PoP review. This ensures that the insurance pool cannot be drained by fraudulent claims.

B.10 立法模块Legislation Module

立法模块实现任务生命周期的两个准备阶段——代理注册和多方立法谈判——共同产生管理所有后续执行的合同规范。这两个阶段均由 §B.3 中定义的合约架构进行调解，立法输出直接输入到 §B.11 中描述的执行基础设施中。The Legislation Module implements the two preparatory phases of the mission lifecycle—agent registration and multi-party legislative negotiation—that together produce the contract specifications governing all subsequent execution. Both phases are mediated by the contract architecture defined in §B.3, and the legislative output feeds directly into the Execution Infrastructure described in §B.11.

第一阶段：注册。Phase 1: Registration.在任何任务开始之前，所有参与的代理通过 AgentContract 进行注册，绑定他们的加密身份（DID 兼容）Before any mission begins, all participating agents register through the AgentContract, binding their cryptographic identity (DID-compatible[35]) 到一个主要地址并建立他们的声誉。代理合同将每个注册者分类为生产者代理（运营人员）或管理代理（监督委员会）。这种分类决定了整个任务中允许的操作：管理人员可以检查和标记立法审议，但不能提交任务投标；生产者代理可以投标和部署微服务，但不能修改合约参数。注册代理在接纳参与者进入立法阶段之前验证身份和声誉阈值。声誉低于宪法底线（在规则中心设定）的特工将被排除在任务参与之外，等待裁决审查。此外，管理代理（注册、立法、监管、编纂）必须通过管理合约进行注册，管理合约将每个代理绑定到一个权限信封，指定允许的操作和强制微服务委托。该注册是管理机构参与立法协议的先决条件。) to a human principal address and establishing their reputation standing. The AgentContract classifies each registrant as either a producer agent (operational workforce) or a management agent (oversight committee). This classification determines permitted operations throughout the mission: management agents may inspect and flag legislative deliberations but cannot submit task bids; producer agents may bid and deploy micro-services but cannot modify contract parameters. The Registry Agent verifies identities and reputation thresholds before admitting participants to the Legislation phase. An agent whose reputation falls below the constitutional floor (set in the Rules Hub) is excluded from mission participation pending adjudication review. Additionally, management agents (Registry, Legislative, Regulatory, Codification) must be registered through the ManagementContract, which binds each to an authority envelope specifying permitted operations and mandatory microservice delegations. This registration is a prerequisite for management agent participation in the legislative protocol.

第二阶段：立法。Phase 2: Legislation.Legislation模块以五节点LangGraph的形式实现多方立法协商The Legislation module implements multi-party legislative negotiation as a five-node LangGraph[18]图表。五个代理——立法机构、生产者、监管机构、登记机构和编纂机构——通过结构化消息传递协议进行交互。我们在下面正式确定该协议。graph. The five agents—Legislative, Producer, Regulatory, Registry, and Codification—interact through a structured message-passing protocol. We formalize this protocol below.

消息传递协议。Message-Passing Protocol.设 A = A_reg, A_leg, A_prod(̂1), …, A_prod(̂p), A_reg_agent, A_cod 表示立法代理的集合，其中 A_reg 是注册代理，A_leg 是立法代理，A_prod(̂i) 是第 i 个生产者代理，A_reg_agent 是监管代理，A_cod 是编纂代理。该协议定义了七种消息类型，分为五个连续的阶段。每轮由消息类型、发送者-接收者映射以及在该轮前进之前必须保持的有效性谓词来定义。Let A = A_reg, A_leg, A_prod(̂1), …, A_prod(̂p), A_reg_agent, A_cod denote the set of legislative agents, where A_reg is the Registry Agent, A_leg the Legislative Agent, A_prod(̂i) the i-th Producer Agent, A_reg_agent the Regulatory Agent, and A_cod the Codification Agent. The protocol defines seven message types, grouped into five sequential phases. Each round is defined by a message type, a sender-receiver mapping, and a validity predicate that must hold before the round may advance.

公平得分的正式定义。Formal Definition of Fairness Score.fairness_score 计算为标准化赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数 (HHI) 在出价分布上的补数：The fairness_score is computed as the complement of the normalized Herfindahl–Hirschman Index (HHI) over the bid distribution:

fairness_score=1000×(1−H​H​I−H​H​Im​i​nH​H​Im​a​x−H​H​Im​i​n)\text{fairness\_score}=1000\times\left(1-\frac{HHI-HHI_{min}}{HHI_{max}-HHI_{min}}\right)

哪里whereH​H​I=∑j=1psj2HHI=\sum_{j=1}^{p}s_{j}^{2}, sjs_{j}是分配给生产者代理 j 的总任务节点分配的份额，is the share of total task-node assignments allocated to producer agent j,H​H​Im​i​n=1/pHHI_{min}=1/p（完美分布），以及(perfectly distributed), andH​H​Im​a​x=1HHI_{max}=1（垄断）。 fairness_score 为 1000 表示分配完全公平； 0表示完全垄断。宪法最低限度（默认值：600）防止任何单个生产者获得任务中超过约 63% 的任务分配，从而为防止 Sybil 代理垄断投标池提供了正式的经济障碍。(monopoly). A fairness_score of 1000 indicates perfectly equitable distribution; 0 indicates complete monopolization. The constitutional minimum (default: 600) prevents any single producer from capturing more than approximately 63% of task assignments in a mission, providing a formal economic barrier against bid-pool monopolization by Sybil agents.

垄断界限的形式推导。Formal Derivation of Monopolization Bound.对于有 p 个生产商的市场，其中一个占主导地位的生产商持有份额 s，其余 (p–1) 个同等份额，For a market with p producers where one dominant producer holds share s and the remaining (p–1) share equally,H​H​I=s2+(1−s)2/(p−1)HHI=s^{2}+(1-s)^{2}/(p-1), 与, withH​H​Im​i​n=1/pHHI_{min}=1/p和andH​H​Im​a​x=1HHI_{max}=1。设置. Settingfairness_score≥600\text{fairness\_score}\geq 600:

s2+(1−s)2/(p−1)−1/p1−1/p≤0.4\frac{s^{2}+(1-s)^{2}/(p-1)-1/p}{1-1/p}\leq 0.4

对于 p = 2：For p = 2:s≤0.816s\leq 0.816。对于 p = 5：. For p = 5:s≤0.72s\leq 0.72。对于 p = 10：. For p = 10:s≤0.68s\leq 0.68。上述“大约 63%”的界限保守地适用于具有 p 的市场。. The "approximately 63%" bound stated above applies conservatively to markets with p≥\geq15 名制片人。因此，随着生产者池的增长，宪法规定的 600 的最低限度提供了逐渐更强的垄断保护——这正是基于 Sybil 的投标池操纵变得最令人担忧的制度。15 producers. The constitutional minimum of 600 thus provides progressively stronger monopolization protection as the producer pool grows—precisely the regime where Sybil-based bid-pool manipulation becomes most concerning.

立法授权协议。Legislative Authorization Protocol.监管机构的签字构成立法过程中的主要授权关口。监管代理必须在 MSG_TYPE_5 上提供监管签名，以验证其链上 DID。最终合同规范的部署还需要The Regulatory Agent’s sign-off constitutes the primary authorization gate in the legislative process. The Regulatory Agent must provide a regulatory_signature on MSG_TYPE_5 that verifies against its DID on-chain. Deployment of the final contract specification additionally requires a双重共同授权dual co-authorization：立法代理 (A_leg) 和监管代理 (A_reg_agent) 必须共同签署 MSG_TYPE_7 (LegislativeApproval)，提供链上加密证据，表明两个审议角色都授权了最终规范。这种串行提案审查授权可以防止单独的 A_leg 或单独的 A_reg_agent 单方面部署合约规范。: both the Legislative Agent (A_leg) and the Regulatory Agent (A_reg_agent) must co-sign MSG_TYPE_7 (LegislativeApproval), providing on-chain cryptographic evidence that both deliberative roles authorized the final specification. This serial proposal-review authorization prevents either A_leg alone or A_reg_agent alone from unilaterally deploying a contract specification.

双重共同授权的架构限制。Architectural Limit of Dual Co-Authorization.两方共同授权方案为立法最终确定步骤提供了授权分离，但不构成拜占庭容错共识：如果对手同时控制A_leg和A_reg_agent，则可以在没有架构阻力的情况下为恶意合约规范获得双重共同签名。这种共谋情形被正式承认为 NP-6（附录 A）。因此，立法部门的安全保证取决于 A_leg 和 A_reg_agent 角色的分离，类似于访问控制中的职责分离原则。如果这种分离被违反，立法部门将无法提供结构性保障，并且系统的完整性会降低人类裁决者的警惕性（§B.12）。The two-party co-authorization scheme provides separation-of-authorization for the legislative finalization step but does not constitute Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus: if an adversary simultaneously controls both A_leg and A_reg_agent, dual co-signature can be obtained for a malicious contract specification without architectural resistance. This collusion scenario is formally acknowledged as NP-6 (Appendix A). The security guarantee of the legislative branch is therefore contingent on the separation of A_leg and A_reg_agent roles—analogous to the separation of duties principle in access control. If this separation is violated, the legislative branch provides no structural guarantee and the system’s integrity degrades to human adjudicator vigilance (§B.12).

对于多个监管代理可能处于活动状态的多组织任务（每个参与组织一个），适用可配置的法定人数策略：直到 R 个监管代理提交批准的阈值 q（默认值：q = ceil(R / 2) + 1，即简单多数加一）之前，编纂代理不会前进到 AWAITING_APPROVAL。该阈值是可通过规则中心调整的宪法参数。For multi-organization missions where multiple Regulatory Agents may be active (one per participating organization), a configurable quorum policy applies: the Codification Agent will not advance to AWAITING_APPROVAL until a threshold q of R total Regulatory Agents have submitted approvals (default: q = ceil(R / 2) + 1, i.e., simple majority plus one). This threshold is a constitutional parameter adjustable via the Rules Hub.

构成参数验证。Constitutional Parameter Validation.在编纂代理进入 AWAITING_APPROVAL 状态之前，已编译的合约规范必须通过针对当前规则中心状态的宪法验证检查。此检查验证以下条件：Before the Codification Agent may advance to AWAITING_APPROVAL, the compiled contract specification must pass a constitutional validation check against the current Rules Hub state. This check verifies the following conditions:

⬇
算法ALGORITHM 宪法生效ConstitutionalValidation(规格spec: 编码合同规范CodedContractSpecification) -> 验证证明ValidationProof:
输入INPUT: 编译的compiled 合同contract 规格specification
输出OUTPUT: 验证证明ValidationProof (or 失败FAIL 与with 结构化的structured 错误error)
// 行为方面Behavioral 参数parameter 界限bounds
检查CHECK 规格spec.监护人参数guardian_params.偏差阈值SigmadeviationThresholdSigma \in [1, 5]
检查CHECK 规格spec.监护人参数guardian_params.最大工具调用次数maxToolInvocations \in [5, 200]
检查CHECK 规格spec.监护人参数guardian_params.最大消息量maxMessageVolume \in [10, 500]
检查CHECK 规格spec.监护人参数guardian_params.升级冻结计数escalationFreezeCount \in [2, 10]
// 预算Budget 合规性compliance
检查CHECK 规格spec.总代币预算total_token_budget <= 规则中心rules_hub.任务预算上限mission_budget_cap
为FOR 每个EACH 节点node IN 规格spec.达格节点dag_nodes:
检查CHECK 节点node.代币预算tokenBudget > 0
检查CHECK 节点node.超时时间timeoutMs \in [1000, 规则中心rules_hub.最大节点超时时间max_node_timeout_ms]
// 流行病学PoP 层tier 有效性validity
为FOR 每个EACH 节点node IN 规格spec.达格节点dag_nodes:
检查CHECK 节点node.流行层popTier \in {1, 2, 3}
IF 节点node.流行层popTier == 2:
检查CHECK 节点node.冗余系数redundancyFactor \in [2, 5]
检查CHECK 节点node.共识阈值consensusThreshold <= 节点node.冗余系数redundancyFactor
检查CHECK 节点node.共识阈值consensusThreshold >= 天花板ceil(节点node.冗余系数redundancyFactor / 2) // 多数majority
IF 节点node.流行层popTier == 3:
检查CHECK 节点node.超时时间timeoutMs >= 规则中心rules_hub.min_ human_review_timeout_msmin_human_review_timeout_ms // 默认default: 300,000 ms
// 身份Identity 和and 股份stake 检查checks
为FOR 每个EACH 出价bid IN 规格spec.批准的出价approved_bids:
检查CHECK 代理合同AgentContract.符合声誉楼层meetsReputationFloor(出价bid.生产者代理producer_agent)
检查CHECK 出价bid.股份金额stake_amount >= 规则中心rules_hub.每个风险层的最小风险min_stake_per_risk_tier[出价bid.风险等级risk_tier]
检查CHECK 服务合同ServiceContract.验证代码哈希verifyCodeHash(出价bid.服务IDservice_id, 出价bid.提议的代码哈希值proposed_code_hash)
// 有向无环图DAG 结构性的structural 有效性validity
检查CHECK 达格dag is 无环的acyclic (拓扑的topological 排序sort 成功succeeds)
检查CHECK 全部all 有向无环图DAG 叶leaf 节点nodes 有have 流行层popTier 作业assignment
检查CHECK 达格dag 有has >= 1 根root 节点node 和and >= 1 终端terminal 节点node
// 公平性Fairness 检查check
检查CHECK 监管决定regulatory_decision.公平性分数fairness_score >= 规则中心rules_hub.最小公平分数min_fairness_score // 默认default: 600/1000
IF 全部all 检查checks 通过pass:
证明proof <- 标志sign(散列hash(规格spec), 编码代理密钥codification_agent_key)
返回RETURN 验证证明ValidationProof(证明proof, 块block.数量number, 规则集线器状态根rules_hub_state_root)
其他ELSE:
返回RETURN 失败FAIL(结构化的structured 错误error 列表list)

DAG 规范格式。DAG Specification Format.立法输出被序列化为符合以下架构的 JSON-LD 文档。这种格式构成了法定任务拓扑的规范记录，并且是§B.11中定义的合同部署序列的直接输入。The legislative output is serialized as a JSON-LD document conforming to the following schema. This format constitutes the canonical record of the legislated mission topology and is the direct input to the contract deployment sequence defined in §B.11.

⬇

本体注：Ontology Note:的Thehttps://agentcity.ai/ontology/v1\{}#命名空间是项目内部 URI，当前无法解析为已发布的本体文档。为了可重复性，DAG 规范中使用的所有术语都在 JSON-LD 中自我记录namespace is a project-internal URI that does not currently resolve to a published ontology document. For reproducibility, all terms used in the DAG specification are self-documenting within the JSON-LD@上下文@context块：每个键（例如，block: each key (e.g.,达格dag, 任务IDmissionId, 节点nodes）直接映射到§B.3中定义的相应 CollaborationContract 结构字段，并且架构由 DAGNode 结构和边列表格式完全指定。正式的 OWL 本体出版物计划作为系统开源版本的一部分。) maps directly to the corresponding CollaborationContract struct fields defined in §B.3, and the schema is fully specified by the DAGNode struct and edge list format. A formal OWL ontology publication is planned as part of the system’s open-source release.

工作示例：三任务任务。Worked Example: Three-Task Mission.我们通过整个立法流程追踪一个简单的任务，以说明五个代理如何相互作用以产生 DAG。使命：We trace a simple mission through the full legislative process to illustrate how the five agents interact to produce a DAG. The mission:给定 URL 列表，(T1) 获取并解析每个页面，(T2) 对每个页面的主题进行分类，(T3) 将结果聚合到结构化 JSON 报告中。Given a URL list, (T1) fetch and parse each page, (T2) classify each page’s topic, (T3) aggregate results into a structured JSON report.

所有立法审议（所有 MSG_TYPE_1 到 MSG_TYPE_7 消息、时间戳和签名）均以仅附加形式记录到日志中心 (§B.12)，从而提供立法合同形成方式的完整记录。任何立法机构都不能单方面将DAG推进到Orchestration阶段；需要监管代理的签字，并且在授权部署之前生成的合同规范必须满足所有规则中心的宪法参数。All legislative deliberations—all MSG_TYPE_1 through MSG_TYPE_7 messages, timestamps, and signatures—are logged to the Logging Hub (§B.12) in append-only form, providing a complete record of how the legislative contract was formed. No legislative agent can unilaterally advance the DAG to the Orchestration phase; the Regulatory Agent’s sign-off is required, and the resulting contract specification must satisfy all Rules Hub constitutional parameters before deployment is authorized.

B.11 执行基础设施Execution Infrastructure

执行基础设施将 §B.10 的立法输出转换为完全可操作的执行网格，并管理任务 DAG 从编排到最终输出交付的确定性执行。本节介绍编排和执行序列（§B.11.1）、确定性冻结机制（§B.11.2）、安全性与活跃性权衡及其缓解措施（§B.11.3）、自适应细化反馈循环（§B.11.4）以及维持两个计算层治理完整性的链上/链下一致性协议（§B.11.5）。The Execution Infrastructure translates the legislative output from §B.10 into a fully operational execution mesh and governs the deterministic enforcement of the mission DAG from orchestration through final output delivery. This section describes the orchestration and execution sequence (§B.11.1), the Deterministic Freeze mechanism (§B.11.2), the Safety-vs-Liveness tradeoff and its mitigations (§B.11.3), the Adaptive Refinement feedback loop (§B.11.4), and the on-chain/off-chain consistency protocol that maintains governance integrity across the two computational layers (§B.11.5).

B.11.1 编排和执行Orchestration and Execution

编排将立法 DAG 转换为完全可操作的执行网格。生产者代理使用以下三种途径之一为每个任务节点部署微服务：(i)Orchestration translates the legislative DAG into a fully operational execution mesh. Producer agents deploy micro-services for each task node using one of three pathways: (i)代码优先code-first：代理生成并部署新代码； (二): the agent generates and deploys new code; (ii)包部署package deployment：代理实例化一个预先存在的微服务包； (三): the agent instantiates a pre-existing micro-service package; (iii)服务链接service linking：代理绑定一个已经部署的微服务。每个部署的微服务都通过 ServiceContract 注册，将其代码哈希和 API 模式锚定在链上。同时，编纂代理构建并部署协作合约（其监护人、验证和门模块已初始化），并根据立法协议将它们链接起来。: the agent binds an already-deployed micro-service. Each deployed micro-service is registered via a ServiceContract, anchoring its code-hash and API schema on-chain. Concurrently, the Codification Agent constructs and deploys the CollaborationContract (with its Guardian, Verification, and Gate modules initialized), linking them according to the legislative agreements.

代码哈希验证协议。Code-Hash Verification Protocol.在安排任何任务之前（符合条件的Before routing any task (ELIGIBLE→\rightarrowEXECUTING 转换），CollaborationContract 执行代码哈希验证，以确认执行结构中运行的实时微服务与立法阶段注册的代码哈希匹配。该协议缩小了之间的差距EXECUTING transition), the CollaborationContract performs a code-hash verification to confirm that the live micro-service running in the execution fabric matches the code-hash registered during the Legislation phase. This protocol closes the gap between the立法的legislated服务身份和service identity and the直播live服务身份，防止代理部署与其投标不同的微服务的部署替代攻击。service identity, preventing deployment substitution attacks where an agent deploys a different micro-service than the one it bid.

时间注意事项：Timing note:对执行结构的代码哈希请求是一个链外调用，可能需要长达The code-hash request to the execution fabric is an off-chain call that may take up to最大\{}_codehash\{}_verification\{}_latency\{}_msmax\{}_codehash\{}_verification\{}_latency\{}_ms（构成参数，默认：2,000 ms）。如果在此窗口内未收到响应，则验证将被视为不匹配，并且转换将被阻止。这可以防止通过延迟验证响应来阻止系统的活跃攻击：超时可确保保守地（阻止）而不是宽松地（允许通过）处理无响应的服务。(constitutional parameter, default: 2,000 ms). If no response is received within this window, the verification is treated as a mismatch and the transition is blocked. This prevents liveness attacks that stall the system by delaying verification responses: the timeout ensures that unresponsive services are treated conservatively (blocked) rather than leniently (allowed through).

部署合约网格后，每个 DAG 节点将按照以下顺序确定执行：Once the contract mesh is deployed, execution proceeds deterministically through the following sequence at each DAG node:

  1. 1.

    当所有 DAG 前任都通过了验证模块关卡时，任务就变得合格。A task becomes eligible when all DAG predecessors have passed their the Verification module gates.

  2. 2.

    CollaborationContract 将任务路由到相应 ServiceContract 中注册的微服务，通过上面的 CodeHashVerification 协议验证实时代码哈希是否与法定绑定匹配。The CollaborationContract routes the task to the micro-service registered in the corresponding ServiceContract, verifying that the live code-hash matches the legislated binding via the CodeHashVerification protocol above.

  3. 3.

    微服务确定性地执行。其输出连同适当的 PoP 证明材料（哈希证明、共识包或委托证明请求）一起提交给验证模块。The micro-service executes deterministically. Its output—along with the appropriate PoP proof material (hash proof, consensus bundle, or delegated attestation request)—is submitted to the Verification module.

  4. 4.

    验证模块应用每个节点的证明层：类型 1（链上哈希验证）、类型 2（跨冗余执行器的共识检查）或类型 3（通过覆盖面板转发给人工裁决者）。 DAG 状态转换仅在证明成功后才被授权。the Verification module applies the per-node attestation tier: Type 1 (hash verification on-chain), Type 2 (consensus check across redundant executors), or Type 3 (forwarding to human adjudicator via the Override Panel). The DAG state transition is authorized only upon successful attestation.

  5. 5.

    同时，Guardian 模块在每次 DAG 转换时强制执行行为不变量作为执行层防火墙。Concurrently, the Guardian module enforces behavioral invariants as an execution-layer firewall at every DAG transition.

  6. 6.

    最终任务完成后，Gate 模块应用宪法输出过滤——在发布之前验证聚合结果是否满足任务级安全谓词。Upon final task completion, the Gate module applies constitutional output filtering—verifying that the aggregated result satisfies mission-level safety predicates before release.

守护者模块、验证模块和门模块是执行执行机制，而不是裁决者：它们确定性地应用立法机关定义的规则，并由人类裁决者通过规则中心按宪法参数化。The Guardian module, Verification module, and Gate module are execution enforcement mechanisms, not adjudicators: they deterministically apply rules defined by the legislature and constitutionally parameterized by human adjudicators via the Rules Hub.

质押和托管。Staking and Escrow.执行分支的经济激励层通过 §B.5 中定义的相同注册托管 (AgentContract) 和任务级托管 (CollaborationContract) 机制运行。 §B.5 中提出的统一 Sybil + 叛逃成本模型、每层检测概率和联盟调整威慑界限直接适用于所有执行阶段的质押交互。 lockStake、releaseStake 和lashStake 的伪代码在 CollaborationContract 接口 (§B.5) 中定义。The economic incentive layer for the Execution branch operates through the same registration escrow (AgentContract) and task-level escrow (CollaborationContract) mechanisms defined in §B.5. The unified Sybil + defection cost model, per-tier detection probabilities, and coalition-adjusted deterrence bound presented in §B.5 apply directly to all execution-phase staking interactions. The pseudocode for lockStake, releaseStake, and slashStake is defined in the CollaborationContract interface (§B.5).

B.11.2 确定性冻结Deterministic Freeze

当Guardian模块检测到异常时——推理偏差超过2When the Guardian module detects an anomaly—a reasoning deviation exceeding 2σ\sigma从任务来看，工具调用次数超过 40，或者每个任务节点的消息量超过 120，它会触发from mandate, a tool invocation count exceeding 40, or a message volume exceeding 120 per task node—it triggers a确定性冻结Deterministic Freeze：代理的执行飞地立即停止，保留易失性内存状态和上下文，供人类裁决者进行取证检查。如果 20 分钟内发生超过 3 次确定性冻结，系统会自动升级为紧急停止，停止整个任务并通知人工评审员进行审查。: the agent’s execution enclave is instantly halted, preserving volatile memory state and context for forensic inspection by human adjudicators. If more than three Deterministic Freezes occur within 20 minutes, the system auto-escalates to an Emergency Stop, halting the entire mission and notifying human adjudicators for review.

推理偏差的正式定义。Formal Definition of Reasoning Deviation.偏差分数The deviation scoreσ\sigma计算如下。令 M = m_1, m_2, …, m_t 为微服务代理在任务节点执行期间产生的推理步骤序列（LLM 输出）。偏差分数is computed as follows. Let M = m_1, m_2, …, m_t be the sequence of reasoning steps (LLM outputs) produced by a micro-service agent during execution of a task node. The deviation scoreσ\sigma步骤 m_i 的 _i 使用自引用滚动窗口来测量智能体当前输出与其最近行为基线之间的语义距离。三级管道反映了车身规格（§B.11.4）：_i for step m_i measures the semantic distance between the agent’s current output and its own recent behavioral baseline, using a self-referential rolling window. The three-stage pipeline mirrors the body specification (§B.11.4):

(1) 代表Representation：每个代理的每个任务输出都使用以下方法编码为 3,072 维嵌入向量: each agent’s per-task output is encoded as a 3,072-dimensional embedding vector using the文本嵌入 3-largetext-embedding-3-large模型 (OpenAI) 用于主要评分，辅助评分器使用 Voyage AImodel (OpenAI) for primary scoring, with a secondary scorer using Voyage AI’s航程3voyage-3模型以满足偏差评分器多样性要求。两名记分员必须在触发冻结之前达成一致，以防止单个受损记分员产生误报（请参阅 TA-7，附录 A）。model to satisfy the deviation scorer diversity requirement. Both scorers must agree before a freeze is triggered, preventing a single compromised scorer from generating false positives (see TA-7, Appendix A).

(2) 参考分布Reference distribution：参考是代理在最近 w = 20 个已完成任务中的输出的自参考滚动窗口，其中平均嵌入: the reference is a self-referential rolling window of the agent’s own outputs over the most recent w = 20 completed tasks, from which the mean embeddingμ\mu和分量标准差and component-wise standard deviationσ\sigma被计算。在偏差评分激活之前，至少需要完成 w_min = 5 个任务，以确保有足够的参考数据。are computed. A minimum of w_min = 5 completed tasks is required before deviation scoring activates, ensuring sufficient reference data.

(3) 距离度量Distance metric：当前输出嵌入与参考平均值之间的余弦距离 d_cos: cosine distance d_cos between the current output embedding and the reference meanμ\mu，归一化为, normalized byσ\sigma产生 z 分数：to yield a z-score:

σi=dcos​(embed​(mi),μ)σcos\sigma_{i}=\frac{d_{\cos}(\text{embed}(m_{i}),\,\mu)}{\sigma_{\cos}}

当监护人触发 FROZEN 状态转换时The Guardian triggers a FROZEN state transition whenσ\sigma_i >偏差ThresholdSigma（构成参数，默认_i > deviationThresholdSigma (constitutional parameter, defaultσ\sigma= 2.0）。门槛= 2.0). The thresholdσ\sigma= 2.0 和参考统计数据 (= 2.0 and the reference statistics (μ\mu, σ\sigma）根据来自试点任务的 500 个代理轨迹的保留验证集进行校准；该校准集与实验 1（附录 D）中使用的对抗性测试场景脱节，以避免循环评估。通过reportAnomaly(nodeId,agentAddr,DEVIATION,magnitude=)将异常报告给Guardian模块) are calibrated on a held-out validation set of 500 agent traces from pilot missions; this calibration set is disjoint from the adversarial test scenarios used in Experiment 1 (Appendix D) to avoid circular evaluation. The anomaly is reported to the Guardian module via reportAnomaly(nodeId, agentAddr, DEVIATION, magnitude=σ\sigma_i）。_i).

提供者依赖说明。Provider Dependency Note.的选择The choice of文本嵌入 3-largetext-embedding-3-large因为主要嵌入函数创建了对 OpenAI API 的部署依赖。如果该模型被弃用或其嵌入空间被修改，则校准统计数据将变得无效，并且必须针对新的参考语料库重新校准。为了减轻提供者锁定，偏差评分器界面被设计为与嵌入模型无关：任何将文本映射到固定维度向量空间的函数都可以被替换，前提是它在同一参考语料库上重新校准。候选替代方案包括可以自托管的开源模型（例如 BGE-large、E5-mistral-7b-instruct），以增加推理基础设施为代价消除对外部 API 的依赖。构成参数系统包括as the primary embedding function creates a deployment dependency on OpenAI’s API. If this model is deprecated or its embedding space is modified, the calibration statistics become invalid and must be re-calibrated against a new reference corpus. To mitigate provider lock-in, the deviation scorer interface is designed to be embedding-model-agnostic: any function that maps text to a fixed-dimensional vector space can be substituted, provided it is re-calibrated on the same reference corpus. Candidate alternatives include open-source models (e.g., BGE-large, E5-mistral-7b-instruct) that can be self-hosted, eliminating the external API dependency at the cost of increased inference infrastructure. The constitutional parameter system includes an嵌入模型IdembeddingModelId记录哪个模型的校准处于活动状态的参数，每当模型发生更改时都会触发强制重新校准工作流程。parameter that records which model’s calibration is active, triggering a mandatory re-calibration workflow whenever the model is changed.

设计原理2Design rationale for 2σ\sigma阈值：threshold:阈值2The threshold of 2σ\sigma选择匹配标准的二西格玛规则，接受高斯参考分布下大约 2.28% 的误报率。人类评审员可以通过规则中心调整此阈值，以适应需要更严格的环境（例如，1.5is chosen to match a standard two-sigma rule, accepting a false positive rate of approximately 2.28% under a Gaussian reference distribution. Human adjudicators can adjust this threshold via the Rules Hub for contexts requiring stricter (e.g., 1.5σ\sigma）或更宽松（例如，3) or more permissive (e.g., 3σ\sigma）偏差检测。构成参数系统确保无论值如何，阈值变化都会被记录在链上。偏差评分器在原型基准上的假阳性和假阴性率的经验表征计划作为实验 1（附录 D）的一部分，并将在配套的经验论文中报告。) deviation detection. The constitutional parameter system ensures that threshold changes are on-chain recorded regardless of value. Empirical characterization of the false positive and false negative rates of the deviation scorer on the prototype benchmark is planned as part of Experiment 1 (Appendix D) and will be reported in the companion empirical paper.

校准要求。Calibration Requirements.2.28% 假阳性率主张背后的高斯假设必须通过经验进行验证。我们需要：（i）Kolmogorov-Smirnov 检验确认嵌入距离分布不会拒绝高斯零假设The Gaussian assumption underlying the 2.28% false positive rate claim must be validated empirically. We require: (i) a Kolmogorov–Smirnov test confirming that the embedding distance distribution does not reject the Gaussian null hypothesis atα\alpha= 0.05; (ii) QQ 图，可视化参考分布与理论高斯分布的关系； （iii）分布外对抗性测试集（不是校准语料库）的经验假阳性和假阴性率表征。这些验证结果将在配套的实证论文中报告。如果高斯假设被拒绝，则将使用经验百分位数（2.28% 目标 FPR 的第 97.72 个百分位数）而不是参数 2 重新校准阈值= 0.05; (ii) a QQ-plot visualizing the reference distribution against a theoretical Gaussian; (iii) empirical false positive and false negative rate characterization on an out-of-distribution adversarial test set (not the calibration corpus). These validation results will be reported in the companion empirical paper. If the Gaussian assumption is rejected, the threshold will be re-calibrated using the empirical percentile (97.72nd percentile for a 2.28% target FPR) rather than the parametric 2σ\sigma规则。rule.

B.11.3 安全性与活性的权衡Safety-vs-Liveness Tradeoff

自动升级规则（20 分钟内冻结 3 次）The auto-escalation rule (three freezes in 20 minutes→\rightarrow紧急停止）创建了一个潜在的拒绝服务向量：可以在受控时间间隔触发看似良性异常的对手可以强制任务停止，而不会违反任何个人行为不变量。 19 分钟内发生的 3 次看似异常的相互作用足以将任何任务升级为紧急停止。我们分析了这种权衡并确定了三种缓解措施：Emergency Stop) creates a potential denial-of-service vector: an adversary who can trigger benign-looking anomalies at controlled intervals can force a mission halt without appearing to violate any individual behavioral invariant. Three plausibly anomalous interactions spaced across 19 minutes would suffice to escalate any mission to Emergency Stop. We analyze this tradeoff and identify three mitigations:

首先，First,声誉加权冻结阈值reputation-weighted freeze thresholds：Guardian 模块不是对所有代理应用统一的升级阈值，而是查阅 AgentContract 声誉分类账并应用缩放阈值 - 具有较高声誉的代理需要按比例增加更多异常才能触发升级。例如，处于第 90 个声誉百分位的代理需要在紧急停止之前冻结 5 次；历史最少的新注册代理需要三个。这使得拒绝服务向量对于已建立的高声誉代理来说更加昂贵，并为对手创造了保持良好信誉的经济激励——这种信誉本身就降低了他们利用该向量的能力。形式上，具有信誉评分的代理 a 的有效阈值 T_eff(a): rather than applying a uniform escalation threshold across all agents, the Guardian module consults the AgentContract reputation ledger and applies a scaled threshold—agents with higher reputation require proportionally more anomalies to trigger escalation. An agent at the 90th reputation percentile requires, for example, five freezes before Emergency Stop; a newly registered agent with minimal history requires three. This makes the denial-of-service vector substantially more expensive against established, high-reputation agents and creates an economic incentive for adversaries to maintain good standing—a standing that itself reduces their ability to exploit the vector. Formally, the effective threshold T_eff(a) for agent a with reputation scoreρ\rho(一)(a)∈\in[0, 1000] 是：[0, 1000] is:

⬇
T_eff(a) = T_base + 地板floor(罗rho(a) / 1000 x T_奖金T_bonus)

其中 T_base = 3（构成参数，默认：escalationFreezeCount = 3），T_bonus = 3（构成参数，默认：3）。在where T_base = 3 (constitutional parameter, default: escalationFreezeCount = 3) and T_bonus = 3 (constitutional parameter, default: 3). Atρ\rho= 0：T_eff = 3；在= 0: T_eff = 3; atρ\rho= 500：T_eff = 4；在= 500: T_eff = 4; atρ\rho= 1000：T_eff = 6。该公式在简单性和可审核性方面是线性的；非线性变体（例如对数）是可能的，但会降低可解释性。= 1000: T_eff = 6. The formula is linear in reputation for simplicity and auditability; non-linear variants (e.g., logarithmic) are possible but reduce interpretability.

第二，Second,冻结计数窗口的指数退避exponential backoff on freeze counting windows：每次紧急停止被人工裁判员清除后，后续升级的计数窗口呈指数增长（例如 20 分钟）: after each Emergency Stop is cleared by human adjudicators, the counting window for subsequent escalations increases exponentially (e.g., 20 minutes→\rightarrow40分钟40 minutes→\rightarrow80 分钟）。这可以防止对手反复触发最小冻结升级的快速循环攻击。第 n 个紧急停止事件后的升级窗口 W_n 为：80 minutes). This prevents rapid cycling attacks where an adversary repeatedly triggers minimal-freeze escalations. The escalation window W_n after the n-th Emergency Stop event is:

⬇
W_n = W_base x 2^n

其中 W_base = 1,200,000 ms（20 分钟），n 是当前任务中清除的紧急停止事件的计数。窗口随着每次骑行赛事而无限制地增长；实际上，在 W_n 变得与操作无关之前，任务将经过人工审查并中止。where W_base = 1,200,000 ms (20 minutes) and n is the count of Emergency Stop events cleared in the current mission. The window grows without bound with each cycling event; in practice, the mission will be human-reviewed and aborted long before W_n becomes operationally irrelevant.

三、Third,误报审查false positive review：覆盖面板（§B.12）公开了一种机制，通过该机制人类裁决者可以追溯地将单个冻结事件分类为误报，并相应地调整升级计数器。被归类为误报的冻结被排除在升级计算之外，并且代理的声誉不会受到惩罚。该机制关闭了 Guardian 模块的自动检测和人工判断之间的反馈回路，防止累积的误报产生虚假的紧急停止。在原型中实施声誉加权阈值和误报审查，以及检测/升级权衡的经验表征，计划作为实验 1（附录 D）的一部分，并将在配套的经验论文中报告。: the Override Panel (§B.12) exposes a mechanism through which human adjudicators can retroactively classify individual freeze events as false positives, adjusting the escalation counter accordingly. A freeze classified as a false positive is excluded from the escalation calculation, and the agent’s reputation is not penalized. This mechanism closes the feedback loop between the Guardian module’s automated detection and human judgment, preventing accumulated false positives from producing spurious Emergency Stops. Implementation of reputation-weighted thresholds and false positive review in the prototype, along with empirical characterization of the detection/escalation tradeoff, is planned as part of Experiment 1 (Appendix D) and will be reported in the companion empirical paper.

缓解协议下的活性保证。Liveness Guarantee under the Mitigated Protocol.在声誉加权和指数退避协议下，针对高声誉代理强制紧急停止的对抗成本如下所示。对手必须触发 T_eff(a) = T_base + Floor(Under the reputation-weighted and exponential-backoff protocol, the adversarial cost of forcing an Emergency Stop against a high-reputation agent scales as follows. An adversary must trigger T_eff(a) = T_base + floor(ρ\rho(一)/1000(a)/1000×\timesT_bonus) 冻结 W_n ms 窗口内的事件。对于高信誉代理商（T_bonus) freeze events within a window of W_n ms. For a high-reputation agent (ρ\rho= 900，T_eff = 5）在基线窗口（W_0 = 20 分钟），对手必须在 20 分钟内生成 5 个可能的异常。每个异常要么需要代理推理中的真正偏差（难以秘密制造），要么需要可检测到的异常输入注入（这本身就构成了可通过日志中心在链上追踪的治理违规行为）。相对于简单的固定阈值设计，声誉权重和异常源链上可追溯性的结合大大提高了攻击成本。= 900, T_eff = 5) at baseline window (W_0 = 20 min), the adversary must generate 5 plausible anomalies in 20 minutes. Each anomaly requires either a genuine deviation in the agent’s reasoning (difficult to manufacture covertly) or a detectable injection of anomalous inputs (which would itself constitute a governance violation traceable on-chain via the Logging Hub). The combination of reputation weighting and on-chain traceability of anomaly sources substantially raises the attack cost relative to a naive fixed-threshold design.

B.11.4 自适应细化Adaptive Refinement

当验证模块拒绝进度证明提交或监护人模块触发确定性冻结时，故障信号传播回立法层：生产者代理和编码代理将低级故障数据（合约异常、阈值违规、完整性不匹配）转换为语义反馈。更新后的任务状态反馈到随后的立法时代——编纂代理可以重新链接治理合同，生产者代理可以重新部署或替换微服务——从而实现迭代优化，逐步增强任务执行和治理保真度。这种反馈循环与现代治理有直接的相似之处：为立法修正案提供信息的行政部门实施报告。保持权力分离——生产者代理人不能自行修改合同；他们只能向立法机关请求修改。When the Verification module rejects a Proof-of-Progress submission or the Guardian module triggers a Deterministic Freeze, the fault signal propagates back to the legislative layer: producer agents and codification agents translate low-level fault data (contract exceptions, threshold violations, integrity mismatches) into semantic feedback. The updated mission state feeds into subsequent legislative epochs—codification agents may re-link governance contracts, producer agents may re-deploy or substitute micro-services—enabling iterative optimization that progressively strengthens both task execution and governance fidelity. This feedback loop has a direct analog in modern governance: executive-branch implementation reports that inform legislative amendment. The separation of authority is maintained—producer agents cannot modify contracts themselves; they can only petition the legislature for amendment.

最大细化迭代。Maximum Refinement Iterations.自适应细化循环的边界为The Adaptive Refinement loop is bounded by最大\{}_refinement\{}_iterationsmax\{}_refinement\{}_iterations（构成参数，默认：3）。这一上限可以防止无限的重新立法周期，从而耗尽任务预算而不取得进展。默认为 3 的理由如下：一次迭代从单个微服务故障（原型中最常见的故障模式）中恢复；第二次迭代从复合错误或规范模糊性中恢复；第三次迭代提供了最后一次尝试，然后升级为人工评审员进行手动重新确定范围。对此上限的任何增加都必须在规则中心中明确设置，并适用于所有后续任务 - 不能在任务中修改。(constitutional parameter, default: 3). This cap prevents infinite re-legislation cycles that would exhaust mission budgets without making progress. The rationale for the default of 3 is as follows: one iteration recovers from a single micro-service fault (the most common failure mode in the prototype); a second iteration recovers from a compounded fault or a specification ambiguity; a third iteration provides a final attempt before escalating to human adjudicators for manual re-scoping. Any increase to this cap must be explicitly set in the Rules Hub and applies to all subsequent missions—it cannot be amended mid-mission.

B.11.5 链上/链下一致性协议On-Chain/Off-Chain Consistency Protocol

AgentCity 的执行架构跨越两个计算层：提供高吞吐量任务执行的链下微服务结构，以及提供不可变治理记录、可验证状态转换和宪法执行的链上智能合约层。这两层必须保持一致：链上状态必须准确反映链下发生的执行，链下执行不得释放尚未通过链上治理检查的输出。本节指定一致性模型和每个类别的一致性违规的故障协议。AgentCity’s execution architecture spans two computational layers: an off-chain micro-service fabric that provides high-throughput task execution, and an on-chain smart contract layer that provides immutable governance records, verifiable state transitions, and constitutional enforcement. These two layers must remain consistent: the on-chain state must accurately reflect the execution that occurred off-chain, and off-chain execution must not release outputs that have not cleared on-chain governance checks. This section specifies the consistency model and the failure protocols for each category of consistency violation.

一致性模型。Consistency Model.AgentCity 使用AgentCity uses具有链上终结性的乐观执行optimistic execution with on-chain finality。链下微服务在收到 CollaborationContract 路由信号后立即执行任务，无需等待每个中间步骤的链上确认。链上状态转换在链下执行完成后异步提交。该系统可以容忍链下任务完成和链上状态最终确定之间短暂的一致性差距。这种设计反映了 L2 部署的正确权衡：同步链上门控会给每个微服务调用带来块时间延迟，使得多步 DAG 执行对于实时工作负载来说不切实际。乐观执行以暂时一致性窗口为代价来恢复此延迟，该窗口由以下四种故障协议限制和管理。. Off-chain micro-services execute tasks immediately upon receiving a CollaborationContract routing signal, without waiting for on-chain confirmation of each intermediate step. On-chain state transitions are submitted asynchronously after off-chain execution completes. The system tolerates a brief consistency gap between off-chain task completion and on-chain state finalization. This design reflects the correct tradeoff for an L2 deployment: synchronous on-chain gating would impose block-time latency on every micro-service invocation, making multi-step DAG execution impractical for real-time workloads. Optimistic execution recovers this latency at the cost of a transient consistency window, which is bounded and managed by the four failure protocols below.

乐观一致性窗口的时序分析。Timing Analysis of the Optimistic Consistency Window.一致性窗口 W_opt 的边界如下。令 t_exec 表示微服务完成链外任务执行并将其输出提交到托管缓冲区的时间。令 t_conf 表示相应的链上 advanceNode() 交易实现 L2 区块最终确定的时间。一致性差距The consistency window W_opt is bounded as follows. Let t_exec denote the time at which a micro-service completes off-chain task execution and submits its output to the escrow buffer. Let t_conf denote the time at which the corresponding on-chain advanceNode() transaction achieves L2 block finality. The consistency gapδ\delta= t_conf – t_exec 由以下部分组成：= t_conf – t_exec is composed of:

  • •

    网络传播延迟Network propagation delay (τ\tau_prop)：交易从链下执行器传播到 L2 排序器的时间。典型_prop): the time for the transaction to propagate from the off-chain executor to the L2 sequencer. Typicalτ\tau_prop ≈\approx正常情况下，在兼容 EVM 的 L2 上为 50–200 ms。50–200 ms on an EVM-compatible L2 under normal conditions.

  • •

    定序器包含延迟Sequencer inclusion delay (τ\tau_seq)：排序器将交易包含在块中的时间。在Base当前目标出块时间约为2秒的情况下，_seq): the time for the sequencer to include the transaction in a block. Under Base’s current target block time of approximately 2 seconds,τ\tau_seq ≤\leq预计 2,000 毫秒。2,000 ms in expectation.

  • •

    气体估计的不确定性Gas estimation uncertainty (τ\tau_gas)：如果初始 Gas 估计不足并且交易需要使用更高的 Gas 重新提交，则会产生额外的延迟。在默认 Gas 定价下（自动 Gas 估算 + 20% 缓冲），_gas): additional latency if the initial gas estimate is insufficient and the transaction requires resubmission with higher gas. Under default gas pricing (automatic gas estimation + 20% buffer),τ\tau_气体_gas≈\approx中位数情况下为 0；在第 99 个百分位中，0 in the median case; in the 99th percentile,τ\tau_气体_gas≤\leq4,000 毫秒（一个额外的区块时间）。实际测量的 99% 值将在配套的实证论文中报告。4,000 ms (one additional block time). Actual measured 99th-percentile values will be reported in the companion empirical paper.

因此，在正常情况下（无气体故障），E[Therefore, in the normal case (no gas failure), E[δ\delta] ≈\approx τ\tau_prop + τ\tau_seq ≈\approx250–2,200 毫秒。在没有定序器中断的最坏情况下，250–2,200 ms. In the worst case without sequencer outage,δ\delta ≤\leq τ\tau_prop + τ\tau_序列+_seq +τ\tau_气体_gas≈\approx6,200 毫秒（一个重试窗口）。在此窗口期间，托管缓冲区保存输出，并且在链上确认到达之前不会解除任何依赖 DAG 节点的阻塞。6,200 ms (one retry window). During this window, the escrow buffer holds the output and no dependent DAG nodes are unblocked until on-chain confirmation arrives.

该程序查询链上This procedure queries the on-chain合作合同CollaborationContract在做出任何执行决策之前，恢复所有活动 DAG 节点的状态并恢复本地冻结镜像的内存状态以匹配链上现实。该过程必须在本地冻结镜像开始处理新的执行路由信号之前完成。其 Gas 成本是只读的（查看对 CollaborationContract 的调用）并且不提交交易。state for all active DAG nodes and restores the Local Freeze Mirror’s in-memory state to match on-chain reality before any execution decisions are made. The procedure must complete before the Local Freeze Mirror begins processing new execution routing signals. Its gas cost is read-only (view calls to CollaborationContract) and does not submit transactions.

信托假设分类：Trust assumption classification:如果未实施或绕过崩溃恢复程序，则本地冻结镜像的崩溃后行为将成为信任假设，而不是架构保证。我们将崩溃恢复过程在重新启动时忠实实现和执行的要求正式分类为 TA-5（链外执行结构完整性）的一部分：受到损害或错误实现的本地冻结镜像跳过恢复可能会在冻结节点上恢复执行，从而违反了 INVARIANT 4 设计提供的冻结优先级保证。If the crash-recovery procedure is not implemented or is bypassed, the Local Freeze Mirror’s post-crash behavior becomes a trust assumption rather than an architectural guarantee. We formally classify the requirement that the crash-recovery procedure is faithfully implemented and executed on restart as part of TA-5 (Off-Chain Execution Fabric Integrity): a compromised or incorrectly implemented Local Freeze Mirror that skips recovery could resume execution on frozen nodes, violating the freeze precedence guarantee that INVARIANT 4 is designed to provide.“‘

乐观执行下保留的关键治理不变量是：The key governance invariant preserved under optimistic execution is:在确认最终 DAG 节点的所有链上状态转换并且 Gate 模块的构成输出门已在链上应用之前，不会向请求者发布任何任务输出。no mission output is released to the requester until all on-chain state transitions for the final DAG node have been confirmed and the Gate module’s constitutional output gate has been applied on-chain.乐观间隙适用于 DAG 内的中间状态转换；终端发布始终是同步且链上确认的。The optimistic gap applies to intermediate state transitions within the DAG; the terminal release is always synchronous and on-chain-confirmed.

乐观执行层的实现和经验表征（代表性工作负载下的平均和第 99% 一致性差距持续时间）计划在配套的经验论文中进行。Implementation and empirical characterization of the optimistic execution layer (mean and 99th-percentile consistency gap duration under representative workloads) is planned for the companion empirical paper.

故障模式 1 — 状态转换故障（气体尖峰/恢复）。Failure Mode 1—State Transition Failure (Gas Spike / Revert).如果链上状态转换在链下执行完成后失败（由于 Gas 峰值、合约恢复或瞬态基础网络状况），系统将进入受影响 DAG 节点的 PENDING_FINALIZATION 状态。在 PENDING_FINALIZATION 中：If an on-chain state transition fails after off-chain execution completes—due to a gas spike, contract revert, or transient Base network condition—the system enters a PENDING_FINALIZATION state for the affected DAG node. In PENDING_FINALIZATION:

  • •

    微服务输出保存在The micro-service output is held in an托管缓冲区escrow buffer— 本地的、经过加密签名的持有存储 — 并且不会向下游发布到依赖的 DAG 节点或任务请求者。—a local, cryptographically signed holding store—and is not released downstream to dependent DAG nodes or to the mission requester.

  • •

    系统以指数退避重试链上状态转换：尝试 T+30 秒、T+2 分钟和 T+8 分钟（总共三次尝试）。The system retries the on-chain state transition with exponential backoff: attempts at T+30s, T+2min, and T+8min (three total attempts).

  • •

    如果所有 3 次重试均失败，则 DAG 节点将被标记为“失败”，并且故障信号将传播到自适应细化循环（§B.11.4），立法机关可以在其中重新分配任务或重新配置合约参数。If all three retries fail, the DAG node is marked FAILED and the fault signal propagates to the Adaptive Refinement loop (§B.11.4), where the legislature can re-assign the task or re-configure the contract parameters.

  • •

    如果任何重试成功，托管缓冲区将被释放，DAG 状态将前进，并继续执行。If any retry succeeds, the escrow buffer is released, the DAG state advances, and execution continues.

托管缓冲区确保乐观执行不会传播未经确认的输出：下游任务仅接收链上来源已确认的输出，从而保留每个 DAG 转换都可追溯到链上记录的治理保证。The escrow buffer ensures that optimistic execution does not propagate unconfirmed outputs: downstream tasks receive only outputs whose on-chain provenance has been confirmed, preserving the governance guarantee that every DAG transition is traceable to an on-chain record.

计划实现 PENDING_FINALIZATION 状态、托管缓冲区和重试逻辑；基础网络条件下的故障频率特征将在实验 4 和配套的经验论文中报告。Implementation of PENDING_FINALIZATION state, escrow buffer, and retry logic is planned; failure frequency characterization under Base network conditions will be reported in Experiment 4 and the companion empirical paper.

故障模式 2 — 延迟了 Guardian 模块冻结。Failure Mode 2—Delayed the Guardian module Freeze.如果 Guardian 模块检测到异常并在链上确认之前提交因网络拥塞而延迟的冻结交易，则链下执行环境会执行If the Guardian module detects an anomaly and submits a freeze transaction that is delayed by network congestion before on-chain confirmation, the off-chain execution environment implements a局部冻结镜Local Freeze Mirror：由驱动 Guardian 模块的相同异常检测逻辑触发的本地进程级停止，独立于链上确认运行。本地冻结镜像使用与 Guardian 模块相同的异常检测阈值（如当前规则中心构成参数中指定），并在异常检测后立即停止代理的执行飞地，而无需等待冻结交易在链上确认。: a local process-level halt triggered by the same anomaly detection logic that drives the Guardian module, operating independently of on-chain confirmation. The Local Freeze Mirror uses the identical anomaly detection thresholds as the Guardian module (as specified in the current Rules Hub constitutional parameters) and halts the agent’s execution enclave immediately upon anomaly detection, without waiting for the freeze transaction to confirm on-chain.

架构设计是分层的：链上的 Guardian 模块 freeze 作为The architectural design is layered: the on-chain the Guardian module freeze serves as the权威治理记录authoritative governance record— 冻结事件的不可变的、防篡改的证据 — 而本地冻结镜像提供—the immutable, tamper-proof evidence of the freeze event—while the Local Freeze Mirror provides纵深防御defense-in-depth在确认间隙期间。观察到 Base mempool 中待处理冻结交易的对手无法利用确认间隙来进行恶意执行，因为本地冻结镜像已经在本地停止了 enclave。然后，链上记录为裁决审查提供可审计的证据。during the confirmation gap. An adversary who observes a pending freeze transaction in the Base mempool cannot exploit the confirmation gap to race ahead with malicious execution, because the Local Freeze Mirror has already halted the enclave locally. The on-chain record then provides the auditable evidence for adjudicative review.

本地冻结镜像不能替代链上冻结；它是一个安全层，关闭检测和确认之间的窗口。如果链上冻结交易最终失败（例如，由于恢复），本地冻结镜像仍然有效，并且条件将升级到自适应细化循环，该循环可以通过覆盖面板重新提交冻结。The Local Freeze Mirror is not a substitute for the on-chain freeze; it is a safety layer that closes the window between detection and confirmation. If the on-chain freeze transaction ultimately fails (e.g., due to a revert), the Local Freeze Mirror remains in effect and the condition is escalated to the Adaptive Refinement loop, which can re-submit the freeze via the Override Panel.

计划实施具有共享异常检测逻辑的本地冻结镜像；确认间隙持续时间和局部冻结镜像误报率特征将在实验 1 和配套的实证论文中报告。Implementation of the Local Freeze Mirror with shared anomaly detection logic is planned; confirmation gap duration and Local Freeze Mirror false positive rate characterization will be reported in Experiment 1 and the companion empirical paper.

故障模式 3 — 定序器停机。Failure Mode 3—Sequencer Downtime.在 L2 定序器中断期间（各种 L2 网络上发生的事件，必须将其视为设计要求而不是边缘情况），系统在以下状态下运行During L2 sequencer outages—events that have occurred on various L2 networks and must be treated as a design requirement rather than an edge case—the system operates in降级模式Degraded Mode:

  • •

    链下微服务执行继续：已接收路由信号并且没有未解决的 PENDING_FINALIZATION 依赖关系的任务将被执行，并将其输出保存在托管缓冲区中。Off-chain micro-service execution continues: tasks that have received routing signals and have no unresolved PENDING_FINALIZATION dependencies are executed and their outputs held in the escrow buffer.

  • •

    链上状态转换在有序的本地队列中排队（保留原始提交顺序），而不是提交到网络。On-chain state transitions are queued in an ordered local queue (preserving the original submission order) rather than submitted to the network.

  • •

    在降级模式期间，不会向请求者发布任何任务输出。No mission outputs are released to the requester during Degraded Mode.

  • •

    当定序器恢复时，排队的状态转换将按顺序提交，尊重原始 DAG 依赖顺序。When the sequencer recovers, queued state transitions are submitted in order, respecting the original DAG dependency sequence.

  • •

    如果定序器中断超过可配置的阈值（默认值：30 分钟），系统会自动升级到紧急停止：所有链外执行停止，所有排队的转换都被保留但不提交，并通知人工评审员在授权恢复之前检查任务状态。If the sequencer outage exceeds a configurable threshold (default: 30 minutes), the system automatically escalates to Emergency Stop: all off-chain execution halts, all queued transitions are preserved but not submitted, and human adjudicators are notified to review the mission state before resumption is authorized.

30 分钟的默认阈值设置为限制在需要人工审核之前可以累积的未经确认的链下工作的最大数量。较低的门槛会增加裁决负担；较长的阈值会增加在没有链上治理确认的情况下延长执行的风险。该阈值是可通过规则中心调整的构成参数，允许操作员调整其部署环境的安全性与可用性的权衡。The 30-minute default threshold is set to bound the maximum volume of unconfirmed off-chain work that can accumulate before human review is required. Shorter thresholds increase adjudicative burden; longer thresholds increase the risk of extended execution without on-chain governance confirmation. This threshold is a constitutional parameter adjustable via the Rules Hub, allowing operators to tune the safety-vs-availability tradeoff for their deployment context.

这可以防止在判定器无法使用时在定序器长时间停机期间无限期暂停任务状态。针对 L2 定序器停机场景的实施和测试计划作为实验 4（附录 D）的一部分，并将在随附的实证论文中报告。This prevents indefinite suspension of mission state during prolonged sequencer outages when adjudicators are unavailable. Implementation and testing against L2 sequencer downtime scenarios is planned as part of Experiment 4 (Appendix D) and will be reported in the companion empirical paper.

故障模式 4——状态分歧。Failure Mode 4—State Divergence. A 和解协议Reconciliation Protocol在任务边界运行——具体来说，在每个任务阶段结束时（立法之后、编排之后、最终输出发布之前）——将链下执行记录与该阶段处理的所有 DAG 节点的链上状态进行比较。调节检查验证：runs at mission boundaries—specifically, at the conclusion of each mission Phase (after Legislation, after Orchestration, and before final output release)—comparing the off-chain execution record against the on-chain state for all DAG nodes processed in that phase. The reconciliation check verifies:

  • •

    链下执行记录中标记为完成的每个 DAG 节点都有相应的已确认的链上状态转换。Every DAG node marked complete in the off-chain execution record has a corresponding confirmed on-chain state transition.

  • •

    每个确认的链上状态转换都对应于记录的链外执行事件（在乐观一致性窗口内具有匹配的代码哈希、I/O 哈希和时间戳）。Every confirmed on-chain state transition corresponds to a recorded off-chain execution event (with matching code-hash, I/O hash, and timestamp within the optimistic consistency window).

  • •

    每个节点在链上记录的 PoP 证明类型与 CollaborationContract 规范相匹配。The PoP attestation type recorded on-chain for each node matches the CollaborationContract specification.

任何分歧——DAG节点完全在链外但不在链上，或者链上转换没有相应的执行记录——都会触发Any divergence—a DAG node complete off-chain but absent on-chain, or an on-chain transition without a corresponding execution record—triggers an审计警报audit alert到裁决分支：任务被暂停，日志中心显示分歧证据，人类裁决员在允许任务推进或发布输出之前通过覆盖面板审查差异。to the Adjudication branch: the mission is suspended, the Logging Hub surfaces the divergence evidence, and human adjudicators review the discrepancy via the Override Panel before the mission is permitted to advance or release outputs.

协调协议提供了权威的一致性保证：即使单独的 PENDING_FINALIZATION 重试和降级模式恢复自动运行，任务边界协调也确保人类主体在任何输出离开系统之前验证完整的治理记录。The Reconciliation Protocol provides the authoritative consistency guarantee: even if individual PENDING_FINALIZATION retries and Degraded Mode recovery operate automatically, the mission-boundary reconciliation ensures that a human principal validates the full governance record before any outputs leave the system.

B.11.6 混合模式安全模型Hybrid-Mode Security Model

安全属性 SP-1 到 SP-4（第 4.2 节）是为纯粹的链上执行而定义的。在用于实验 1-2（附录 D）的混合模式中，这些属性在任务边界（锚点）处保持不变，但在任务内执行期间会放松。我们明确定义混合模式安全属性：The security properties SP-1 through SP-4 (§4.2) are defined for pure on-chain enforcement. In hybrid mode—used for Experiments 1–2 (Appendix D)—these properties hold at mission boundaries (anchor points) but are relaxed during intra-mission execution. We define the hybrid-mode security properties explicitly:

SP-1h（混合接线完整性）。SP-1h (Hybrid Wiring Integrity).任务节点和授权执行单元之间的绑定在任务锚点处受到完整性保护。在锚点之间，绑定由内存治理中间件强制执行，该中间件复制链上访问控制逻辑，但在可变执行环境中运行。破坏中间件的对手可以在锚点内窗口期间改变绑定。此漏洞被形式化为 TA-5 (§4)；另请参见 TA-5 中 NP-1/NP-3 与局部冻结镜相互作用的讨论。The binding between task nodes and authorized execution units is integrity-protected at mission anchor points. Between anchors, bindings are enforced by the in-memory governance middleware, which replicates the on-chain access control logic but operates in a mutable execution environment. An adversary who compromises the middleware can alter bindings during the intra-anchor window. This vulnerability is formalized as TA-5 (§4); see also the discussion of NP-1/NP-3 interaction with the Local Freeze Mirror in TA-5.

SP-2h（混合门执法）。SP-2h (Hybrid Gate Enforcement).执行门条件在锚点处强制执行。在锚点之间，门由本地冻结镜像和内存中 PoP 验证强制执行，这提供了深度防御，但不防篡改。Execution gate conditions are enforced at anchor points. Between anchors, gates are enforced by the Local Freeze Mirror and in-memory PoP validation, which provide defense-in-depth but are not tamper-proof.

SP-3h（混合可审计性）。SP-3h (Hybrid Auditability).在锚点内执行期间，所有状态转换都记录在链下执行日志中，并提交到锚点处的链上记录。链下日志仅在单个进程中追加，但在锚定承诺之前不具有加密防篡改功能。All state transitions are recorded in the off-chain execution log during intra-anchor execution and committed to the on-chain record at anchor points. The off-chain log is append-only within a single process but is not cryptographically tamper-proof until anchor commitment.

SP-4h（混合分离）。SP-4h (Hybrid Separation).分离执行的操作与 SP-4 相同——访问控制在中间件中复制并在锚点上在链上确认。Separation enforcement operates identically to SP-4—access control is replicated in the middleware and confirmed on-chain at anchors.

损害界限分析。Damage Bound Analysis.锚点之间的最大未经审核操作受到 DAG 执行速率和锚点间隔的限制。令 r 表示平均 DAG 节点完成率（节点/秒），The maximum unaudited operations between anchor points is bounded by the DAG execution rate and the anchor interval. Let r denote the average DAG node completion rate (nodes/second) andτ\tau_anchor 锚定间隔（秒）。单个锚点窗口中的最大未经审计操作为：_anchor the anchor interval (seconds). The maximum unaudited operations in a single anchor window is:

Nu​n​a​u​d​i​t​e​d=r×τa​n​c​h​o​rN_{unaudited}=r\times\tau_{anchor}

例如，考虑一个具有平均节点执行时间的 8 节点 DAGFor example, consider an 8-node DAG with mean node execution timeτ\tau_节点_node≈\approx每个节点 5 秒，可配置的检查点间隔为5 seconds per node, and a configurable checkpoint interval ofτ\tau_anchor = 10秒（即治理中间件每执行任务10秒提交一次链上锚定交易）。节点完成率 r = 1/_anchor = 10 seconds (i.e., the governance middleware submits an on-chain anchor transaction every 10 seconds of mission execution). The node completion rate is r = 1/τ\tau_node = 0.2 节点/秒。代入公式：N_unaudted = r_node = 0.2 nodes/second. Substituting into the formula: N_unaudited = r×\times τ\tau_锚点= 0.2_anchor = 0.2×\times10 = 2 个连续检查点锚点之间的节点转换。请注意10 = 2 node transitions between consecutive checkpoint anchors. Note thatτ\tau_anchor 这里是_anchor here is the检查点频率checkpoint frequency——通过规则中心配置的宪法参数——而不是总任务持续时间。对于 5 秒/节点的 8 节点顺序 DAG，总任务持续时间约为 40 秒，跨越四个检查点窗口，每个检查点窗口 10 秒，每个检查点窗口最多包含 2 个未经审核的节点。较短的检查点间隔会减少 N_unaudted （从而减少妥协的爆炸半径），但代价是增加链上交易频率。对于较大的 DAG（100 个节点，r = 0.5 个节点/秒，—a constitutional parameter configurable via the Rules Hub—not the total mission duration. For an 8-node sequential DAG at 5s/node, the total mission duration is approximately 40 seconds, spanning four checkpoint windows of 10s each, each containing at most 2 unaudited nodes. Shorter checkpoint intervals reduce N_unaudited (and therefore the blast radius of a compromise) at the cost of increased on-chain transaction frequency. For larger DAGs (100 nodes, r = 0.5 nodes/s,τ\tau_anchor = 60s), N_未经审核_anchor = 60s), N_unaudited≤\leq每个检查点窗口 30 个节点。协调协议（§B.11.5）检测每个检查点的任何分歧，将中间件妥协的爆炸半径限制为每个窗口最多 N_unaudited 未经验证的转换。30 nodes per checkpoint window. The Reconciliation Protocol (§B.11.5) detects any divergence at each checkpoint, bounding the blast radius of a middleware compromise to at most N_unaudited unverified transitions per window.

实验警告。Experimental Caveat.这两个实验主要在混合模式安全模型 (SP-1h–SP-4h) 下运行。实验2的纯链上测量子集在完整的链上安全模型（SP-1–SP-4）下运行。应相应地解释结果：以混合模式测量的攻击成功率反映了链上锚定和中间件执行的组合安全性，而不是纯粹的链上保证。Both experiments operate primarily under the hybrid-mode security model (SP-1h–SP-4h). Experiment 2’s pure on-chain measurement subset operates under the full on-chain security model (SP-1–SP-4). Results should be interpreted accordingly: attack success rates measured in hybrid mode reflect the combined security of on-chain anchoring and middleware enforcement, not pure on-chain guarantees.

In pure on-chain mode, an 8-node DAG mission requires approximately 3–6 on-chain transactions per task node (authorization, execution confirmation, PoP submission, verification, Guardian check, Gate check), yielding 24–48 transactions per mission. In hybrid mode, only mission-boundary anchor transactions are submitted on-chain: mission initialization (1 tx), per-branch-junction PoP commits (approximately⌈n/τa​n​c​h​o​r⌉\lceil n/\tau_{anchor}\rceilTXS，其中txs, whereτa​n​c​h​o​r\tau_{anchor}是检查点间隔）和任务完成（1 tx）。对于 8 节点 DAGis the checkpoint interval), and mission finalization (1 tx). The estimated cost reduction factor is therefore:

Rc​o​s​tt​x=Hybrid txsPure on-chain txs≈536≈0.14(∼7× reduction by transaction count)R_{cost}^{tx}=\frac{\text{Hybrid txs}}{\text{Pure on-chain txs}}\approx\frac{5}{36}\approx 0.14\quad(\sim 7\times\text{ reduction by transaction count})

然而，交易计数比率夸大了成本降低，因为它假设每笔交易的天然气成本是统一的。在实践中，每个节点的治理操作（授权 45K Gas、执行确认 45K、PoP 提交 50K、验证 55K、Guardian 检查 40K、Gate 检查 42K）与任务级锚点操作（DAG 部署 280K Gas、Merkle 根提交 100K、最终确定 60K）具有截然不同的 Gas 配置文件。气体加权估计更准确：However, the transaction-count ratio overstates the cost reduction because it assumes uniform gas cost per transaction. In practice, per-node governance operations (authorization  45K gas, execution confirmation  45K, PoP submission  50K, verification  55K, Guardian check  40K, Gate check  42K) have substantially different gas profiles from mission-level anchor operations (DAG deployment  280K gas, Merkle root commit  100K, finalization  60K). B.12 裁决界面Adjudication Interface

裁决分支是通过统一的人机界面实现的，该界面提供对立法和执行的系统级优先权。由于合约架构（§B.3）对链上的完整执行拓扑进行编码，因此人类裁决者不仅可以审计日志和遥测数据，还可以审计The Adjudication branch is realized through a unified human interface that provides system-level override authority over both Legislation and Execution. Because the contract architecture (§B.3) encodes the full execution topology on-chain, human adjudicators can audit not only logs and telemetry but the结构布线structural wiring系统本身的问题——检查来自不同各方的微服务如何绑定、控制每个转换的约束以及执行拓扑是否符合立法意图。人类裁判员通过四个组件与系统进行交互。of the system itself—examining how micro-services from different parties are bound, what constraints govern each transition, and whether the execution topology matches the legislated intent. Human adjudicators interact with the system through four components.

评审团队模型。Adjudicator Team Model.在描述四个接口组件之前，我们指定人类裁决者团队本身的治理模型，它构成了 SoP 模型的裁决分支。评审团队必须满足以下结构要求：Before describing the four interface components, we specify the governance model for the human adjudicator team itself, which constitutes the Adjudication branch of the SoP model. The adjudicator team must satisfy the following structural requirements:

  • •

    最低法定人数下限：Minimum quorum floor:的The裁决者法定人数adjudicatorQuorum宪法参数的强制最小下限为constitutional parameter has an enforced minimum floor ofqm​i​n=2​f+1q_{min}=2f+1其中 f 是系统允许受到损害的最大裁决者数量。对于推荐的默认值 f = 2（最多允许 2 个妥协的裁决者），where f is the maximum number of adjudicators the system tolerates being compromised. For the recommended default f = 2 (tolerating up to 2 compromised adjudicators),qm​i​n=5q_{min}=5，需要贿赂, requiring bribery of≥\geq评审员4名（在4 adjudicators (at the⌈\lceil2q/3⌉\rceil撤销控制的绝对多数阈值）以实现无条件的系统妥协。我们设置默认的supermajority threshold for revocation control) to achieve unconditional system compromise. We set the default裁决者法定人数adjudicatorQuorum至7进行以下分析。最低法定人数下限是在合同级别强制执行的：任何设置的尝试to 7 for the following analysis. The minimum quorum floor is enforced at the contract level: any attempt to set裁决者法定人数adjudicatorQuorum下面belowqm​i​nq_{min}通过规则中心恢复。via the Rules Hub is reverted.

  • •

    轮换政策：Rotation policy:任何一个裁决者不得作为同一任务连续两次以上的类型 3 PoP 证明决定或连续两次以上的冻结解冻决定的唯一审批者。此轮换要求由覆盖面板软件层强制执行，该软件层在接受签名操作之前检查裁决者的批准历史记录。No single adjudicator may serve as the sole approver for more than two consecutive Type 3 PoP attestation decisions or more than two consecutive freeze unfreeze decisions for the same mission. This rotation requirement is enforced by the Override Panel software layer, which checks the adjudicator’s approval history before accepting a signed action.

  • •

可扩展的监督框架。Scalable oversight framing.三层 PoP 分配逻辑（将人类裁决者的努力引导至第 3 层任务，同时自动化第 1 层和第 2 层验证）实例化了 Bowman 等人研究的可扩展监督框架。 (2022) 以及欧文和阿斯克尔 (2019) [Bowman2022;欧文2019]。人类审判员的能力是一种稀缺的宪法资源； PoP 层分配和警报优先级队列是 AgentCity 将此资源分配给最需要的任务的机制。The three-tier PoP allocation logic—directing human adjudicator effort toward Tier 3 tasks while automating Tier 1 and Tier 2 verification—instantiates the scalable oversight framework studied by Bowman et al. (2022) and Irving and Askell (2019) [Bowman2022; Irving2019]. Human adjudicator capacity is a scarce constitutional resource; the PoP tier assignment and alert priority queue are the mechanisms by which AgentCity allocates this resource to tasks where it is most needed.

看门狗机制作为自主断路器运行：它不需要任何裁决器来启动操作，并且看门狗触发的冻结不能被标记的裁决器解除。这解决了受贿的多数人可能阻止彼此撤销的关键差距——看门狗通过算法检测行为模式完全绕过了这种依赖人类的机制。The watchdog mechanism operates as an autonomous circuit breaker: it does not require any adjudicator to initiate action, and a watchdog-triggered freeze cannot be lifted by the flagged adjudicator(s). This addresses the critical gap where a bribed majority could block revocation of each other—the watchdog bypasses this human-dependent mechanism entirely by detecting behavioral patterns algorithmically.

看门狗活跃度：最大冻结持续时间和误报分析。Watchdog Liveness: Maximum Freeze Duration and False-Positive Analysis.监管机构冻结需要所有未标记裁判员的一致同意才能解除。这会产生活跃风险：如果未标记的裁决者不可用（休假、网络分区、密钥丢失），冻结会无限期持续，从而停止所有任务执行。我们通过两种机制限制这种风险：The watchdog freeze requires unanimous consent from all non-flagged adjudicators to lift. This creates a liveness risk: if a non-flagged adjudicator is unavailable (vacation, network partition, key loss), the freeze persists indefinitely, halting all mission execution. We bound this risk through two mechanisms:

  1. 1.

    最大冻结持续时间。Maximum freeze duration.构成参数A constitutional parameter看门狗最大冻结持续时间watchdogMaxFreezeDuration（默认值：72 小时）对看门狗触发的冻结施加自动超时。如果在此窗口内未明确解决（解除或确认）冻结，系统将输入(default: 72 hours) imposes an automatic timeout on watchdog-triggered freezes. If the freeze is not explicitly resolved (lifted or confirmed) within this window, the system enters a降级治理模式degraded-governance mode其中新任务启动被阻止，但允许处于 EXECUTING 状态的现有任务通过当前 DAG 节点完成，而无需前进到新节点。这可以防止无限期的系统停止，同时保留未解决的看门狗警报的安全信号。in which new mission initiations are blocked but existing missions in EXECUTING state are allowed to complete through their current DAG node without advancing to new nodes. This prevents indefinite system halt while preserving the security signal of the unresolved watchdog alert.

  2. 2.

    假阳性率分析。False-positive rate analysis.默认阈值（>95% 的批准率、>20 次连续批准、> 30 天内三个参数削弱）根据基线裁决者行为进行校准。在正常运作下，审查各种合法任务的裁决者预计会批准 70-85% 的行动（基于大多数任务都是非对抗性的假设）。因此，只有当批准率超过基线时，才会触发 95% 阈值The default thresholds (>95% approval rate, >20 consecutive approvals, >three parameter weakenings in 30 days) are calibrated against baseline adjudicator behavior. Under normal operations, an adjudicator reviewing a mix of legitimate missions is expected to approve 70–85% of actions (based on the assumption that most missions are non-adversarial). The 95% threshold therefore triggers only when approval rate exceeds baseline by≥\geq10 个百分点。对于连续批准阈值，连续 20 次以上批准而没有任何拒绝的概率是10 percentage points. For the consecutive-approvals threshold, a sequence of 20+ approvals without any rejection has probability≤0.8520≈0.039\leq 0.85^{20}\approx 0.039在基线 85% 的批准率下——产生估计的假阳性率under the baseline 85% approval rate—yielding an estimated false-positive rate of∼\sim每个评审员每 30 天窗口 3.9%。与3.9% per adjudicator per 30-day window. Withq=7q=7裁决者，每个窗口的误报警报的预期数量是adjudicators, the expected number of false-positive alerts per window is∼\sim0.27，假阳性概率0.27, and the probability of a false-positive冻结freeze（需要来自同一裁决者的 2 个异常警报）是(requiring 2 anomaly alerts from the same adjudicator) is≤(0.039)2≈0.15%\leq(0.039)^{2}\approx 0.15\%每个窗口每个裁判员。per adjudicator per window.对基线批准率的敏感性。Sensitivity to baseline approval rate.假阳性率对假设的基线批准率高度敏感。我们将一系列合理基线的看门狗 FP 率制成表格：The false-positive rate is highly sensitive to the assumed baseline approval rate. We tabulate the watchdog FP rate across a range of plausible baselines:

基线批准率Baseline Approval Rate P(警报/调整/30天)P(alert/adj/30d) P(冻结/30d)P(freeze/30d)
0.70 0.046% <0.001%
0.75 0.266% <0.001%
0.80 1.15% <0.001%
0.85 3.88% 0.001%
0.90 10.6% 0.044%

在假设的基线 0.85 下，每个裁决者的警报率为每 30 天窗口 3.9%，冻结概率可以忽略不计。然而，如果真实基线超过 0.90（例如，因为绝大多数任务都是非对抗性的，并且裁决者正确批准了它们），则警报率超过 10%，并且误报冻结在操作上变得非常重要。这种敏感性激发了两种设计反应：(1)At the assumed baseline of 0.85, the per-adjudicator alert rate is  3.9% per 30-day window and freeze probability is negligible. However, if the true baseline exceeds 0.90 (e.g., because the vast majority of missions are non-adversarial and adjudicators correctly approve them), the alert rate exceeds 10% and false-positive freezes become operationally significant. This sensitivity motivates two design responses: (1) the最大批准率maxApprovalRate阈值应根据试点阶段观察到的裁决者行为进行经验校准，而不是先验设定； (2) 分级警报方案（警告threshold should be calibrated empirically from observed adjudicator behavior during the pilot phase, not set a priori; (2) a graduated alerting scheme (warning→\rightarrow调查investigation→\rightarrowfreeze）而不是当前的二进制警报freeze) rather than the current binary alert→\rightarrow冻结模型将减少阈值校准错误对操作的影响。我们承认这些估计依赖于假设的基准批准率；在生产部署之前，需要根据配套实验数据进行经验校准。freeze model would reduce the operational impact of threshold miscalibration. We acknowledge that these estimates rely on the assumed baseline approval rate; empirical calibration from the companion experimental data is required before production deployment.

规则中心（宪法编辑器）。Rules Hub (Constitution Editor).规则中心是宪法参数管理界面，人类裁决者通过它定义和修改管理所有任务执行的行为约束。规则更改通过更新相关合约参数的链上交易生效，确保所有治理修改都通过裁决者的加密签名记录在不可变的分类账上。The Rules Hub is the constitutional parameter management interface through which human adjudicators define and amend the behavioral constraints that govern all mission execution. Rule changes take effect via on-chain transactions that update the relevant contract parameters, ensuring that all governance modifications are recorded on the immutable ledger with the adjudicator’s cryptographic signature.

参数校准原理。Parameter Calibration Rationale.默认参数值是根据理论分析和试点任务观察结果得出的：The default parameter values are derived from a combination of theoretical analysis and pilot mission observations:

  • •

    σ\sigma= 2（偏差阈值）：= 2 (deviation threshold):符合统计2Matches the statistical 2σ\sigma规则，在高斯参考分布下理论误报率为 2.28%。经验验证待定（请参阅§B.11 校准要求）。rule, yielding a theoretical 2.28% false positive rate under Gaussian reference distributions. Empirical validation pending (see §B.11 calibration requirements).

  • •

    工具 = 40（最大工具调用次数）：tools = 40 (max tool invocations):源自试点任务跟踪，其中每个任务节点的合法工具调用的第 99 个百分位数为 32。25% 的余量裕度产生 40。Derived from pilot mission traces where the 99th percentile of legitimate tool invocations per task node was 32. A 25% headroom margin yields 40.

  • •

    消息 = 120（最大消息量）：messages = 120 (max message volume):试点任务中每项任务的代理间消息的第 99 个百分位是 94。28% 的余量产生 120。The 99th percentile of inter-agent messages per task in pilot missions was 94. A 28% margin yields 120.

  • •

    冻结 = 3（升级阈值）：freezes = 3 (escalation threshold):设置为平衡误报容忍度（在升级之前允许最多 2 次错误冻结）与对抗性利用（将攻击者限制为 2 次不受惩罚的异常）。Set to balance false positive tolerance (allowing up to 2 erroneous freezes before escalation) against adversarial exploitation (limiting the attacker to 2 unpenalized anomalies).

  • •

    窗口 = 20 分钟（升级窗口）：window = 20 min (escalation window):经过校准，超过试点任务中最长单节点执行的预期持续时间（12 分钟），确保一项任务中不同任务节点之间的连续合法冻结不会虚假触发升级。Calibrated to exceed the expected duration of the longest single-node execution in pilot missions (12 minutes), ensuring that sequential legitimate freezes across different task nodes within one mission do not spuriously trigger escalation.

这些默认值是临时的，将通过计划的敏感性实验（配套实证论文）中的系统敏感性分析进行完善。These defaults are provisional and will be refined through systematic sensitivity analysis in a planned sensitivity experiment (companion empirical paper).

规则中心参数更新协议：Rules Hub Parameter Update Protocol:

⬇
算法ALGORITHM 宪法参数更新ConstitutionalParameterUpdate(参数IDparamId: 字节32bytes32, 新价值newValue: uint256,
理由justification: 字符串string):
// 调用Invoked by 裁决者adjudicator 通过via 规则Rules 枢纽Hub 网络web 接口interface
1. 裁判员Adjudicator 构造constructs 电子工业园区EIP-712 打字的typed 数据data 有效载荷payload:
有效载荷payload <- {
类型type: "宪法参数更新ConstitutionalParameterUpdate",
参数IDparamId: 参数IDparamId,
旧值oldValue: 当前值currentValue(参数IDparamId),
新价值newValue: 新价值newValue,
理由justification: 凯卡克256keccak256(理由justification),
裁决者地址adjudicatorAddr: 味精msg.发件人sender,
时间戳timestamp: 现在now,
使命范围missionScope: "全球GLOBAL" | "使命MISSION:<任务IDmissionId>"
}
2. 裁判员Adjudicator 迹象signs 有效载荷payload 与with 硬件hardware 钱包wallet:
签名signature <- 标志SIGN(有效载荷payload, 裁决者私钥adjudicator_private_key)
3. 网络Web 接口interface 提交submits on-链条chain 交易transaction:
呼叫CALL 规则中心RulesHub.更新参数updateParameter(参数IDparamId, 新价值newValue, 签名signature, 理由_cidjustification_cid)
// 理由_cidjustification_cid: IPFS 来电显示CID of 的the 满full 理由justification 文本text (为了for 审计audit 踪迹trail)
4. 规则中心RulesHub 合同contract 验证validates:
要求REQUIRE 签名signature 验证verifies 反对against 仲裁员注册地址adjudicator_registered_address
要求REQUIRE 裁决者adjudicator is 非non-矛盾的conflicted 为了for 范围scope
要求REQUIRE 新价值newValue \in 有效范围valid_range[参数IDparamId]
要求REQUIRE 不NOT 活动任务期间锁定locked_during_active_mission(参数IDparamId)
// 一些Some 参数parameters 是are 不可变的immutable 中mid-使命mission; 变化changes 采取take 效果effect at 下一个next 使命mission 开始start
5. 规则中心RulesHub 传播propagates to 受影响affected 合同contracts:
为FOR 每个EACH 受影响的合同affected_contract IN 参数IDparamId.受影响的合同affectedContracts:
呼叫CALL 受影响的合同affected_contract.设置参数setParam(参数IDparamId, 新价值newValue)
6. 记录Logging 枢纽Hub 记录records 更新update:
发射发射EMIT 参数更新ParameterUpdated(参数IDparamId, 旧值oldValue, 新价值newValue, 裁决者地址adjudicatorAddr,
理由_cidjustification_cid, 块block.数量number)

日志中心（审计跟踪查看器）。Logging Hub (Audit Trail Viewer).日志中心是一个仅附加的审计跟踪界面，提供任务生命周期所有阶段的完整交互历史记录。它是裁决审查和任务后取证分析的主要证据来源。The Logging Hub is an append-only audit trail interface providing full interaction history across all phases of the mission lifecycle. It is the primary evidence source for adjudicative review and post-mission forensic analysis.

索引维度。Indexing Dimensions.日志中心按照以下维度对所有事件进行索引，以支持有针对性的取证查询：The Logging Hub indexes all events along the following dimensions to support targeted forensic queries:

指标维度Index Dimension 类型Type 查询语义Query Semantics
任务IDmissionId 字节32bytes32 特定任务的所有事件（主分区键）All events for a specific mission (primary partition key)
代理地址agentAddr 地址address 涉及特定特工的所有事件（跨任务）All events involving a specific agent (across missions)
合约地址contractAddr 地址address 特定合约实例发出的所有事件All events emitted by a specific contract instance
事件类型eventType 枚举enum 特定类型的所有事件（例如，所有 FREEZE_TRIGGERED 事件）All events of a specific type (e.g., all FREEZE_TRIGGERED events)
节点IDnodeId 字节32bytes32 特定 DAG 任务节点的所有事件All events for a specific DAG task node
纪元epoch uint256 特定立法时期内的所有事件All events within a specific legislative epoch
时间范围timeRange （uint256，uint256）(uint256, uint256) 时间戳窗口内的所有事件All events within a timestamp window
块范围blockRange （uint256，uint256）(uint256, uint256) 区块编号范围内的所有事件All events within a block number range
人类校长humanPrincipal 地址address 所有事件均归因于特定人类委托人的代理人All events attributable to a specific human principal’s agents

保留政策。Retention Policy.所有事件都以仅附加形式存储。链上事件（由智能合约发出）可通过标准 L2 日志检索永久可用。链下事件（立法消息交换、执行 enclave 日志）与其链上有效负载哈希和 IPFS 上的完整有效负载一起存储，最短保留期为 24 个月。日志中心界面将链上事件和 IPFS 存储的事件聚合到统一视图中。关键任务事件（FREEZE_TRIGGERED、DIVERGENCE_DETECTED、EMERGENCY_STOP、STAKE_SLASHED）还被镜像到裁决者控制的链下存储端点，以确保独立于 IPFS 网络条件的可用性。All events are stored in append-only form. On-chain events (emitted by smart contracts) are permanently available via standard L2 log retrieval. Off-chain events (legislative message exchanges, execution enclave logs) are stored with their payload hashes on-chain and full payloads on IPFS with a minimum retention period of 24 months. The Logging Hub interface aggregates both on-chain and IPFS-stored events into a unified view. Mission-critical events (FREEZE_TRIGGERED, DIVERGENCE_DETECTED, EMERGENCY_STOP, STAKE_SLASHED) are additionally mirrored to an adjudicator-controlled off-chain storage endpoint to ensure availability independent of IPFS network conditions.

执行仪表板。Execution Dashboard.执行仪表板提供任务状态的实时和历史视图，旨在进行持续的裁决监督，而不是一次性的取证审查。The Execution Dashboard provides real-time and historical views of mission state, designed for continuous adjudicative oversight rather than one-time forensic review.

历史观点：Historical Views:该仪表板还提供历史任务分析，包括：任务时间线甘特图（显示每个节点的执行时间和阶段）、按合同类型划分的 Gas 成本明细、按代理和时间窗口划分的冻结频率直方图、按层划分的 PoP 成功/拒绝率以及跨立法时期的比较性能（对于自适应细化任务）。The dashboard also provides historical mission analysis, including: mission timeline gantt charts (showing per-node execution times and phases), gas cost breakdown by contract type, freeze frequency histograms by agent and time window, PoP success/rejection rate by tier, and comparative performance across legislative epochs (for Adaptive Refinement missions).

覆盖面板。Override Panel.推翻小组是人类裁决者行使具有约束力的系统级推翻权力的机制。所有覆盖面板操作都需要在提交之前从裁决者的注册负责人地址获得经过加密签名的 EIP-712 有效负载。The Override Panel is the mechanism through which human adjudicators exercise binding system-level override authority. All Override Panel actions require a cryptographically signed EIP-712 payload from the adjudicator’s registered human-principal address before submission.
