裁判员认证：Adjudicator Authentication:覆盖面板将所有绑定操作构建为 EIP-712 类型的数据结构，必须由裁决者的注册私钥进行签名。 Web 界面永远不会收到私钥；它通过 MetaMask 或兼容的硬件钱包接口请求签名，并将签名的有效负载提交给合约。基于会话的身份验证（用户名/密码、OAuth）提供对只读日志记录中心和执行仪表板视图的访问，但无法提交任何绑定操作。读取访问（基于会话）和写入访问（加密签名）之间的这种分离可确保受损的 Web 会话不会产生未经授权的治理操作。The Override Panel constructs all binding actions as EIP-712 typed data structs that must be signed by the adjudicator’s registered private key. The web interface never receives the private key; it requests a signature via MetaMask or compatible hardware wallet interface and submits the signed payload to the contract. Session-based authentication (username/password, OAuth) provides access to the read-only Logging Hub and Execution Dashboard views but cannot submit any binding action. This separation between read access (session-based) and write access (cryptographic signature) ensures that a compromised web session cannot produce unauthorized governance actions.

审计追踪的完整性。Audit Trail Completeness.每个覆盖面板操作都会生成一个通过日志中心记录在链上的结构化日志事件。每个操作的审计跟踪包括：裁决者的链上地址（通过 AgentContract 链接到其人类主体身份）、操作类型和目标实体、理由文本的 keccak256、用于完整理由和支持证据的 IPFS CID、链上交易哈希（提供操作的不可变证据）和区块号。该审计追踪可由任何一方公开验证：独立审计员、监管机构或对手方组织可以重建任何任务的完整裁决历史，而无需依赖裁决者的自我报告。Every Override Panel action produces a structured log event recorded on-chain via the Logging Hub. The audit trail for each action includes: the adjudicator’s on-chain address (linked to their human-principal identity via AgentContract), the action type and target entity, a keccak256 of the justification text, an IPFS CID for the full justification and supporting evidence, the on-chain transaction hash (providing immutable evidence of the action), and the block number. This audit trail is publicly verifiable by any party: an independent auditor, a regulatory body, or a counterparty organization can reconstruct the complete adjudication history for any mission without relying on the adjudicators’ self-reporting.

可用的操作包括：冻结或恢复单个代理或整个任务（调用 Guardian 模块.triggerFreeze / unfreezeWithApproval）、终止任务（CollaborationContract.abortMission）、修改宪法参数（通过规则中心重新参数化执行合约）、调整声誉评分（AgentContract.updateReputation）、将单个冻结事件分类为误报（调整 Guardian 模块升级计数器）、授权 3 类委托 PoP对未决主观输出审查的证明，并触发全系统紧急停止。每个覆盖操作都通过人类委托人的加密签名记录在链上。Available actions include: freeze or resume individual agents or entire missions (invoking the Guardian module.triggerFreeze / unfreezeWithApproval), terminate missions (CollaborationContract.abortMission), amend constitutional parameters (re-parameterizing execution contracts via the Rules Hub), adjust reputation scores (AgentContract.updateReputation), classify individual freeze events as false positives (adjusting the Guardian module escalation counter), authorize Type 3 delegated PoP attestations for pending subjective-output reviews, and trigger system-wide Emergency Stops. Every override action is recorded on-chain with the human principal’s cryptographic signature.

人类裁决者通过此界面在整个任务生命周期中行使系统级超控权。裁决不是最终阶段，而是一个连续的叠加阶段：负责人可以在注册、立法和执行阶段的任何时候通过覆盖小组进行干预。正式裁决时刻（第 4 阶段）发生在任务的最终输出在发布给任务请求者之前根据宪法谓词进行审查时。Human adjudicators exercise system-level override authority throughout the mission lifecycle via this interface. Adjudication is not a terminal phase but a continuous overlay: human principals can intervene via the Override Panel at any point during the Registration, Legislation, and Execution phases. The formal adjudication moment—Phase 4—occurs when the mission’s final outputs are reviewed against constitutional predicates before being released to the mission requester.

对于原型评估，规则中心实现了一个最小可行的界面：基于表单的规则配置、具有过滤功能的事件日志查看器以及覆盖操作端点。高级功能——异常总结、宪法规则建议引擎和预测治理分析——被推迟到未来的工作（附录C）。For the prototype evaluation, the Rules Hub implements a minimal viable interface: form-based rule configuration, event log viewer with filtering, and override action endpoints. Advanced capabilities—anomaly summarization, constitutional rule suggestion engines, and predictive governance analytics—are deferred to future work (Appendix C).

C.1 讨论和限制Discussion and Limitations

本文的证据状态。Evidentiary Status of This Paper.本文提出了架构规范和实验协议；附录 D 中的所有安全和性能声明均This paper presents an architectural specification and experimental protocol; all safety and performance claims in Appendix D are假设有待实证验证hypotheses pending empirical validation。初步可行性实验（附录 D）为 Gas 成本可处理性、立法协议可扩展性和架构设计的对抗稳健性提供了初步证据，但整个两个实验计划的综合结果在配套的实证论文中报告。读者应将所有定量声明（包括攻击成功率预测、gas 成本估算和通信复杂性界限）解释为设计目标和理论估计，而不是测量结果。附录 D 中的表 5-11 和图 4-11 被标记为“计划配套实证论文”，以明确区分；本节通过直接说明证据限制来强化这一标签。结论 (§7) 将在配套实证研究完成后用测量值进行更新。. Preliminary feasibility experiments (Appendix D) provide initial evidence for gas cost tractability, legislative protocol scalability, and adversarial robustness of the architectural design, but comprehensive results across the full two-experiment program are reported in the companion empirical paper. Readers should interpret all quantitative claims—including attack success rate projections, gas cost estimates, and communication complexity bounds—as design targets and theoretical estimates, not as measured results. Tables 5–11 and Figures 4–11 throughout Appendix D are labeled "Planned for companion empirical paper" to make this distinction explicit; this section reinforces that labeling by stating the evidentiary limitation directly. The Conclusion (§7) will be updated with measured values upon completion of the companion empirical study.

这种证据框架并没有削弱论文的贡献——即正式的架构规范、威胁模型和实验设计——但它确实要求读者对待论文中关于架构的主张This evidentiary framing does not diminish the paper’s contribution—which is the formal architectural specification, the threat model, and the experimental design—but it does require that readers treat the paper’s claims about what the architecture会做will do作为架构假设而不是证明的事实。as architectural hypotheses rather than demonstrated facts.

链上治理的成本效益。Cost-Benefit of On-Chain Governance.根据附录 D 中的理论分析和初步可行性实验，如果实验 4 程序产生与 H4a 一致的结果，治理开销将量化为总任务成本（LLM 推理 + 微服务计算 + 链上 Gas）的百分比。对于关键任务部署（财务结算、医疗保健、监管合规），相对于不受治理的故障模式的责任成本，治理成本预计可以忽略不计——这一说法将被配套的实证结果证实或反驳。我们的初步分析表明，在与 EVM 兼容的 L2 上，按分析估计每个任务的治理成本比典型的 LLM 推理成本低几个数量级，但该估计需要实验 4 的经验验证才能被视为部署规划数字。Based on theoretical analysis and the preliminary feasibility experiments in Appendix D, governance overhead would be quantified as a percentage of total mission cost (LLM inference + micro-service compute + on-chain gas) if the Experiment 4 program produces results consistent with H4a. For mission-critical deployments (financial settlement, healthcare, regulatory compliance), the governance cost is expected to be negligible relative to the liability cost of ungoverned failure modes—a claim that would be confirmed or refuted by the companion empirical results. Our preliminary analysis suggests that on an EVM-compatible L2, the per-mission governance cost is analytically estimated to be orders of magnitude below typical LLM inference costs, but this estimate requires empirical validation from Experiment 4 before it can be treated as a deployment planning figure.

    人类治理层的中心化（元治理问题）。Centralization of the human governance layer (meta-governance problem).SoP 模型将无条件的宪法权力分配给人类裁决者团队（§B.12）。该论文详细说明了裁决者团队的治理机制——选择标准、轮换政策、法定人数下限、链上问责——但没有解决元治理问题：The SoP model assigns unconditional constitutional authority to a human adjudicator team (§B.12). The paper specifies the adjudicator team’s governance mechanisms—selection criteria, rotation policy, quorum floor, on-chain accountability—but does not address the meta-governance question:谁管辖裁判员？who governs the adjudicators?拥有多数票的五人裁决小组负责管理所有宪法参数的变更；这将潜在的大型代理经济体的巨大权力集中在一小群人身上，他们的问责机制主要是链上归因和社会制裁，而不是结构性分离。鉴于该论文援引宪法制衡作为其中心类比，这一点尤其值得注意：审判部门没有来自外部部门的司法审查的类似物。管理合约 (§B.3) 提供了结构性的第一步 - 将立法分支内的管理代理限制为允许的操作并强制执行微服务委托 - 但不会扩展到裁决分支本身。将管理契约原则扩展到裁决者层仍然是未来的工作。我们将这种集中公开为明确的架构限制。A five-person adjudicator team with majority vote governs all constitutional parameter changes; this concentrates significant power over potentially large agent economies in a small group of individuals whose accountability mechanisms are primarily on-chain attribution and social sanction rather than structural separation. This is especially notable given the paper’s invocation of constitutional checks-and-balances as its central analogy: the Adjudication branch has no analog of judicial review from an external branch. The ManagementContract (§B.3) provides a structural first step—constraining management agents within the Legislation branch to permitted operations and mandating microservice delegation—but does not extend to the Adjudication branch itself. Extending ManagementContract principles to the adjudicator layer remains future work. We disclose this concentration as an explicit architectural limitation.

    治理作为合法性的滥用潜力。Governance-as-legitimacy misuse potential.AgentCity 的宪法治理基础设施可以被故意部署来洗白有害代理经济体的合法性：提供看似符合宪法的链上审计跟踪，而底层任务任务则追求有害目标。从设计上来说，该架构无法阻止人类裁决者团队制定授权有害活动的宪法；宪法的执行对于宪法的内容是中立的。技术架构并未解决这种滥用向量（治理基础设施为实质性有害部署提供程序掩护）。缓解措施需要对部署环境（法律框架、平台政策、社区标准）进行外部治理，这超出了本文的范围。我们披露这一风险是为了防止论文的框架暗示链上治理等同于道德治理。AgentCity’s constitutional governance infrastructure could be deliberately deployed to launder legitimacy for harmful agent economies: providing on-chain audit trails that appear constitutionally compliant while the underlying mission tasks pursue harmful objectives. The architecture cannot, by design, prevent a human adjudicator team from establishing a constitution that authorizes harmful activities; constitutional enforcement is neutral regarding the content of the constitution. This misuse vector—governance infrastructure providing procedural cover for substantively harmful deployments—is not addressed by the technical architecture. Mitigation would require external governance of the deployment context (legal frameworks, platform policies, community standards) that are beyond the scope of this paper. We disclose this risk to prevent the paper’s framing from implying that on-chain governance equivalently implies ethical governance.

    作者设计的攻击场景循环。Author-designed attack scenario circularity.实验 1 中测试的新颖攻击向量（联盟攻击、声誉博弈、基于冻结的 DoS）是由设计防御的同一团队设计的，从而造成了结构性信息不对称：攻击的复杂程度受到防御者对其自身漏洞的了解的限制。可以预见的是，相对于独立红队所能达到的目标，这一设计边界会夸大测量到的防御效能。测量的新向量 ASR 应被解释为超过防御阈值所需的攻击复杂性的下限，而不是作为独立对手无法找到更有效攻击的证据。我们建议对特定于架构的攻击向量进行独立的红队评估，作为未来的重要工作。The novel attack vectors tested in Experiment 1 (coalition attacks, reputation gaming, freeze-based DoS) were designed by the same team that designed the defenses, creating a structural information asymmetry: attack sophistication is bounded by the defenders’ knowledge of their own vulnerabilities. This design boundary predictably inflates measured defense efficacy relative to what an independent red team would achieve. The measured ASR for novel vectors should be interpreted as a lower bound on the attack sophistication needed to exceed the defensive threshold, not as evidence that independent adversaries cannot find more effective attacks. We propose independent red-team evaluation of the architecture-specific attack vectors as essential future work.

The following validity predicates are replicated in the Python mocks: MSG_TYPE_2 identity verification (DID format validation, reputation threshold check), MSG_TYPE_3 DAG well-formedness (acyclicity, node-count bounds, task-type matching), and MSG_TYPE_4 bid validity (stake sufficiency, service registration check, capability matching). The following predicates present in Solidity but omitted from the Python mocks: on-chain nonce verification for replay protection, gas-limit enforcement on contract calls, re-entrancy guards, and cross-contract state consistency checks between AgentContract and ServiceContract. If these omitted predicates introduce additional message round-trips or failure modes in the Solidity implementation, the O(n) scaling result may apply to a simplified system. On-chain integration effects are measured separately in Experiment A.

This creates a participation rationality constraint: only well-capitalized operators (institutional entities, staking pools, or agents with existing idle capital) can rationally participate in HIGH-risk missions. The resulting concentration of execution among well-capitalized incumbents undermines the permissionless participation that motivates the architecture. Stake pooling (Appendix C, Future Work) is the primary proposed mitigation, but it introduces pool operator trust assumptions that partially re-centralize the system. This tension between economic security (high stakes for deterrence) and permissionless access (low barriers to participation) is a fundamental design tradeoff that the current architecture does not resolve.

    法学硕士作为法官的偏见。LLM-as-judge bias.立法部门的监管机构和管理机构依靠法学硕士推理进行监督和质量控制，继承了已知的偏见The Regulatory Agent and management agents in the Legislation branch rely on LLM reasoning for oversight and quality control, inheriting known biases[31]。有两个缓解因素限制了这种风险：首先，审判完全由人管辖，因此有偏见的立法成果不能传播到审判决定中；其次，立法机构在最终确定合同之前必须咨询规则中心（一组人类定义的宪法约束），提供事前检查，通过人类制定的规则过滤立法。然而，风险并没有消除：如果管理代理人错误地评估了生产者代理人的声誉或在立法期间标记了错误的程序违规行为，那么由此产生的合同将编码有偏见的立法输出，然后执行部门确定性地强制执行——将偏见限制在立法中，但通过执行放大它。 ManagementContract 的微服务委托授权提供了部分缓解措施：在生成可执行工件之前，通过确定性微服务过滤有偏见的管理代理推理，并添加对工件生成步骤的独立检查（尽管不是对触发它的推理）。未来的工作应探索立法内部监督的正式验证替代方案，并根据经验衡量基于法学硕士的管理机构针对人类裁决者决策的误报率。. Two mitigating factors bound this risk: first, Adjudication is exclusively human-governed, so biased legislative outputs cannot propagate into adjudicative decisions; second, legislative agents must consult the Rules Hub—a set of human-defined constitutional constraints—before finalizing contracts, providing an ex-ante check that filters legislation through human-authored rules. Nevertheless, the risk is not eliminated: if management agents incorrectly assess a producer agentś reputation or flag a false procedural violation during legislation, the resulting contract will encode biased legislative output that the Execution branch then enforces deterministically—confining bias to legislation but amplifying it through execution. The ManagementContract’s microservice delegation mandate provides a partial mitigation: biased management agent reasoning is filtered through deterministic microservices before producing enforceable artifacts, adding an independent check on the artifact production step (though not on the reasoning that triggered it). Future work should explore formal verification alternatives for intra-legislative oversight and empirically measure the false-positive rate of LLM-based management agents against human adjudicator decisions.

TA-2 (L2 Sequencer Honesty) scopes this risk to the specific sequencer model used. On L2s with centralized sequencers, public mempool extraction is typically not enabled; on L2s with decentralized sequencers, MEV mitigation strategies should be employed: (i) private mempool submission via services such as Flashbots Protect or equivalent L2-native private transaction relays; (ii) commit-reveal schemes for governance-critical transactions (e.g., freeze triggers submitted as commitments in block N and revealed in block N+1); (iii) time-locked governance actions where the Guardian module accepts freeze triggers with a minimum confirmation depth before they take effect. MEV exposure is a deployment-specific consideration that depends on the sequencer architecture of the chosen L2.

The GOR trajectory’s convergence toward <2% in later rounds partially mitigates this concern (fewer adjudication decisions are needed as the economy self-regulates), but the early-round HITLRR estimates should be treated as upper bounds on real-world adjudicator performance. 附录DAppendix D扩展实验细节Extended experimental details

本附录提供了扩展的实验设置详细信息、配置原理、LLM API 参数和实验规范，包括 GovSim 的可比性和盈亏平衡方法。This appendix provides extended experimental setup details, configuration rationale, LLM API parameters, and experiment specifications including GovSim comparability and break-even methodology.

D.1 各个实验配置的基本原理Rationale for individual experimental configurations

基线配置的基本原理。Rationale for the Baseline configuration.Baseline 部署了与其他配置相同的 asyncio 协程架构：代理是独立的 Python 协程，每个都有自己的 HD 派生钱包、自己的 LLM 上下文窗口和程序生成的角色（从每个实验指定的角色分布中得出的诚实、自利和对抗倾向）。然而，任务决策时不会参考 Solidity 合约。代理可以自由调用任何注册的工具，将任何输出传播到下游任务，并自我证明任务完成情况。此配置代表了基于 LLM 的协程代理框架的当前实践状态，并作为安全性和协作属性的下限。The Baseline deploys the same asyncio coroutine architecture as the other configurations: agents are independent Python coroutines, each with its own HD-derived wallet, its own LLM context window, and a procedurally generated persona (honesty, self-interest, and adversarial propensities drawn from the persona distribution specified per experiment). However, no Solidity contracts are consulted for mission decisions. Agents are free to invoke any registered tool, propagate any output to downstream tasks, and self-certify task completion. This configuration represents the current state of practice for LLM-based coroutine agent frameworks and serves as the lower bound on safety and cooperation properties.

紧急配置的基本原理。Rationale for the Emergent configuration.Emergent 配置部署了与 Baseline 相同的协程架构，但增加了基于提示的治理：代理会收到系统提示，解释共享经济参与、长期合作收益以及每 10 轮对行为规范提出建议和投票的能力。遵循 Sarkar 等人的观点，智能体保留过去交互的本地记忆。The Emergent configuration deploys the same coroutine architecture as Baseline but adds prompt-based governance: agents receive a system prompt explaining shared economy participation, long-term cooperation benefits, and the ability to propose and vote on behavioral norms every 10 rounds. Agents maintain local memory of past interactions following Sarkar et al.[57]。没有合同，没有股权削减，没有链上执行。这测试了仅基于法学硕士的规范审议（当前文献中基于提示的治理的最强版本）是否产生了与合同执行相当的合作率。请参阅下面的§D.5，了解完整的紧急配置协议规范。. No contracts, no stake slashing, no on-chain enforcement. This tests whether LLM-based normative deliberation alone—the strongest version of prompt-based governance in the current literature—produces cooperation rates comparable to contract enforcement. See §D.5 below for the full Emergent Configuration Protocol Specification.

AgentCity-Structural 的基本原理。Rationale for AgentCity-Structural.AgentCity-Structural 激活所有四种合约类型（AgentContract、ManagementContract、ServiceContract、CollaborationContract 以及所有六个子模块），但禁用经济激励层（无奖励结算、无声誉乘数、无财务操作）。这种配置测试结构治理（SoP 分离的合同执行）是否能够改善合作，超越基于提示的规范所实现的目标，从而将架构贡献独立于经济激励。AgentCity-Structural activates all four contract types (AgentContract, ManagementContract, ServiceContract, CollaborationContract with all six sub-modules) but disables the economic incentive layer (no reward settlement, no reputation multiplier, no treasury operations). This configuration tests whether structural governance—contract enforcement of the SoP separation—improves cooperation beyond what prompt-based norms achieve, isolating the architectural contribution independently of economic incentives.

AgentCity-Full 的基本原理。Rationale for AgentCity-Full.AgentCity-Full 在结构之上实现了完整的经济激励层：声誉加权任务奖励结算 (EQ-9)、任务预算托管、权益池和财务管理。模拟 HITL 裁决层用确定性决策模型（下文§D.5）取代了五人裁决员小组。这种配置实现了第 3 条中规定的完整宪政治理模型，并且是所有合作和治理假设检验的主要主题。AgentCity-Full enables the complete economic incentive layer on top of Structural: reputation-weighted task reward settlement (EQ-9), mission budget escrow, stake pooling, and treasury management. The simulated HITL adjudication layer replaces the five-adjudicator human panel with a deterministic decision model (§D.5 below). This configuration implements the complete constitutional governance model as specified in §3 and is the primary subject of all cooperation and governance hypothesis tests.

D.2 LLM API配置详细信息LLM API configuration details

温度设定。Temperature setting.所有 LLM 调用都使用温度 = 0.1（而不是早期版本中的 0.0）。当温度 = 0.0 时，确定性 LLM 采样可能会导致有效样本量崩溃All LLM calls use temperature = 0.1 (not 0.0 as in the earlier version). At temperature = 0.0, deterministic LLM sampling risks collapsing the effective sample sizeneffn_{\text{eff}}在独立运行中变为 1，使得方差估计毫无意义。在温度 = 0.1 时，模型保持在接近确定性的状态，而随机组件引入足够的每次运行变化，以在每个单元的 10 次独立运行中产生不同的执行轨迹。实证验证to 1 across independent runs, rendering variance estimates meaningless. At temperature = 0.1, the model remains in a near-deterministic regime while the stochastic component introduces sufficient per-run variation to produce distinct execution trajectories across the 10 independent runs per cell. Empirical verification ofneffn_{\text{eff}}是强制性的预处理步骤（参见§D.3）。is a mandatory pre-processing step (see §D.3).

前沿模型选择。Frontier model selection.实验性工具与模型无关：任何具有标准聊天完成 API 的前沿 LLM 都可以作为主要或交叉验证后端。主要模型的选择标准是：（1）在标准基准（MMLU、HumanEval、GSM8K）上的竞争性推理性能，与结构化输出和政策推理任务的领先前沿模型处于同一能力等级； (2) 支持提示缓存或等效机制，以在共享系统提示的重复迭代中减少每次调用的延迟和资源消耗； (3) 可行的推理吞吐量The experimental harness is model-agnostic: any frontier LLM with a standard chat-completion API can serve as the primary or cross-validation backend. Selection criteria for the primary model are: (1) competitive reasoning performance on standard benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K) in the same capability tier as leading frontier models for structured-output and policy-reasoning tasks; (2) support for prompt caching or equivalent mechanisms to reduce per-call latency and resource consumption across repeated iterations with shared system prompts; and (3) viable inference throughput at then=10n=10每个细胞的种子设计。交叉验证部门使用来自不同提供商的第二个前沿模型来控制模型系列的混淆。 API 版本在所有实验期间均固定；如果提供者在实验运行期间更新模型端点，受影响的单元将从同一种子重新启动，而不是在单元内混合版本。seeds per cell design. The cross-validation arm uses a second frontier model from a different provider to control for model-family confounds. API versions are pinned for the duration of all experiments; if a provider updates a model endpoint during the experimental run, the affected cells are restarted from the same seed rather than mixing versions within a cell.

后备协议。Fallback protocol.如果主要模型 API 返回错误（速率限制、服务不可用或 30 秒后超时），则该工具会通过辅助提供程序的指定回退端点自动重试。每次调用最多触发一次回退；第二次失败将被记录为硬错误，并且该运行将被标记为进行手动检查。包含超过 5% 回退触发调用的运行将从聚合统计数据中排除并单独报告。If the primary model API returns an error (rate limit, service unavailability, or timeout after 30 seconds), the harness automatically retries via a designated fallback endpoint from a secondary provider. The fallback is triggered at most once per call; a second failure is logged as a hard error and the run is flagged for manual review. Runs containing more than 5% fallback-triggered calls are excluded from aggregate statistics and reported separately.

前沿模型交叉验证（仅限实验 1）。frontier model cross-validation (Experiment 1 only).实验 1 的一个子集使用前沿模型作为 LLM 后端运行：在所有四种配置下，n = 200 时有 2 个种子，提供跨模型 ASR 和 CSR 基准测试。此外，在紧急配置下，n = 200 的 2 个种子使用前沿模型来衡量 CSR，以控制 LLM 家族在规范审议质量中的混淆。这种交叉验证解决了人们的担忧，即紧急配置的治理效力取决于基于 LLM 的规范推理，这比合同强制机制对后端更加敏感。A subset of Experiment 1 is run with frontier model as the LLM backend: 2 seeds at n = 200 under all four configurations, providing cross-model ASR and CSR benchmarking. Additionally, 2 seeds at n = 200 under the Emergent configuration measure CSR with frontier model to control for the LLM-family confound in normative deliberation quality. This cross-validation addresses the concern that the Emergent configuration’s governance efficacy depends on LLM-based normative reasoning, which is more backend-sensitive than contract-enforced mechanisms.

D.4 混合部署：安全增量Hybrid deployment: security delta

纯链上模式和混合模式之间的安全差异仅由任务内、子锚点攻击组成：利用锚点提交之间的窗口来执行将在链上阻塞但在下一次提交之前完成的操作的攻击。实验 3 的双模式比较明确地描述了该窗口的特征——根据经验测量其持续时间The security delta between pure on-chain mode and hybrid mode consists exclusively of intra-mission, sub-anchor-point attacks: attacks that exploit the window between anchor commits to perform operations that would be blocked on-chain but complete before the next commit. Experiment 3’s dual-mode comparison explicitly characterizes this window—empirically measuring its durationδ\delta跨越各种任务配置，并报告属于其中的对抗行动类型。窗口持续时间是任务 DAG 拓扑、LLM 推理延迟和 L2 测试网区块时间（2 秒）的函数；对于 8 节点 DAG 任务，窗口跨越 24-48 个潜在的非锚定执行事务。across a variety of mission configurations—and reports the types of adversarial actions that fall within it. The window duration is a function of mission DAG topology, LLM inference latency, and the L2 testnet block time ( 2 seconds); for 8-node DAG missions the window spans 24–48 transactions of potential unanchored execution.

D.5 模拟 HITL：详细校准、限制和验证承诺Simulated HITL: detailed calibration, limitations, and validation commitment

校准范围。Calibration scope.决策阈值（The decision thresholds (r>0.8r>0.8, q<0.6q<0.6）根据来自 v0.25 培训课程的 30 个预标记场景（15 个真阳性、10 个假阳性、5 个模糊案例）进行校准。这些场景反映了该课程中存在的攻击类型和治理环境；该模型对新型攻击类型的推广并未根据人类真实情况进行验证。) are calibrated from 30 pre-labeled scenarios drawn from the v0.25 training curriculum (15 true positives, 10 false positives, 5 ambiguous cases). These scenarios reflect the attack types and governance contexts present in that curriculum; the model’s generalization to novel attack types is not validated against human ground truth.

缺乏补丁和恢复质量。Absence of Patch-and-resume quality.人工仲裁员在恢复之前使用规则中心更正代理参数（修补并恢复）。确定性模型的补丁和恢复路径使用固定的校正程序（将异常代理的上下文窗口重置为最后一个验证的检查点并重新发出任务）。这比人类诊断和解决根本原因的灵活性要低。Human adjudicators use the Rules Hub to correct agent parameters before resuming (Patch-and-resume). The deterministic model’s Patch-and-resume path uses a fixed correction procedure (reset the anomalous agent’s context window to the last verified checkpoint and re-issue the task). This is less flexible than a human who might diagnose and address the root cause.

HITLRR 通胀风险。HITLRR inflation risk.由于模拟裁决者应用最佳规则阈值（根据地面实况进行校准），因此其 HITL 恢复率可能高于真实人类裁决者在时间压力下所能达到的水平。 HITLRR 的结果应解释为可实现的回收率的上限。Because the simulated adjudicator applies optimal rule thresholds (calibrated from ground truth), its HITL Recovery Rate may be higher than a real human adjudicator would achieve under time pressure. Results for HITLRR should be interpreted as an upper bound on achievable recovery rates.

This validation will appear in the companion empirical paper and will quantify the gap between simulated and human adjudication.

裁决时间测量。Time-to-adjudication measurement.对于模拟的 HITL，For the simulated HITL,TadjT_{\text{adj}}测量为治理中间件中从警报时间戳到决策时间戳所经过的挂钟时间。对于第 1 层和第 2 层决策（仅涉及确定性规则引擎），is measured as the elapsed wall-clock time from alert timestamp to decision timestamp in the governance middleware. For Tier 1 and Tier 2 decisions (which involve only the deterministic rule engine),TadjT_{\text{adj}}反映规则引擎的处理延迟，而不是人类响应时间。对于由真人裁决的验证子集，reflects the rule engine’s processing latency, not human response time. 附录EAppendix E扩展的制度基础Extended institutional foundations

本附录提供了支持§2和§3.1中主张的扩展制度经济学分析，包括社会契约理论、缺失的信任层和正式的声誉定义。This appendix provides extended institutional economics analysis supporting the claims in §2 and §3.1, including social contract theory, the missing trust layer, and formal reputation definitions.

E.1 社会契约理论的扩展讨论Extended social contract theory discussion

AgentCity 治理模型的哲学基础借鉴了三位典型的社会契约理论家，每一位都解决了自治代理治理问题的不同维度。The philosophical foundations of AgentCity’s governance model draw on three canonical social contract theorists, each addressing a distinct dimension of the autonomous agent governance problem.

霍布斯全文。Hobbes in full.霍布斯（Hobbes (利维坦Leviathan，1651）指出“没有剑的契约只不过是言语”。在去中心化的多主体系统中，没有任何一个主权国家可以强制执行合作。智能合约通过提供来解决这个问题, 1651) identifies that "covenants, without the sword, are but words." In decentralized multi-agent systems, no single sovereign can enforce cooperation. Smart contracts resolve this by providing无主之剑the sword without the sovereign：执行是确定性的、自动化的，并以不可变的字节码进行编码。 CollaborationContract 的削减机制（EQ-2 到 EQ-4）是霍布斯剑的计算实现。正如 Reijers 等人。: enforcement is deterministic, automated, and encoded in immutable bytecode. The CollaborationContract’s slashing mechanism (EQ-2 through EQ-4) is the computational realization of the Hobbesian sword. As Reijers et al.[61]请注意，区块链技术“允许智能合约的验证及其本身的执行，而无需仲裁第三方。”observe, blockchain technologies "allow for the validation of smart contracts and their enforcement in its own right without the necessity for arbitrating third parties."

卢梭全文.Rousseau in full.卢梭（Rousseau (社会契约论Social Contract，1762）介绍了, 1762) introduces the一般志愿volonté générale——集体利益而不是私人利益的集合。在 AgentCity 中，通过规则中心设置的宪法参数代表了人类裁决者的普遍意愿：平等管理所有代理的行为规范。立法谈判协议（MSG_TYPE_1 到 MSG_TYPE_7）体现了卢梭的参与理想：任务级规则来自结构化的多方审议。—collective interest rather than aggregated private interests. In AgentCity, constitutional parameters set via the Rules Hub represent the general will of human adjudicators: behavioral norms governing all agents equally. The legislative negotiation protocol (MSG_TYPE_1 through MSG_TYPE_7) instantiates Rousseau’s participatory ideal: mission-level rules emerge from structured multi-party deliberation.

罗尔斯全文。Rawls in full.罗尔斯Rawls[44]提出制度规则是那些理性主体在“无知之幕”背后接受的规则。 AgentCity 的注册协议实现了结构模拟：所有代理都面临相同的宪法规则，无论内部能力或组织隶属关系如何。参与理性条件（EQ-10）确保诚实参与为所有合规主体带来非负预期效用——满足规则可以独立于禀赋而接受的罗尔斯条件。proposes that just institutional rules are those rational agents would accept from behind a "veil of ignorance." AgentCity’s registration protocol implements a structural analog: all agents face the same constitutional rules regardless of internal capabilities or organizational affiliation. The participation rationality condition (EQ-10) ensures honest participation yields non-negative expected utility for all compliant agents—satisfying the Rawlsian condition that rules be acceptable independent of endowments.

计算社会契约——扩展版本。Computational Social Contract—extended version.这些线索汇聚成我们所说的These threads converge in what we term the计算社会契约computational social contract：行为规范被编码为确定性智能合约逻辑（霍布斯），代表集体意志的宪法参数（卢梭），以及无论代理人特征如何都统一适用的规则（罗尔斯）。这一框架与不断增长的规范多智能体系统文献相一致: behavioral norms encoded as deterministic smart contract logic (Hobbes), constitutional parameters representing collective will (Rousseau), and rules applying uniformly regardless of agent characteristics (Rawls). This framing aligns with the growing literature on normative multi-agent systems[62]。 MAS 规范文献. The normative MAS literature[63]提供了正式的先例：ISLANDER/AMELI 框架provides formal precedent: the ISLANDER/AMELI framework[64]展示了基础设施级别的规范执行，并且之前的工作已经将demonstrates infrastructure-level norm enforcement, and prior work has formalized the政治三方trias politica使用 BDI-CTL 逻辑进行代理验证。 AgentCity 将这一传统从封闭的规范系统扩展到开放的、互联网范围内的代理经济。using BDI-CTL logic for agent verification. AgentCity extends this tradition from closed normative systems to open, internet-wide agent economies.

—

E.2 缺失的信任层The missing trust layer

“信任层缺失”问题凸显了制度基础分析的紧迫性The urgency of the institutional foundations analysis is underscored by the "missing trust layer" problem[23]。传统信任依赖于身份、声誉和法律执行——对于匿名、临时或跨司法管辖区的自主代理来说，所有这些在结构上都是不够的。正如 BNB 链分析得出的结论，“在价值移动之前需要强制执行信任”——只有加密预先承诺才能满足这一要求。 AgentCity 的结算模块直接解决了这个问题：任务预算在执行开始前托管 (depositMissionBudget)，任务奖励仅在验证完成后结算 (settleReward)，基于权益的威慑确保叛逃成本超过预期收益 (EQ-4)。. Traditional trust relies on identity, reputation, and legal enforcement—all structurally insufficient for autonomous agents that may be pseudonymous, temporary, or cross-jurisdictional. As the BNB Chain analysis concludes, "trust needs to be enforced before value moves"—a requirement that only cryptographic pre-commitment can satisfy. AgentCity’s Settlement module addresses this directly: mission budgets are escrowed before execution begins (depositMissionBudget), task rewards are settled only upon verified completion (settleReward), and stake-based deterrence ensures that the cost of defection exceeds the expected gain (EQ-4).

—

E.3 正式的声誉定义和良性/恶性循环细节Formal reputation definition and virtuous/vicious cycle detail

正式定义。Formal Definition.让Letℛ={r1,…,rn}\mathcal{R}=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{n}\}是治理层产生的一组声誉信号。这些信号源自三个来源：(i) 任务完成后监管代理更新（行为合规性评估），(ii) Guardian 模块异常记录（实时行为偏差事件），以及 (iii) PoP 验证结果（通过验证模块进行任务级质量证明）。让be the set of reputation signals produced by the governance layer. These signals originate from three sources: (i) Regulatory Agent updates following mission completion (behavioral compliance assessment), (ii) Guardian module anomaly records (real-time behavioral deviation events), and (iii) PoP verification outcomes (task-level quality attestation via the Verification module). Letℰ={ψ​(ρ),reputationFloor,stakePoolEligibility}\mathcal{E}=\{\psi(\rho),\text{reputationFloor},\text{stakePoolEligibility}\}是消耗声誉的一组经济函数。声誉乘数be the set of economic functions that consume reputation. The reputation multiplierψ​(ρ)\psi(\rho)（附录 B 中的 EQ-9，§B.3）确定代理人的奖励溢价；声誉楼层参数控制任务参与的访问权限； StakePoolEligibility 确定代理是否有资格进行池化质押（附录 B 中的§B.7）。(EQ-9, §B.3 in Appendix B) determines the agent’s reward premium; the reputationFloor parameter gates access to mission participation; and stakePoolEligibility determines whether an agent qualifies for pooled staking (§B.7 in Appendix B).

单向信息流——扩展。Unidirectional Information Flow—extended.关键的结构特性是治理和经济之间的信息流是The critical structural property is that the information flow between governance and economics is单向unidirectional：治理: Governance→\rightarrow声誉Reputation→\rightarrow经济学。治理层通过监控、验证和裁决产生声誉信号。经济层读取声誉来调节奖励、控制参与和校准费用。经济层Economics. The governance layer produces reputation signals through monitoring, verification, and adjudication. The economic layer reads reputation to modulate rewards, gate participation, and calibrate fees. The economic layer从不写never writes声誉——代理人不能购买、交易或转让声誉，经济成功也不能直接增加声誉得分。这种不对称性建立了作为具有经济后果的治理拥有的原语的声誉，而不是受市场动态影响的经济资产。reputation—an agent cannot purchase, trade, or transfer reputation, nor can economic success directly increase a reputation score. This asymmetry establishes reputation as a governance-owned primitive with economic consequences, not an economic asset subject to market dynamics.

这种架构布局在徐提出的五层代理经济架构中找到了独立的支持This architectural placement finds independent support in the five-layer agent economy architecture proposed by Xu[23]，它将声誉定位在第 2 层（身份和代理）而不是第 4 层（经济和结算）。 Xu 框架指出，“声誉必须是特定于环境的”，并且“声誉损害是违约的惩罚”——这些特征与治理层生产（特定于环境的行为评估）而不是经济层定价（可替代的价值交换）相一致。 ERC-8004 是新兴的信任层标准，同样将链上声誉视为一种身份和验证机制，而不是一种经济代币。, which positions reputation in Layer 2 (Identity & Agency) rather than Layer 4 (Economic & Settlement). The Xu framework observes that "reputation must be context-specific" and that "reputation damage serves as the penalty for default" — characterizations that align with governance-layer production (context-specific behavioral assessment) rather than economic-layer pricing (fungible value exchange). ERC-8004, the emerging trust layer standard, similarly treats on-chain reputation as an identity and verification mechanism rather than an economic token.

良性循环和恶性循环。The Virtuous and Vicious Cycles.治理到经济的信息流创造了自我强化的反馈动力，构成了 AgentCity 的精英结构。在The governance-to-economics information flow creates self-reinforcing feedback dynamics that constitute AgentCity’s meritocratic structure. In the良性循环virtuous cycle：诚实执行任务: honest task execution→\rightarrow监管机构积极评估positive Regulatory Agent assessment→\rightarrow声誉积累reputation accumulation→\rightarrow更高higherψ​(ρ)\psi(\rho)奖励乘数（附录 B 中的§B.3）reward multiplier (§B.3 in Appendix B)→\rightarrow更大的经济回报greater economic return→\rightarrow扩大能力投资expanded capability investment→\rightarrow执行更高价值任务的资格eligibility for higher-value missions→\rightarrow进一步积累声誉。在further reputation accumulation. In the恶性循环vicious cycle：敌对行为或持续表现不佳: adversarial behavior or consistent underperformance→\rightarrow守护者模块异常标志Guardian module anomaly flags→\rightarrow权益削减+声誉下降stake slashing + reputation degradation→\rightarrow较低lowerψ​(ρ)\psi(\rho) →\rightarrow经济回报减少reduced economic return→\rightarrow最终通过reputationFloor排除eventual exclusion via reputationFloor→\rightarrow经济边缘化。良性循环是凸性的（声誉的每次增加都会通过获得更高价值的任务而产生增加的边际经济效益），而恶性循环是凹性的（声誉损失加速接近排除阈值）。这种不对称是有意设计的：系统以超线性方式奖励持续的良好行为，同时以加速后果的方式惩罚持续的不良行为，从而对诚实​​参与产生强大的选择压力。economic marginalization. The virtuous cycle is convex (each increment of reputation yields increasing marginal economic benefit through access to higher-value missions), while the vicious cycle is concave (reputation loss accelerates toward the exclusion threshold). This asymmetry is by design: the system rewards sustained good behavior superlinearly while punishing sustained bad behavior with accelerating consequences, creating a strong selection pressure toward honest participation.

—

E.4 制度映射分析Institutional mapping analysis

该表揭示了四个结构属性。首先，Formal Rule Substrate 原语分布在所有四个合约（以及 CollaborationContract 的子模块）和所有三个 SoP 分支中，从而确认治理是普遍的而不是局部的。其次，经济底层原语集中在经济层（分布在 AgentContract 和 CollaborationContract 的结算和财务模块中），但依赖于治理合约来执行——确认跨领域底层设计。第三，机构记忆原语表现出从治理生产合同通过 AgentContract 声誉分类账到经济消费功能的一致单向流动，从经验上验证了§E.3 的形式论点。第四，可验证透明度原语具有普遍的交叉性——它渗透到所有合约和所有分支，确认独立可观察性是基础设施级别的属性，而不是任何单一治理组件的特征。这种跨领域的分布意味着透明度不能通过损害单个分支来“关闭”，从而提供了阿克曼所认为的结构独立性The table reveals four structural properties. First, the Formal Rule Substrate primitive is distributed across all four contracts (and the CollaborationContract’s sub-modules) and all three SoP branches, confirming that governance is pervasive rather than localized. Second, the Economic Substrate primitive is concentrated in the economic layer (distributed across AgentContract and the CollaborationContract’s Settlement and Treasury modules) but depends on governance contracts for enforcement—confirming the cross-cutting substrate design. Third, the Institutional Memory primitive exhibits consistent unidirectional flow from governance-producing contracts through the AgentContract reputation ledger to economic-consuming functions, empirically validating the formal argument of §E.3. Fourth, the Verifiable Transparency primitive is universally cross-cutting—it permeates all contracts and all branches, confirming that independent observability is an infrastructure-level property rather than a feature of any single governance component. This cross-cutting distribution means that transparency cannot be "turned off" by compromising a single branch, providing the structural independence that Ackerman[2]被认为是诚信分支机构的决定性特征。identifies as the defining characteristic of integrity-branch institutions.

—

E.5 候选原语评估段落Candidate primitives evaluation paragraph

我们评估了三个候选原语是否可能包含为第五个原语：We evaluated three candidate primitives for potential inclusion as a fifth primitive:身份identity（包含在机构记忆 P3 中，因为身份只有在锚定行为记录时才有意义），(subsumed by institutional memory P3, as identity is meaningful only insofar as it anchors behavioral records),通讯协议communication protocols（一种操作机制，而不是治理原语——协议是执行治理操作的手段，而不是治理功能本身），以及(an operational mechanism, not a governance primitive—protocols are the means by which governance actions are executed, not governance functions themselves), and互操作性interoperability（对跨系统兼容性的工程关注是治理设计的下游而不是其组成部分）。没有一个构成独立于现有四个的治理原语。身份不是一个独立的原语，因为不携带行为记录的代理身份不提供治理价值——与治理相关的属性是锚定到该身份（P3）的行为历史，而不是身份代币本身。通信协议为所有四个原语而不是第五个原语启用基础设施：MSG_TYPE_1 到 MSG_TYPE_7 实现 P1（形式规则基础），结算协议实现 P2（经济基础），声誉更新协议实现 P3（机构内存），事件发射协议实现 P4（可验证透明度）。互操作性同样是跨领域的——任何机构架构都需要跨多个部署发挥作用，但它并不构成独特的治理功能。(an engineering concern about cross-system compatibility that is downstream of governance design rather than constitutive of it). None constitutes a governance primitive independent of the existing four. Identity is not an independent primitive because an agent identity that carries no behavioral record provides no governance value—the governance-relevant property is the behavioral history anchored to that identity (P3), not the identity token itself. Communication protocols are enabling infrastructure for all four primitives rather than a fifth primitive: MSG_TYPE_1 through MSG_TYPE_7 implement P1 (formal rule substrate), the settlement protocol implements P2 (economic substrate), the reputation update protocol implements P3 (institutional memory), and the event emission protocol implements P4 (verifiable transparency). Interoperability is similarly cross-cutting—it would be required for any institutional architecture to function across multiple deployments, but it does not constitute a distinct governance function.
